title: Goa Temple Recipes
tagline: 62 sattvic recipes for institutional cooking, written for ISKCON Bangalore

recipes.name: Sol Kadi
recipes.sub: Kokum and coconut milk cooler

method.en: Soak the dried kokum in warm water for an hour and work the pulp off the skins with the fingers. Keep that liquid and use nothing else for the sourness.
method.l: सुकीं कोकम कोमट उदकांत एक वर भिजयात, बोटांनीं गर काडात. तें उदक दवरात, हेर कांयच घालचें न्हय.

method.en: Grind the fresh coconut with warm water and press it through muslin. Press it twice — the second pressing is half the milk and throwing it away wastes half the coconut.
method.l: ताजो नाल्ल कोमट उदकाकडेन दळात आनी मलमलांतल्यान पिळात. दोन फावटीं पिळात — दुसरें पिळप म्हळ्यार अर्दें दूद.

method.en: Use fresh coconut, never desiccated. Desiccated coconut gives a thin grey liquid and no amount of it will make a sol kadi.
method.l: ताजो नाल्लच वापरात, सुको न्हय. सुक्या नाल्लान सोलकडी जायना.

method.en: Combine the coconut milk and the kokum liquid cold. Never heat a sol kadi — coconut milk splits and the kokum turns brown and flat.
method.l: नाल्लाचें दूद आनी कोकमाचें उदक थंड आसतना एकठांय करात. सोलकडी केन्नाच तापोवची न्हय.

method.en: Grind the chilli and ginger to a fine paste and stir it in by hand rather than in the machine.
method.l: मिरसांग आनी आलें बारीक वाटात आनी हातान भरसात.

method.en: Taste it cold and correct the salt. Chilled kokum needs more salt than it seems to, and the balance should be sour first, then salt, then a little sweet.
method.l: थंड आसतनाच चाकात. थंड कोकमाक दिसता तातूंतल्यान चड मीठ जाय.

recipes.why: Never heated, and the coconut pressed twice. On a Goan table this is the drink and the digestive both.
recipes.why_l: केन्नाच तापोवंक ना, आनी नाल्ल दोन फावटीं पिळ्ळो. गोंयांत हेंच पियां आनी हेंच पचन.

start.en: Soak the kokum an hour. Nothing is cooked. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: कोकम एक वर भिजयात. रांदप ना. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L drum, a grinder and muslin. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. ड्रम, ग्राइंडर आनी मलमल. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year. On the table at every Goan meal.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. दर गोंयकार जेवणांत मेजार आसता.

recipes.name: Kokum Sharbat
recipes.sub: Kokum cordial with cumin and salt

method.en: Kokum ripens in May and the whole year's supply is made in those three weeks. Buy the fruit fresh if it can be got, dried if it cannot.
method.l: कोकम मे म्हयन्यांत पिकता आनी आख्ख्या वर्साचें त्याच तीन सप्तकांनीं करतात.

method.en: Steep the kokum in just enough hot water to cover, overnight, and work the pulp off the skins the next morning.
method.l: कोकम बुडटा तितलें कोमट उदक घालून रातभर दवरात, फाल्यां सकाळीं गर काडात.

method.en: Cook the strained liquid with the sugar to a light syrup, about twenty minutes. Skim the froth as it rises.
method.l: गाळिल्लें उदक साकरे वांगडा वीस मिनटां शिजयात. वयर येवपी फेण काडात.

method.en: Do not boil it hard or long. Kokum loses its colour in a long boil and what is left is only sour.
method.l: चड वेळ वा जोरान उकडचें न्हय. कोकमाचो रंग वता आनी फकत आंबटपण उरता.

method.en: Bottle the syrup hot in sterilised glass and it keeps a full year in a cool store.
method.l: सरबत गरम आसतनाच निवळ काचेच्या बाटलेंत भरात, थंड जाग्यार वर्सभर उरता.

method.en: To serve, dilute about one part syrup to six of water and add roasted cumin and both salts at the counter.
method.l: वाडपाक एक वांटो सरबत, स आठ वांटे उदक. जिरें आनी मीठ वाडपाच्या जाग्यार घालात.

recipes.why: Three weeks of fruit turned into a year of drink, and the whole method is not boiling it too hard.
recipes.why_l: तीन सप्तकांचें फळ वर्सभराचें पियां जालें. चड उकडचें न्हय, हेंच सगळें.

start.en: The cordial is made in May and keeps a year. Dilute and serve.
start.l: सरबत मे म्हयन्यांत करतात, वर्सभर उरता. उदक घालून वाडात.

vessel.en: A heavy 25 L vessel and glass bottles. Two cooks.
vessel.l: २५ ली. जड आयदन आनी काचेच्यो बाटल्यो. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: Kokum is picked in May; the cordial is drunk all year.
season.l: कोकम मे म्हयन्यांत काडटात; सरबत आख्खें वर्स पियेतात.

recipes.name: Coconut Lime Cooler
recipes.sub: Tender coconut water with lime

method.en: Open the coconuts as close to serving as possible. Tender coconut water begins to sour within two hours of being opened and there is nothing that stops it.
method.l: शाहळीं वाडपाच्या जितलें लागीं फोडात तितलें बरें. फोडल्या उपरांत दोन वरांनीं तें आंबट जाता.

method.en: Scrape the soft flesh out of each shell and keep it. It goes into the drum shredded and is half the reason for making this.
method.l: दर शाहळ्यांतली मोव खोबरी काडून दवरात. ती किसून ड्रमांत घालतात.

method.en: Do not strain the water through cloth. Straining takes out the soft flesh, which is the point.
method.l: उदक कापडांतल्यान गाळचें न्हय. गाळ्ळ्यार मोव खोबरी वता.

method.en: Add only a little sugar and taste first. Tender coconut water is already faintly sweet and sixty coconuts vary a great deal.
method.l: थोडीशीच साकर घालात आनी पयलीं चाकात. शाहळ्याचें उदक आदींच गोड आसता.

method.en: Add the lime at the counter, not in the kitchen. Lime added early turns the water cloudy and slightly bitter.
method.l: लिंब वाडपाच्या जाग्यार घालात, रांदपाघरांत न्हय.

method.en: Crush the mint by hand and steep only twenty minutes. Serve cold and do not hold it past two hours.
method.l: पुदिनो हातान चुरडात आनी वीस मिनटां दवरात. थंड वाडात, दोन वरांपरस चड दवरचें न्हय.

recipes.why: Opened late and limed at the counter. Both rules are about it not souring before the line ends.
recipes.why_l: उशीरां फोडप आनी वाडपाच्या जाग्यार लिंब. दोनूय आंबट जावंक नाकात म्हणून.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Open the coconuts within two hours of serving.
start.l: भिजोवंक ना. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरांभितर शाहळीं फोडात.

vessel.en: A 30 L drum and a coconut knife. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. ड्रम आनी नाल्ल फोडपाचो कातयो. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: March to June, and doubled in the hot months.
season.l: मार्च ते जून, तापाच्या दिसांनीं दुप्पट.

recipes.name: Nachne Ambil
recipes.sub: Ragi gruel soured overnight, drunk cold
recipes.sub_l: रातभर आंबयल्ली नाचणेची पेज, थंड पियेवपाची

method.en: Slake the ragi in cold water before it goes near the fire — dropped into hot water it lumps and no amount of stirring will smooth it.
method.l: नाचणी उज्याकडे वचचेआदीं थंड उदकांत कालयात — तापयल्ल्या उदकांत घाल्यार गुठळ्यो जातात.

method.en: Cook it out fully, twenty minutes, so the raw smell goes.
method.l: वीस मिनटां बरें शिजयात, जाका करून कच्चो वास वता.

method.en: Cool it to room heat before the buttermilk goes in, or the buttermilk splits.
method.l: ताक घालचेआदीं तें सामकें थंड जावंक दियात, ना जाल्यार ताक फुटता.

method.en: Leave it covered overnight and drink it the next morning, cold.
method.l: रातभर धांपून दवरात आनी दुसरे दिसा सकाळीं थंड पियेयात.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head, and it is what a Sanguem field hand drinks at eleven in the morning instead of a meal. Ragi grows on land where nothing else will.
recipes.why_l: नोव रुपया दर मनशाक. सांगेच्या शेतकऱ्याक सकाळच्या इकरा वरांचेर जेवणाबदला हेंच जाय. नाचणी अशे जमनींत पिकता जंय हेर कांयच पिकना.

start.en: Cook one day ahead and sour it overnight. Start eighteen hours before serving.
start.l: एक दीस आदीं रांदात आनी रातभर आंबवात. वाडपाआदीं अठरा वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L drum and a wooden churner. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. ड्रम आनी लांकडी रवी. एक रांदपी.

season.en: March to June, when the afternoons are worst.
season.l: मार्च ते जून, जेन्ना दनपारां सगळ्यांत वायट आसतात.

recipes.name: Ambyachem Panhem
recipes.sub: Roasted raw mango with jaggery and cumin
recipes.sub_l: गोड आनी जिऱ्यासयत भाजिल्लो कच्चो आंबो

method.en: Roast the mangoes whole over a wood fire until the skin blackens — boiled, the panhem is only sour and never smoky.
method.l: आंबे सालीसयत लांकडाच्या उज्यार साल काळी जासर भाजात — शिजयल्यार फकत आंबट लागता, धुंवराचो वास येना.

method.en: Squeeze the pulp out warm and sieve it twice.
method.l: गर हुनसाण आसतनाच काडात आनी दोन खेपे गाळात.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it; jaggery carries grit that settles at the bottom of the drum.
method.l: गोड वेगळो विरगळायात आनी गाळात; गोडांत रेंव आसता जी ड्रमाच्या तळाक बसता.

method.en: Roasted cumin and black salt at the counter, not in the drum.
method.l: भाजिल्लें जिरें आनी काळें मीठ वाडपाच्या जाग्यार, ड्रमांत न्हय.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees a head against ninety for a bottled drink, and it is made in the six weeks the raw mango sells at thirty rupees a kilo.
recipes.why_l: बाटलेच्या पेयाच्या नव्वद रुपयां परस तेरा रुपया दर मनशाक. जे स सप्तक कच्चो आंबो तीस रुपया किलो मेळटा, तेदनाच हें करतात.

start.en: Roast and pulp in the morning. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: सकाळीं भाजात आनी गर काडात. वाडपाआदीं तीन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A wood fire, a 30 L drum and a sieve. Two cooks.
vessel.l: लांकडाचो उजो, ३० ली. ड्रम आनी गाळणी. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Ananas Sarbat
recipes.sub: Pineapple pressed with lime and mint

method.en: Cut the eyes out of the pineapple properly; one left in is a sharp bite in a glass and the devotee stops drinking.
method.l: अननसाचे दोळे बरे काडात; एक उरलो जाल्यार ग्लासांत तोखता आनी भक्त पियेवप सोडटा.

method.en: Grind the flesh with the core — the core carries most of the smell.
method.l: गर मदल्या दांडयासयत वाटात — वास चडसो त्याच दांडयांत आसता.

method.en: Press through muslin rather than a fine sieve; a sieve leaves fibre that floats.
method.l: बारीक गाळणे परस मलमलींतल्यान पिळात; गाळणेंत तंतू उरतात जे तरतात.

method.en: Serve within three hours — pineapple juice standing longer turns bitter at the back of the tongue.
method.l: तीन वरां भितर वाडात — ते उपरांत अननसाचो रोस जिबेच्या फाटल्यान कडू लागता.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. Ponda's pineapple is thirty rupees a kilo in season and the second-grade fruit that will not sell whole makes the best sarbat.
recipes.why_l: सोळा रुपया दर मनशाक. फोंड्याचो अननस मोसमांत तीस रुपया किलो; जो अख्खो विकना ती दुय्यम प्रतीची फळां सगळ्यांत बरें सरबत दितात.

start.en: Nothing is cooked. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: रांदप ना. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A grinder, muslin and a 30 L drum. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ग्राइंडर, मलमल आनी ३० ली. ड्रम. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Sunthi Cha
recipes.sub: Dry ginger tea for the monsoon

method.en: Boil the water with dry ginger and pepper five minutes before anything else goes in.
method.l: हेर कांय घालचेआदीं उदक सुंठ आनी मिऱ्यांसयत पांच मिनटां उकडात.

method.en: Tulsi last and off the fire — boiled, it goes bitter.
method.l: तुळस निमणी आनी उजो पालवून — उकडल्यार कडू जाता.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in a separate pot and strain it in, or the milk will split in front of you.
method.l: गोड वेगळ्या आयदनांत विरगळावन गाळून घालात, ना जाल्यार दूद तुमच्या दोळ्यां मुखार फुटतलें.

method.en: Never let it sit on a flame for a second hour.
method.l: दुसऱ्या वरा मेरेन उज्यार दवरूं नाकात.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head, and in July the men who come in soaked from the pump house are given this before they are given anything to eat.
recipes.why_l: पंदरा रुपया दर मनशाक. जुलयांत पंप हावसांतल्यान भिजून येवपी मनशांक जेवण दिवचेआदीं हेंच दितात.

start.en: Twenty minutes on the fire. Serve at once.
start.l: वीस मिनटां उज्यार. तेदनाच वाडात.

vessel.en: A 25 L pot, a strainer and flasks. One cook.
vessel.l: २५ ली. आयदन, गाळणी आनी फ्लास्क. एक रांदपी.

season.en: June to September, and any cold morning.
season.l: जून ते सप्टेंबर, आनी खंयचोय थंड सकाळ.

recipes.name: Kaju Doodh
recipes.sub: Cashew milk with saffron for a feast night

method.en: Soak the cashew four hours and grind it with a little milk to a paste with no grain left in it.
method.l: काजू चार वरां भिजयात आनी थोड्या दुदांत सामकी बारीक वाटात.

method.en: Reduce the milk by a fifth first, scraping the sides back in.
method.l: पयलीं दूद पांचव्या वाटयान आटयात, देगो खरडून परत घालात.

method.en: Stir the paste in slowly — tipped in at once it sinks and burns on the base.
method.l: वाटिल्लो काजू सवकास घालात — एकठांय घाल्यार तळाक बसून लागता.

method.en: Saffron warmed in two spoons of hot milk, nutmeg grated at the end.
method.l: केसर दोन चमचे हुन दुदांत भिजयात, जायफळ निमाणें किसात.

recipes.why: Forty-four rupees a head. Bicholim's cashew is bought whole at the plantation gate for half the market rate, and broken kernels do the same work as whole ones here.
recipes.why_l: चवेचाळीस रुपया दर मनशाक. डिचोलेचो काजू बागायतीच्या दारांत बाजाराच्या अर्द्या दरान मेळटा, आनी तुटिल्ल्या गऱ्यांनी लेगीत हेंच काम जाता.

start.en: Soak the cashew four hours. Start five hours before serving.
start.l: काजू चार वरां भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं पांच वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L thick-based pot and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जाड तळाचें ३० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: All year. Served at the end of a night kirtan.

recipes.name: Sanna
recipes.sub: Steamed fermented rice cakes

method.en: Sanna is traditionally raised with palm toddy. Toddy is alcoholic, so this recipe uses yeast — the texture is close and the difference is worth stating on a menu.
method.l: सान्नां परंपरेन सुरेन फुगयतात. सूर मद्य आसा देखून हांगा यीस्ट वापरलां — रुची लागींची, पूण मेन्यूंत सांगप बरें.

method.en: Soak the parboiled rice five hours and grind it with the fresh coconut to a thick smooth batter.
method.l: उकडे तांदूळ पांच वर भिजयात आनी ताजो नाल्ल घालून घट्ट, मोव पीठ दळात.

method.en: Use parboiled rice, not raw. Raw rice gives a sanna that is dense and does not rise however long it ferments.
method.l: उकडे तांदूळच वापरात. कच्च्या तांदळाचीं सान्नां फुगनांत.

method.en: Activate the yeast in a little warm water with the sugar and wait ten minutes for foam. No foam means dead yeast and there is no point going further.
method.l: यीस्ट कोमट उदकांत साकरेकडेन घालून धा मिनटां सोडात. फेण आयली ना जाल्यार यीस्ट मेल्लें.

method.en: Ferment eight hours in a warm place. The batter should rise by about half and smell faintly sweet — sour means it has gone too far.
method.l: उदकट जाग्यार आठ वर आंबोवंक दवरात. पीठ अर्दें फुगपाक जाय.

method.en: Grease the moulds, fill them two-thirds only, and steam fifteen minutes. A full mould gives a sanna with a wet centre.
method.l: वाट्यांक तेल लावात, दोन तृतीयांशच भरात, पंदरा मिनटां उकडात.

recipes.why: Parboiled rice and a live ferment. The yeast is a substitution and the book says so.
recipes.why_l: उकडे तांदूळ आनी जिवें आंबोवप. यीस्ट ही बदली आनी पुस्तक तें सांगता.

start.en: Grind the soaked rice the night before and ferment eight hours.
start.l: भिजयल्लें तांदूळ रातचें दळात आनी आठ वर आंबोवंक दवरात.

vessel.en: Three steamers with small moulds. Three cooks.
vessel.l: तीन उकडपाचीं आयदनां आनी ल्हान वाट्यो. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Ambolli
recipes.sub: Fermented rice pancake

method.en: Soak the rice, urad dal and fenugreek together five hours and grind with the coconut to a pouring batter.
method.l: तांदूळ, उडीद डाळ आनी मेथी पांच वर भिजयात आनी नाल्लाकडेन दळात.

method.en: The fenugreek is not for flavour. It feeds the ferment and gives the ambolli its holes, and without it the pancake is flat and close.
method.l: मेथी रुचीक न्हय — ती आंबोवपाक मदत करता आनी आंबोळेंत भोंकां हाडटा.

method.en: Ferment eight hours in a warm place. In a Goan monsoon this may take six; in December allow ten.
method.l: उदकट जाग्यार आठ वर आंबोवंक दवरात. पावसाळ्यांत स वर, डिसेंबरांत धा.

method.en: Do not stir the batter down before cooking. Stirring knocks the air out and the ambolli comes out flat.
method.l: रांदचेआदीं पीठ ढवळचें न्हय. ढवळ्ळ्यार हवा वता.

method.en: Spread on a hot tawa and cover for the first minute. An ambolli is cooked on one side only and the lid is what sets the top.
method.l: तापल्ल्या तव्यार घालात आनी पयलें मिनीट झांपात. आंबोळी एकाच वटेन भाजतात.

method.en: Do not turn it. Turned, it becomes a dosa and loses the holes that give it its name.
method.l: उफटावंक नाकात. उफटायल्यार तो डोसो जाता.

recipes.why: One side only, and fenugreek in the grind. Both are what make it an ambolli rather than a dosa.
recipes.why_l: एकाच वटेन, आनी दळपांत मेथी. हेंच आंबोळी करता.

start.en: Grind the night before and ferment eight hours.
start.l: रातचें दळात आनी आठ वर आंबोवंक दवरात.

vessel.en: Four tawas. Three cooks.
vessel.l: चार तवे. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Polle
recipes.sub: Plain rice and coconut pancake

method.en: A polle is the unfermented cousin of the ambolli, and it exists for exactly the morning when nobody set a batter the night before.
method.l: पोळे म्हळ्यार आंबोळेचो न आंबयल्लो भाव. रातचें पीठ दवरूंक ना अशा सकाळाकच तो आसा.

method.en: Soak the rice three hours and grind with the coconut to a thin pouring batter — thinner than for an ambolli.
method.l: तांदूळ तीन वर भिजयात आनी नाल्लाकडेन पातळ पीठ दळात.

method.en: Rest the batter thirty minutes but do not ferment it. A polle is meant to be plain and slightly sweet from the coconut.
method.l: पीठ तीस मिनटां दवरात पूण आंबोवंक दिवचें न्हय.

method.en: Spread thin on a hot tawa. A polle is thinner than an ambolli and cooks in half the time.
method.l: तापल्ल्या तव्यार पातळ घालात. पोळे आंबोळेपरस पातळ आसतात.

method.en: Cook on both sides, unlike an ambolli. There is no ferment here to set the top and it needs turning.
method.l: दोनूय वटांनीं भाजात. हांगा आंबोवप ना देखून उफटावंक जाय.

method.en: Stack in a cloth-lined basket. Polle go hard within twenty minutes and are made to the line.
method.l: कापड घाल्ल्या टोपलेंत दवरात. पोळे वीस मिनटांनीं घट्ट जातात.

recipes.why: Three hours from a cold start and no ferment. This is the dish for the morning that went wrong.
recipes.why_l: तीन वरांनीं तयार, आंबोवप ना. चुकल्ल्या सकाळाखातीर हेंच.

start.en: Grind three hours ahead. No overnight ferment.
start.l: तीन वर आदीं दळात. रातभर आंबोवंक ना.

vessel.en: Four tawas. Three cooks.
vessel.l: चार तवे. तीन रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The pancake for a morning when nothing was fermented the night before.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. रातचें कांयच आंबयल्लें ना अशा सकाळाक.

recipes.name: Pez
recipes.sub: Parboiled rice gruel

method.en: Pez is boiled rice and its own water, and it is what a Goan household eats when there is nothing else or when someone is ill.
method.l: पेज म्हळ्यार शीत आनी ताचें उदक. घरांत हेर कांय ना वा कोणूय दुयेंत आसा जाल्यार हेंच.

method.en: Use parboiled rice. Raw rice gives a thin watery gruel; parboiled rice thickens the water and that thickness is the dish.
method.l: उकडे तांदूळ वापरात. कच्च्या तांदळाची पेज पातळ उरता.

method.en: Cook with far more water than for rice and do not drain any of it off. The starch in the water is the whole point.
method.l: शितापरस चड उदक घालात आनी तें केन्नाच गाळचें न्हय.

method.en: Cook forty minutes until the grains have burst completely and the liquid has thickened.
method.l: चाळीस मिनटां शिजयात, दाणे पुरायपणान फुटपासर.

method.en: Stir the grated coconut in off the fire. It is optional in a poor household and always there in a temple kitchen.
method.l: उजो बंद करून खवयल्लो नाल्ल भरसात.

method.en: Salt lightly and serve warm rather than hot. Pez is eaten with a pickle or a chutney and both are already salted.
method.l: थोडेंच मीठ घालात आनी कोमट वाडात.

recipes.why: Six kilos of rice feeds a hundred and there is nothing else in it. The cheapest thing in this book.
recipes.why_l: स किलो तांदळान शंबर जाण जेवतात. ह्या पुस्तकांतलें सगळ्यांत सवाय.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: भिजोवंक ना. वाडपाआदीं पन्नास मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ४० ली. जड आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year, and given to anyone who is unwell.

recipes.name: Alle Belle
recipes.sub: Thin pancake rolled around coconut and jaggery
recipes.sub_l: नाल्ल आनी गोड भरून गुठलायल्लो पातळ पोळो

method.en: Cook the coconut and jaggery together until the mixture leaves the side of the pan and no syrup runs when it is pushed.
method.l: नाल्ल आनी गोड एकठांय शिजयात, जोमेरेन तें आयदनाची देग सोडिना आनी ढकल्ल्यार पाक व्हांवना.

method.en: A wet filling soaks the pancake and it tears when it is rolled.
method.l: ओली भरणी पोळो भिजयता आनी गुठलायतना तो फाटता.

method.en: The batter must be thin enough to run off a ladle in a sheet.
method.l: पीठ इतलें पातळ जाय की डावेंतल्यान चादरीभशेन देंवचें.

method.en: Roll while the pancake is still warm; cold, it cracks along the fold.
method.l: पोळो हुनसाण आसतनाच गुठलायात; थंड जाल्यार घडयेर तो चिरता.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a head. What Goa eats at four in the afternoon and the one thing every child in the hall finishes without being asked twice.
recipes.why_l: बावीस रुपया दर मनशाक. गोंय सांजवेळार चार वरांचेर हेंच खाता, आनी हॉलांतलें दर भुरगें सांगचें पडना तशें सोंपयता.

start.en: Make the filling first, then the pancakes. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं भरणी, मागीर पोळे. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: Four tawas and a heavy kadhai. Four cooks.
vessel.l: चार तवे आनी एक जड कायल. चार रांदपी.

season.en: All year. More in the coconut months after the monsoon.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. पावसा उपरांतच्या नाल्लाच्या म्हयन्यांनी चड.

recipes.name: Neer Dosa
recipes.sub: Lace-thin rice crepes, no fermenting
recipes.sub_l: आंबवचें ना अशे बारीक तांदळाचे धोंस

method.en: Soak the rice four hours and grind it with the coconut to a batter with no grain felt between the fingers.
method.l: तांदूळ चार वरां भिजयात आनी नाल्लासयत अशें वाटात की बोटां मदीं कण लागचो न्हय.

method.en: Thin it until it is like water — that is the whole name of the dish and the reason it needs no fermenting.
method.l: तें उदकाभशेन पातळ करात — तेंच जेवणाचें नांव आनी तेच खातीर हाका आंबवचें पडना.

method.en: Pour from a height onto a very hot tawa and do not spread it with the ladle.
method.l: बरो तापिल्ल्या तव्यार वयल्यान वतात आनी डावेन पातळावंक वचूं नाकात.

method.en: Cover thirty seconds, lift, and never turn it.
method.l: तीस सेकंद धांपात, उखलात, आनी कदींच परतूं नाकात.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head and no dal, no fermenting, no waiting overnight. What the kitchen makes when a group arrives at seven in the morning with no notice.
recipes.why_l: चवदा रुपया दर मनशाक — ना दाळ, ना आंबवप, ना रातभर रावप. सकाळीं सात वरांचेर कळयनासतना पंगड आयल्यार रांदणकूड हेंच करता.

start.en: Soak four hours, grind, use at once. Start five hours before serving.
start.l: चार वरां भिजयात, वाटात, तेदनाच वापरात. वाडपाआदीं पांच वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: Six tawas with lids and a wet-grinder. Six cooks.
vessel.l: झांकणासयत स तवे आनी ओलो ग्राइंडर. स रांदपी.

recipes.name: Rulanv Sheero
recipes.sub: Semolina roasted in ghee with banana

method.en: Roast the semolina in ghee on the lowest flame until every grain is separate and the smell turns nutty — twenty-five minutes, not ten.
method.l: रुलांव धिम्या उज्यार तुपांत दर कण वेगळो जासर भाजात — धा न्हय, पंचवीस मिनटां.

method.en: Two and a half parts liquid to one of semolina, boiling before it goes in.
method.l: एक वांटो रुलांवाक अडेच वांटे द्रव, आनी तें घालचेआदीं उकडपाक जाय.

method.en: Rain it in with one hand and stir with the other, or the whole vessel is lumps.
method.l: एका हातान भुरकयात आनी दुसऱ्या हातान घुसळात, ना जाल्यार आख्खें आयदन गुठळ्यांचें जाता.

method.en: Mashed banana at the end, off the fire.
method.l: उजो पालवून निमाणें कुसकुरिल्लें केळें.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees a head, on the table in forty minutes and it is what goes out as prasadam after the morning arati when there is no time for sanna.
recipes.why_l: चोवीस रुपया दर मनशाक. चाळीस मिनटांत तयार; सकाळच्या आरतीउपरांत सान्नां करपाक वेळ ना जाल्यार प्रसाद म्हणून हेंच वता.

start.en: Roast, then cook. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं भाजात, मागीर रांदात. वाडपाआदीं सत्तर मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L heavy kadhai and a long spatula. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. जड कायल आनी लांब उलथणें. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Dudhatle Phov
recipes.sub: Beaten rice softened in sweetened milk

method.en: Use the thick poha, never the thin — thin poha turns to paste in milk before the tray reaches the hall.
method.l: जाड फोवच वापरात, पातळ न्हय — पातळ फोव हॉलांत पावचेआदींच दुदांत लापशी जातात.

method.en: Rinse it once in a colander and drain it fully; do not soak it.
method.l: चाळणींत एक खेप धुवात आनी उदक सामकें देंवचें दियात; भिजोवंक नाकात.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in a little milk and strain it in — jaggery dropped whole into cold milk will not dissolve evenly.
method.l: गोड थोड्या दुदांत विरगळावन गाळून घालात — थंड दुदांत सगळो एकठांय घाल्यार सारको विरगळना.

method.en: Mix banana and coconut in at the counter, not in the kitchen.
method.l: केळीं आनी नाल्ल वाडपाच्या जाग्यार भरसात, रांदणकुडींत न्हय.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head with no fire lit at all — which on a Gokulashtami morning, when every burner is taken, is the whole reason it is on the page.
recipes.why_l: वीस रुपया दर मनशाक आनी उजो पेटयचोच पडना — गोकुळाष्टमीच्या सकाळीं जेन्ना दर शेगडी घेतिल्ली आसता, तेच खातीर हें पानार आसा.

start.en: Nothing is cooked. Assemble thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: रांदप ना. वाडपाआदीं तीस मिनटां एकठांय करात.

vessel.en: Two 20 L drums and a colander. Two cooks.
vessel.l: दोन २० ली. ड्रम आनी चाळणी. दोन रांदपी.

season.l: आख्खें वर्स. सगळ्यां परस चड गोकुळाष्टमीक.

recipes.name: Coconut Chutney
recipes.sub: Fresh coconut with green chilli

method.en: Use fresh coconut grated the same morning. A coconut grated the day before tastes stale by evening and no chilli hides it.
method.l: त्याच सकाळचो खवयल्लो ताजो नाल्ल वापरात. आदल्या दिसाचो नाल्ल सांजेक शिळो लागता.

method.en: There is no onion and no garlic in a Goan temple chutney and none is missed. Ginger and green chilli carry it.
method.l: गोंयच्या देवळाच्या चटणेंत कांदो-लसूण ना आनी ताचो उणाव भासना.

method.en: Grind with as little water as the machine will take. A wet chutney goes sour within three hours in this climate.
method.l: ग्राइंडर घेता तितलेंच उदक घालात. पातळ चटणी तीन वरांनीं आंबट जाता.

method.en: Grind in short bursts and stop before the machine heats. Warm coconut releases its oil and the chutney splits.
method.l: थोडें थोडें दळात, मशीन तापचेआदीं थांबात. गरम नाल्ल तेल सोडटा.

method.en: Use tamarind rather than lemon. Lemon in a coconut chutney turns it bitter within the hour; tamarind does not.
method.l: लिंबापरस चिंच वापरात. लिंब घाल्ल्यार चटणी एका वरान कडू जाता.

method.en: Make it the same day. This is the one chutney in the book that will not keep overnight.
method.l: त्याच दिसा करात. ही चटणी रातभर उरना.

recipes.why: Fresh coconut, tamarind not lemon, and made the same day. Three rules and all three are about it not turning.
recipes.why_l: ताजो नाल्ल, लिंबापरस चिंच, आनी त्याच दिसा. तिनूय ती नाशिवची न्हय म्हणून.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Make it within two hours of serving.
start.l: भिजोवंक ना. वाडपाच्या दोन वरांभितर करात.

vessel.en: A wet grinder and a 8 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: ओलो ग्राइंडर आनी ८ ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Teppal Chutney
recipes.sub: Coconut and Sichuan pepper chutney

method.en: Teppal is the Goan Sichuan pepper and it is what a temple kitchen uses where another kitchen would reach for garlic. Nothing else in India tastes of it.
method.l: तेप्पल म्हळ्यार गोंयची सिचुआन मिरी. हेर रांदपाघरां लसूण घालतात थंय देवळाचें रांदपाघर हें घालता.

method.en: Buy teppal whole, in the husk, and crush it only at the moment of use. Pre-ground teppal loses everything within a week.
method.l: तेप्पल आख्खें, सालींत घेयात आनी वापरपाच्या घडयेकच चुरडात. आदींच दळ्ळ्यार एका सप्तकांत सगळें वता.

method.en: Discard the small black seed inside each husk. The seed is gritty and bitter and it is the husk that carries the flavour.
method.l: दर सालींतलो ल्हान काळो बी काडून उडयात. रूच सालींत आसा, बीयेंत न्हय.

method.en: Use it sparingly. A hundred and twenty grams in four litres is already assertive and a heavy hand numbs the mouth.
method.l: थोडेंच वापरात. चार लिटरांत १२० ग्राम पावता; चड घाल्ल्यार तोंड बधीर जाता.

method.en: Grind the coconut, chilli and kokum first, then crush the teppal in a mortar and stir it in by hand at the very end.
method.l: पयलीं नाल्ल, मिरसांग आनी कोकम दळात, मागीर तेप्पल उखळांत चुरडून हातान भरसात.

method.en: Never grind teppal in the machine with the coconut. The blades bruise the husk and it turns bitter.
method.l: तेप्पल मशिनांत नाल्लाकडेन दळचें न्हय. पातें साल चिरडटात आनी तें कडू जाता.

recipes.why: Whole husk, crushed last, and the seed thrown out. Teppal is what makes this book Goan rather than coastal.
recipes.why_l: आख्खी साल, निमाणें चुरडप, आनी बी उडोवप. तेप्पलानूच हें पुस्तक गोंयचें जाता.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Crush the teppal at the last moment.
start.l: भिजोवंक ना. तेप्पल निमाण्या घडयेक चुरडात.

vessel.en: A wet grinder, a mortar and a 6 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: ओलो ग्राइंडर, उखळ आनी ६ ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year; teppal is harvested in May and keeps a year dried.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स; तेप्पल मे म्हयन्यांत काडटात.

recipes.name: Kokum Chutney
recipes.sub: Kokum cooked with jaggery and chilli

method.en: Soak the kokum in warm water an hour and work the pulp off the skins. Keep both the pulp and the liquid.
method.l: कोकम कोमट उदकांत एक वर भिजयात आनी गर काडात. गर आनी उदक दोनूय दवरात.

method.en: Temper the mustard seed in coconut oil and wait until it stops popping before the curry leaf goes in.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव तडतडयात आनी तें थांबसर कढीपत्तो घालचो न्हय.

method.en: Use coconut oil, not groundnut. In Goa the oil is part of the flavour and a chutney made in another oil tastes of nowhere.
method.l: नाल्लाचें तेलच वापरात. गोंयांत तेल हो रुचीचो वांटो.

method.en: Add the asafoetida last of the tempering — it burns faster than anything else in the pan.
method.l: हिंग निमाणें घालात — तें सगळ्यांत बेगीन जळटा.

method.en: Cook the kokum with the jaggery on a low flame for twenty-five minutes until it holds a line drawn with a ladle.
method.l: कोकम आनी गोड धिम्या उज्यार पंचवीस मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Cool completely before judging the thickness — it sets a good deal firmer than it looks on the fire.
method.l: घट्टपण पळोवचेआदीं पुरायपणान थंड करात — तें उज्यार दिसता तापरस चड घट्ट जाता.

recipes.why: Two weeks in the fridge, so it can be made once for a fortnight. Coconut oil is not optional here.
recipes.why_l: फ्रिजांत दोन सप्तकां. नाल्लाचें तेल हांगा पर्याय न्हय.

start.en: Soak the kokum an hour. Keeps two weeks refrigerated.
start.l: कोकम एक वर भिजयात. फ्रिजांत दोन सप्तकां उरता.

vessel.en: A heavy 15 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: १५ ली. जड कढई. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year — dried kokum keeps a year.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स — सुकें कोकम वर्सभर उरता.

recipes.name: Ambade Chutney
recipes.sub: Hog plum ground with coconut and chilli

method.en: Boil the ambade five minutes and press the flesh off the stone with the fingers — the stone is fibrous and must not go near the grinder.
method.l: आंबाडे पांच मिनटां उकडात आनी बोटांनीं गर बियेवयल्यान काडात — बी तंतुमय आसता, ती ग्राइंडराकडे वचूंक फावना.

method.en: Grind the flesh with coconut and chilli and no water at all.
method.l: गर नाल्ल आनी मिरसांगेसयत वाटात, उदक मात घालचें न्हय.

method.en: Jaggery to hold the sourness, not to sweeten it — taste before the last half kilo goes in.
method.l: गोड आंबटपण सांबाळपाक, गोड करपाक न्हय — निमणो अर्दो किलो घालचेआदीं चाकून पळयात.

method.en: Keeps two days in the cold room and no longer.
method.l: थंड कुडींत दोन दीस रावता, ते परस चड न्हय.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head from a fruit that falls off temple trees in June and rots on the ground because nobody will pick it up.
recipes.why_l: नोव रुपया दर मनशाक. जुनांत देवळाच्या झाडां वयल्यान पडपी हें फळ कोणूच वेंचिना म्हूण जमनीर कुसता.

start.en: Boil, then grind. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: उकडात, मागीर वाटात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 15 L pot and a grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: १५ ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Karmal Chutney
recipes.sub: Star fruit ground raw with green chilli

method.en: Trim the brown ridge off each fin — that ridge is where the bitterness sits.
method.l: दर पंखाची तांबडी देग कातरात — कडूपण तातूंतच आसता.

method.en: Grind it raw; cooked star fruit loses everything it has.
method.l: कच्चेंच वाटात; शिजयल्ल्या कारमलांत कांयच उरना.

method.en: Do not add water — the fruit is more than half water already.
method.l: उदक घालचें न्हय — फळांतच अर्द्या परस चड उदक आसा.

method.en: Serve the same meal. It darkens within four hours.
method.l: त्याच जेवणांत वाडात. चार वरां भितर तें काळें पडटा.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head, no fire, no fuel, and every backyard in Bardez has a karmal tree that nobody has a use for.
recipes.why_l: सात रुपया दर मनशाक — ना उजो, ना इंदन; आनी बार्देशांतल्या दर परसांत कारमलाचें झाड आसा जाचो कोणाकच उपेग ना.

start.en: Nothing is cooked. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: रांदप ना. वाडपाआदीं चाळीस मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A grinder and a 10 L pan. One cook.
vessel.l: ग्राइंडर आनी १० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kaju Chutney
recipes.sub: Roasted cashew ground with tamarind

method.en: Roast the cashew dry, not in oil — oil-roasted cashew makes a chutney that separates in an hour.
method.l: काजू सुके भाजात, तेलांत न्हय — तेलांत भाजल्यार चटणी एका वरांत वेगळी जाता.

method.en: Roast the chillies until they smell but do not blacken.
method.l: मिरसांगो वास येसर भाजात, पूण काळ्यो जावंक दिवंक नाकात.

method.en: Grind thick and loosen with tamarind water only at the end.
method.l: घट्ट वाटात आनी निमाणें चिंचेच्या उदकान सैल करात.

method.en: Buy broken kernels; whole cashew in a chutney is money on the floor.
method.l: तुटिल्ले गरे घेयात; चटणेंत अख्खो काजू म्हळ्यार जमनीर उडयल्ले पयशे.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a head, dear for a chutney, and it is what makes a plain sanna into a feast plate without a second vessel on the fire.
recipes.why_l: बावीस रुपया दर मनशाक — चटणेखातीर म्हारग; पूण उज्यार दुसरें आयदन दवरिनासतना सादें सान्न फेस्ताचें ताट करता.

start.en: Roast, cool, grind. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: भाजात, थंड करात, वाटात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A heavy tawa and a grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: जड तवो आनी ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year. Cashew is cheapest in April and May.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. काजू एप्रील आनी मेयांत सगळ्यांत सवाय.

recipes.name: Tomat Chutney
recipes.sub: Tomato cooked down with coconut and jaggery

method.en: Cook the tomato down with the skin on until a ladle drawn across the pan shows the bottom.
method.l: तोमाट सालीसयत तोमेरेन शिजयात जोमेरेन डाव ओडल्यार आयदनाचो तळ दिसता.

method.en: Jaggery only after the water has gone, or it burns before the tomato is done.
method.l: उदक सुकल्या उपरांतच गोड, ना जाल्यार तोमाट शिजचेआदीं तो लागता.

method.en: Grind the coconut and chilli separately and fold it in at the end — cooked long, the coconut goes rancid by the next day.
method.l: नाल्ल आनी मिरसांग वेगळी वाटात आनी निमाणें भरसात — चड शिजयल्यार नाल्ल दुसऱ्या दिसा वास मारता.

method.en: A mustard and curry leaf tempering in coconut oil over the top.
method.l: वयल्यान नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव आनी कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head, and it is made in the weeks tomato drops to ten rupees a kilo and the crates come in faster than the kitchen can use them.
recipes.why_l: आठ रुपया दर मनशाक. जेन्ना तोमाट धा रुपया किलो जाता आनी रांदणकुडीक वापरूंक जाता ते परस चड पेट्यो येतात, तेदनाच हें करतात.

start.en: Forty minutes on the fire. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: चाळीस मिनटां उज्यार. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 15 L kadhai and a grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: १५ ली. कायल आनी ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Sukya Mirsangechi Chutney
recipes.sub: Dry chilli and coconut, ground thick
recipes.sub_l: सुकी मिरसांग आनी नाल्ल, घट्ट वाटिल्लें

method.en: Use the mild long chilli. A hot variety at this weight will empty the hall and there is no fixing it afterwards.
method.l: लांब सौम्य मिरसांग वापरात. इतल्या वजनाची तिखट जात हॉल रिकामो करतली आनी मागीर कांयच करूंक जावचें ना.

method.en: Soak the chillies in hot water twenty minutes and throw the water — it takes heat away and leaves the colour.
method.l: मिरसांगो हुन उदकांत वीस मिनटां भिजयात आनी तें उदक उडयात — तिखटपण वता, रंग उरता.

method.en: Grind thick enough to hold its shape on a spoon.
method.l: चमच्यार आकार धरतली इतली घट्ट वाटात.

method.en: It keeps four days and gets better on the second.
method.l: चार दीस रावता आनी दुसऱ्या दिसा चड बरी लागता.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head and it needs nothing fresh at all — the chutney the kitchen falls back on in July when the mandi has sent nothing green for two days.
recipes.why_l: नोव रुपया दर मनशाक आनी ताजें कांयच जाय ना — जुलयांत दोन दीस बाजारांतल्यान कांयच हिरवें आयलें ना जाल्यार रांदणकूड हेच चटणेचो आदार घेता.

start.en: Soak twenty minutes, grind. Start one hour before serving.
start.l: वीस मिनटां भिजयात, वाटात. वाडपाआदीं एक वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A grinder and a 10 L pan. One cook.
vessel.l: ग्राइंडर आनी १० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year, and it carries the monsoon.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स, आनी पावसाळो हेच वयल्यान वता.

recipes.name: Varan
recipes.sub: Plain toor dal with ghee

method.en: Varan is the plainest thing on a Goan temple thali and it is deliberately so. There is no masala, no coconut and no tempering beyond ghee and asafoetida.
method.l: वरण हें देवळाच्या ताटांतलें सगळ्यांत साधें आनी तें मुद्दाम अशें. मसालो ना, नाल्ल ना.

method.en: Cook the dal with the turmeric until it falls apart completely, then whisk it smooth with the back of a ladle.
method.l: डाळ हळदीकडेन पुरायपणान शिजयात, मागीर डावाच्या फाटल्यान घोटात.

method.en: Use kokum for the sourness rather than tamarind or lemon. Kokum keeps the varan pale and clean-tasting; tamarind muddies it.
method.l: आंबटपणाक चिंचेपरस कोकम घालात. कोकमान वरण उजळ उरता.

method.en: Add the kokum only in the last ten minutes. Cooked long it turns the dal brown and slightly bitter.
method.l: कोकम निमाण्या धा मिनटांनीं घालात. चड शिजयल्यार डाळ तांबसार आनी कडू जाता.

method.en: Temper only asafoetida and green chilli in ghee — no mustard, no cumin, no curry leaf. A varan is not a dali toy and the difference is the point.
method.l: तुपांत फकत हिंग आनी हिरवी मिरसांग — सांसव ना, जिरें ना, कढीपत्तो ना.

method.en: Keep it thin. It is poured over rice at the start of a meal and a thick varan defeats the purpose.
method.l: पातळ दवरात. तें जेवणाच्या सुरवातीक शिताचेर घालतात.

recipes.why: Deliberately plain, kokum for sourness, and no tempering beyond ghee. It is the first thing on the thali for a reason.
recipes.why_l: मुद्दाम साधें, आंबटपणाक कोकम, आनी तुपाभायर तडको ना.

start.en: Soak the dal one hour. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: डाळ एक वर भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं सत्तर मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The plainest dish on a temple thali.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. देवळाच्या ताटांतलें सगळ्यांत साधें.

recipes.name: Alsande Tonak
recipes.sub: Black-eyed peas in roasted coconut gravy

method.en: Tonak is the roasted-coconut gravy and it is the backbone of Goan Hindu cooking. Everything depends on how far the coconut is roasted.
method.l: तोणाक म्हळ्यार भाजिल्ल्या नाल्लाचो रस, आनी तो गोंयकार हिंदू रांदपाचो कणो. नाल्ल कितलो भाजला तेचेर सगळें आसा.

method.en: Roast the grated coconut in a dry pan on a low flame, stirring constantly, until it is a deep even brown — twenty minutes at least.
method.l: खवयल्लो नाल्ल सुक्या कढयेंत धिम्या उज्यार सतत ढवळून गडद तांबसार जावंक भाजात — किमान वीस मिनटां.

method.en: Deep brown, not golden. An under-roasted coconut gives a pale sweet gravy that is not a tonak at all; a burnt one is bitter and cannot be saved.
method.l: गडद तांबसार, सोनेरी न्हय. उणो भाजल्यार तो तोणाक जायना.

method.en: Roast the whole spices separately and grind everything together with the tamarind to a very fine paste. A gritty tonak is a failed one.
method.l: मसाले वेगळे भाजात आनी चिंचेकडेन सगळें बारीक वाटात. रवाळ तोणाक चुकीचो.

method.en: There is no onion and no garlic in a temple tonak. Asafoetida goes in with the tempering and does that work.
method.l: देवळाच्या तोणकांत कांदो-लसूण ना. हिंग तें काम करता.

method.en: Add the ground paste to the cooked alsande and simmer twenty minutes. Do not boil it hard — a coconut gravy splits at a rolling boil.
method.l: वाटिल्लो मसालो शिजयल्ल्या आळसांद्यांत घालून वीस मिनटां उकडात. जोरान उकडचें न्हय.

recipes.why: Twenty minutes on the coconut, ground fine, and never boiled hard. Those three decide every tonak in this book.
recipes.why_l: नाल्लाचेर वीस मिनटां, बारीक वाटप, आनी जोरान उकडचें न्हय.

start.en: Soak the alsande six hours. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: आळसांदे स वर भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं अडेच वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pressure vessel, a heavy pan and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. प्रेशर आयदन, जड कढई आनी ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The dish a Goan Hindu household makes most often.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. गोंयकार हिंदू घरांत सगळ्यांत चड करतात.

recipes.name: Kulith Usal
recipes.sub: Horsegram with coconut and kokum

method.en: Kulith is horsegram and it is the hardest pulse in this book. Ten hours of soaking is the minimum and a short soak cannot be made up on the fire.
method.l: कुळीथ ह्या पुस्तकांतलें सगळ्यांत घट्ट धान्य. धा वर भिजोवप कमीत कमी.

method.en: Throw the soaking water away and cook in fresh water. The soaking water is bitter and carries most of what makes kulith heavy on the stomach.
method.l: भिजयल्लें उदक उडयात आनी नव्या उदकांत शिजयात.

method.en: Cook until a grain crushes to nothing between finger and thumb. Kulith that is merely soft is not cooked.
method.l: दाणो बोटांमदीं पुरायपणान चिरडपासर शिजयात.

method.en: Roast the coconut only lightly here — pale gold, not the deep brown of a tonak. Kulith is already strong and a dark roast overwhelms it.
method.l: हांगा नाल्ल फकत हळुवार भाजात — सोनेरी, तोणकाभशेन गडद न्हय.

method.en: Add the kokum in the last ten minutes. It cuts the heaviness of the kulith and that is why it is here.
method.l: कोकम निमाण्या धा मिनटांनीं घालात. तें कुळथाचो जडपणा उणो करता.

method.en: Temper mustard, curry leaf and asafoetida in coconut oil and pour it over in the serving vessel rather than the pot.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव, कढीपत्तो आनी हिंग तडतडावन वाडपाच्या आयदनांत घालात.

recipes.why: Ten hours of soaking and a light roast on the coconut. Kulith is a winter pulse and it is treated gently or not at all.
recipes.why_l: धा वर भिजोवप आनी नाल्लाचेर हळुवार भाजप.

start.en: Soak the kulith ten hours — overnight. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: कुळीथ धा वर भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं तीन वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. प्रेशर आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: November to February, in the cold months.

recipes.name: Mooga Usal
recipes.sub: Sprouted moong cooked with coconut

method.en: Sprout the moong a day and a night, rinsing twice a day so it does not sour.
method.l: मूग एक दीस आनी एक रात मोडयात, दिसाक दोन खेपे धुवात जाका करून आंबट जावचे न्हय.

method.en: Cook them just until a sprout crushes between two fingers — an overcooked usal is a ghashi and this is not one.
method.l: दोन बोटां मदीं मोड चिरडटा इतलेंच शिजयात — चड शिजयल्यार ती घशी जाता, आनी ही घशी न्हय.

method.en: Grind the coconut with coriander seed and chilli and put it in at the end.
method.l: नाल्ल धणे आनी मिरसांगेसयत वाटात आनी निमाणें घालात.

method.en: Do not boil after the coconut goes in.
method.l: नाल्ल घाल्या उपरांत उकडूंक नाकात.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head, and five kilos of moong becomes nine kilos on the shelf before a single flame is lit.
recipes.why_l: सोळा रुपया दर मनशाक; उजो पेटयचेआदींच पांच किलो मूग फळयेर नोव किलो जातात.

start.en: Sprout a day and a night. Start thirty hours before serving.
start.l: एक दीस आनी एक रात मोडयात. वाडपाआदीं तीस वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Chana Tonak
recipes.sub: Black chana in a roasted coconut gravy

method.en: Soak the chana overnight and cook it in the same water.
method.l: चणे रातभर भिजयात आनी त्याच उदकांत शिजयात.

method.en: Roast the coconut on a slow flame until it is the colour of wet earth — that colour is the whole difference between a tonak and a ghashi.
method.l: नाल्ल धिम्या उज्यार ओल्या मातयेच्या रंगाचो जासर भाजात — तोणाक आनी घशी मदलो फरक तोच रंग.

method.en: Roast the whole spices with it in the last two minutes.
method.l: निमाण्या दोन मिनटांनी खडे मसाले तातूंत भाजात.

method.en: Grind with tamarind and no water, then let it down with the chana's own stock.
method.l: चिंचेसयत उदक घालनासतना वाटात, मागीर चण्याच्याच रोसान सैल करात.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head. Black chana is the cheapest pulse in the Mapusa market that still eats like a proper tonak with a pao or a sanna.
recipes.why_l: अठरा रुपया दर मनशाक. म्हापशाच्या बाजारांतली सगळ्यांत सवाय कडधान्य, आनी तरी पांव वा सान्ना वांगडा खऱ्या तोणाकाभशेन लागता.

start.en: Soak overnight, roast, grind. Start fourteen hours before serving.
start.l: रातभर भिजयात, भाजात, वाटात. वाडपाआदीं चवदा वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a heavy tawa and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, जड तवो आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Masoor Tonak
recipes.sub: Whole masoor in a dark coconut masala

method.en: Soak the masoor four hours; cooked unsoaked, the skins burst and the tonak goes cloudy.
method.l: मसूर चार वरां भिजयात; भिजयनासतना शिजयल्यार सालीं फुटतात आनी तोणाक गढूळ जाता.

method.en: Crack the teppal open and take the black seed out — the seed is bitter and the husk is what is wanted.
method.l: तिरफळ फोडून भितरली काळी बी काडात — बी कडू आसता, जाय ती फकत साल.

method.en: Roast the coconut dark and grind it with the spices and tamarind.
method.l: नाल्ल गडद भाजात आनी मसाले आनी चिंचेसयत वाटात.

method.en: Simmer twenty minutes after the masala goes in, never boil hard.
method.l: मसालो घाल्या उपरांत वीस मिनटां धिम्या उज्यार, कदींच जोरान उकडूं नाकात.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head. Teppal is what makes a Sanguem tonak a Sanguem tonak, and it grows on the hills behind the village.
recipes.why_l: सत्रा रुपया दर मनशाक. तिरफळ सांगेच्या तोणाकाक सांगेचें तोणाक करता, आनी तें गांवाफाटल्या दोंगरार पिकता.

start.en: Soak four hours, roast, grind. Start six hours before serving.
start.l: चार वरां भिजयात, भाजात, वाटात. वाडपाआदीं स वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a tawa and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, तवो आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: All year. Teppal is picked in June.

recipes.name: Ambat
recipes.sub: Toor dal soured with kokum, thin and hot
recipes.sub_l: कोकमान आंबट केल्ली पातळ आनी तिखट तुरीची दाळ

method.en: Cook the dal with turmeric and no salt until it is soft.
method.l: दाळ हळदीसयत, मीठ घालनासतना, मऊ जासर शिजयात.

method.en: Kokum, not tamarind — this is the sourness Quepem cooks with and the two do not taste alike.
method.l: चिंच न्हय, कोकम — केपें हेच आंबटपणान रांदता आनी दोगांची रूच एक न्हय.

method.en: Grind the coconut with chilli and coriander seed and put it in for the last ten minutes only.
method.l: नाल्ल मिरसांग आनी धण्यांसयत वाटात आनी फकत निमण्या धा मिनटांक घालात.

method.en: Keep it thin — an ambat is drunk off the plate, not eaten with a spoon.
method.l: पातळ दवरात — आंबट ताटांतल्यान पियेतात, चमच्यान खायना.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head and it is the one thing on the plate that makes plain ukde rice go down on a June afternoon.
recipes.why_l: पंदरा रुपया दर मनशाक; जुनाच्या दनपारां सादो उकडो भात हेच वयल्यान पोटांत वता.

start.en: Cook the dal, then the masala. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं दाळ, मागीर मसालो. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot and a grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Vatana Tonak
recipes.sub: Dried white peas in roasted coconut masala
recipes.sub_l: भाजिल्ल्या नाल्ल मसाल्यांत सुके धवे वाटाणे

method.en: Soak the peas ten hours; anything less and they cook to skins on the outside and stone in the middle.
method.l: वाटाणे धा वरां भिजयात; ते परस उणे जाल्यार भायर सालीं आनी मदीं फातर उरता.

method.en: Cook them soft before the masala meets them — a tonak masala will not let a pea soften after it is in.
method.l: मसालो मेळचेआदींच ते मऊ करात — मसालो घाल्या उपरांत वाटाणो मऊ जावंक तोणाक दिना.

method.en: Roast coconut and whole spices dark and grind with tamarind.
method.l: नाल्ल आनी खडे मसाले गडद भाजून चिंचेसयत वाटात.

method.en: Mash a ladle of peas into the gravy; that is the only thickener.
method.l: एक डाव वाटाणे रोसांत कुसकुरात; घट्ट करपाचो तोच एक मार्ग.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head, and dried peas keep six months on the shelf, which is what a monsoon store needs when the mandi is cut off for three days.
recipes.why_l: सोळा रुपया दर मनशाक. सुके वाटाणे फळयेर स म्हयने रावतात — तीन दीस बाजार बंद जाता तेन्ना पावसाळी भंडाराक तेंच जाय.

start.en: Soak ten hours. Start thirteen hours before serving.
start.l: धा वरां भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं तेरा वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a tawa and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, तवो आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The monsoon most of all.

recipes.name: Dali Toy
recipes.sub: Thin moong dal with coconut oil and chilli
recipes.sub_l: नाल्लाचें तेल आनी मिरसांगीकडेन पातळ मुगाची डाळ

method.en: Dali toy is thin moong dal with a coconut oil tempering, and it is on a Goan table more often than any other dish in this book.
method.l: डाळी तोय म्हळ्यार पातळ मुगाची डाळ. गोंयच्या मेजार ती हेर खंयच्याय जिनसापरस चड आसता.

method.en: Wash the moong dal in three changes of water. Moong throws more starch than any other dal and unwashed it foams over the vessel.
method.l: मुगाची डाळ तीन फावटीं धुयात. ती चड फेण करता.

method.en: Cook with the turmeric until it falls apart, then whisk it smooth.
method.l: हळदीकडेन शिजयात आनी घोटात.

method.en: Keep it genuinely thin — twenty litres of water to four kilos of dal. A dali toy is drunk from the bowl as much as eaten with rice.
method.l: खरेंच पातळ दवरात — चार किलो डाळीक वीस लिटर उदक.

method.en: Use coconut oil for the tempering and nothing else. This is the one thing that makes a dali toy Goan rather than a plain dal.
method.l: तडक्याक फकत नाल्लाचें तेल. हेंच तिका गोंयची करता.

method.en: Pour the tempering over the dal in the serving vessel rather than the cooking pot, so it is still fragrant at the counter.
method.l: तडको रांदपाच्या आयदनांत न्हय, वाडपाच्या आयदनांत घालात.

recipes.why: Coconut oil and genuinely thin. Both are what separate a dali toy from an ordinary dal.
recipes.why_l: नाल्लाचें तेल आनी खरेंच पातळ. हेंच तिका साध्या डाळीपसून वेगळें करता.

start.en: No soaking needed. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: भिजोवंक नाका. वाडपाआदीं पन्नास मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a small pan. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी ल्हान कढई. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The dal a Goan household makes without thinking.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. गोंयकार घर विचार करिनासतना हीच करता.

recipes.name: Mooga Ghashi
recipes.sub: Sprouted moong in coconut gravy

method.en: Soak the whole moong overnight, drain thoroughly, and tie it loosely in damp cloth for a further day and a half.
method.l: आख्खे मूग रातभर भिजयात, उदक पुरायपणान काडात, आनी वल्ल्या कापडांत बांदून दीड दीस दवरात.

method.en: Rinse and re-drain twice a day. Sprouts sitting in their own water sour within a day and a soured batch cannot be served.
method.l: दिसाक दोन फावटीं धुवन उदक काडात.

method.en: Four kilos of dry moong becomes about ten of sprouts. Nothing else in this book multiplies like that.
method.l: चार किलो सुक्या मुगाचे धा किलो मोड जातात.

method.en: Roast the coconut to a medium brown — darker than for a kulith usal, lighter than for a tonak. Ghashi sits between the two.
method.l: नाल्ल मध्यम तांबसार भाजात — कुळथापरस गडद, तोणकापरस उणो.

method.en: Grind fine with the tamarind and add to the boiled sprouts. Simmer fifteen minutes and never let it boil hard.
method.l: चिंचेकडेन बारीक वाटात आनी शिजयल्ल्या मोडांत घालात. पंदरा मिनटां उकडात, जोरान न्हय.

method.en: Temper mustard, curry leaf and asafoetida in coconut oil and pour it over at the end.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव, कढीपत्तो आनी हिंग तडतडावन निमाणें घालात.

recipes.why: Four kilos becomes ten, and the coconut roast sits between a usal and a tonak. That middle roast is the whole dish.
recipes.why_l: चार किलोचे धा जातात, आनी नाल्लाचें भाजप मदलें.

start.en: Sprout the moong two days ahead. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: मूग दोन दीस आदीं मोडयात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, a heavy pan and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन, जड कढई आनी ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

recipes.name: Bhaji Bhat
recipes.sub: Rice cooked with whatever greens came in
recipes.sub_l: मेळ्ळी ती भाजी घालून केल्लो भात

method.en: This is not a recipe so much as a method, and it is what a Goan household does with whatever came from the market that morning.
method.l: ही रांदप-रीत, नुस्ती कृती न्हय. त्या सकाळीं बाजारांतल्यान जें आयलें तें ह्या पद्दतीन करतात.

method.en: Alsande leaves, amaranth, taro leaf, drumstick leaf and radish greens all work. Keep the tender and the tough separate.
method.l: आळसांद्याचीं पानां, तांबडी भाजी, आळूचीं पानां, शेवग्याचीं पानां — सगळीं चलतात.

method.en: Wash in three changes of water. Greens grown in a Goan monsoon come in with a great deal of grit.
method.l: तीन फावटीं धुयात. पावसाळ्यांतल्या भाजयेंत माती चड आसता.

method.en: Temper mustard, curry leaf and asafoetida in coconut oil first, then add the tough greens and fry them four minutes.
method.l: पयलीं नाल्लाच्या तेलांत तडको करात, मागीर घट्ट भाजी घालून चार मिनटां परतात.

method.en: Add the rice and water and cook until the grains are soft. Add the tender greens only in the last five minutes.
method.l: तांदूळ आनी उदक घालात. मोव भाजी निमाण्या पांच मिनटांनीं घालात.

method.en: Stir the fresh grated coconut in off the fire. Cooked in, coconut goes stringy and grey.
method.l: उजो बंद करून खवयल्लो नाल्ल भरसात. शिजयल्यार तो रेशेदार जाता.

recipes.why: Costs almost nothing, uses what would otherwise be thrown, and the coconut goes in off the fire.
recipes.why_l: सवाय, उडोवपाचें वापरता, आनी नाल्ल उजो बंद करून घालतात.

start.en: Wash the greens three times. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: भाजी तीन फावटीं धुयात. वाडपाआदीं पन्नास मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ५० ली. जड आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year with whatever the market gave.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स, बाजारांत जें मेळटा तें.

recipes.name: Tambdi Bhaji
recipes.sub: Red amaranth cooked with coconut

method.en: Wash the leaves in four changes of water — this grows on wet mud and one gritty mouthful ends the dish.
method.l: पानां चार खेपे उदक बदलून धुवात — ही ओल्या चिखलांत उगता आनी एक रेंवाळ घांस सगळें सोंपयता.

method.en: Cook the thick stalks five minutes before the leaves go in.
method.l: पानां घालचेआदीं जाड देंठ पांच मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Add no water at all; the leaves give up more than the vessel needs.
method.l: उदक मात घालचें न्हय; पानांच आयदनाक जाय ते परस चड सोडटात.

method.en: Coconut at the end and no boiling after it.
method.l: नाल्ल निमाणें, आनी ते उपरांत उकडप ना.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head. Tambdi bhaji is ten rupees a bundle in the monsoon and the iron in it is why the kitchen cooks it twice a week, not once.
recipes.why_l: सात रुपया दर मनशाक. पावसाळ्यांत तांबडी भाजी धा रुपया जुडी मेळटा, आनी तातूंतल्या लोखणाखातीरच रांदणकूड ती सप्तकाक एक न्हय, दोन खेपे रांदता.

start.en: Wash well, then twenty minutes on the fire. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: बरी धुवात, मागीर वीस मिनटां उज्यार. वाडपाआदीं सत्तर मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot and four hands at the wash trough. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी धुवपाच्या टांकयेर चार हात. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kelphula Bhaji
recipes.sub: Banana flower cleaned and cooked dry

method.en: Rub coconut oil on the hands before the cleaning starts — the sap stains black and will not wash off for two days.
method.l: निवळावंक सुरू करचेआदीं हातांक नाल्लाचें तेल लायात — चिकाचो काळो डाग दोन दीस वता ना.

method.en: Take the hard stalk and the plastic-like sheath out of every floret; that is the whole labour of the dish.
method.l: दर फुलांतलो घट्ट देंठ आनी प्लास्टिकावरी पातळ पडदो काडात; सगळें कष्ट तेंच.

method.en: Drop the cut pieces into water with tamarind in it or they go black in minutes.
method.l: कातरिल्ले कुडके चिंचेच्या उदकांत घालात, ना जाल्यार मिनटांनी काळे जातात.

method.en: Cook dry with coconut and finish with jaggery.
method.l: नाल्लासयत सुकी रांदात आनी गोड घालून सोंपयात.

recipes.why: Six rupees a head. The flower is cut off the temple's own banana stand and thrown away everywhere else in Goa because of the hour it takes to clean.
recipes.why_l: स रुपया दर मनशाक. हें फूल देवळाच्याच केळींतल्यान मेळटा; निवळावंक एक वर लागता म्हूण गोंयांत हेर सगळेकडेन तें उडयतात.

start.en: An hour of cleaning before any fire. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: उजो पेटयचेआदीं एक वर निवळावप. वाडपाआदीं अडेच वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai and four hands with knives. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल आनी सुऱ्यांसयत चार हात. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Fansa Bikanchi Bhaji
recipes.sub: Jackfruit seeds cooked in coconut masala

method.en: Dry the seeds in the sun two days after the jackfruit is eaten — the white skin peels off by itself then.
method.l: फणस खाल्ल्या उपरांत बियो दोन दीस उन्हांत सुकयात — तेदनाच धवी साल आपशीच सुटता.

method.en: Peel both skins; the brown one under the white is bitter.
method.l: दोनूय सालीं काडात; धवे सकयली तांबडी साल कडू आसता.

method.en: Halve the big seeds so they cook in the same time as the small.
method.l: व्हड बियो अर्द्यो करात जाका करून धाकट्यां वांगडा एकाच वेळार शिजतात.

method.en: Boil twenty-five minutes before the masala goes in — a half-cooked jackfruit seed is like a stone.
method.l: मसालो घालचेआदीं पंचवीस मिनटां उकडात — अर्दी शिजिल्ली बी फातराभशेन आसता.

recipes.why: Six rupees a head out of what the kitchen throws away every June. Eight kilos of seed comes off a hundred jackfruit the hall has already eaten.
recipes.why_l: दर जुनांत रांदणकूड जें उडयता तातूंतल्यान स रुपया दर मनशाक. पंगतीन खाल्ल्या शंबर फणसांतल्यान आठ किलो बियो मेळटात.

start.en: Dry two days, peel, boil. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: दोन दीस सुकयात, सालीं काडात, उकडात. वाडपाआदीं तीन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Dudhi Bhaji
recipes.sub: Bottle gourd with moong dal, cooked thin
recipes.sub_l: मुगाच्या दाळीसयत पातळ शिजयल्ली दुदयेची भाजी

method.en: Taste a slice of every gourd before it is cut in — a bitter one does not merely taste bad, it makes the hall ill.
method.l: दर दुदयेची एक चाक कापचेआदीं चाकात — कडू दुदयो फकत वायट लागना, ती पंगत दुयेंती करता.

method.en: Cook the moong dal first and keep it grainy, not mashed.
method.l: मुगाची दाळ पयलीं शिजयात आनी कण उरचे अशी दवरात, कुसकुरची न्हय.

method.en: The gourd needs eight minutes and no water beyond what clings to it after washing.
method.l: दुदयेक आठ मिनटां जाय आनी धुतल्या उपरांत तिचेर उरिल्ल्या उदका भायर कांयच नाका.

method.en: Coconut and cumin ground together, folded in off the fire.
method.l: नाल्ल आनी जिरें एकठांय वाटात, उजो पालवून भरसात.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head, and a devotee off a fast or out of the sick room can eat this when nothing else on the counter will sit right.
recipes.why_l: आठ रुपया दर मनशाक. उपास सोडिल्लो वा दुयेंस भोगून उठिल्लो भक्त हें खावंक शकता, जेन्ना काउंटरार दुसरें कांयच सोंसना.

start.en: Cook the dal first. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं दाळ शिजयात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot and a grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Papai Bhaji
recipes.sub: Raw papaya grated and cooked with mustard

method.en: Grate rather than dice — grated papaya cooks in six minutes and diced takes twenty.
method.l: कुडके करचे परस किसात — किसिल्ली पपय स मिनटांनी शिजता, कुडक्यांक वीस लागतात.

method.en: Let the milky sap drain in a colander ten minutes before it goes in the pan.
method.l: आयदनांत घालचेआदीं धवो चीक चाळणींत धा मिनटां देंवचो दियात.

method.en: Cook it fast on a high flame and stop while it still has bite.
method.l: व्हड उज्यार बेगीन रांदात आनी चाबूंक येता तेदनाच थांबात.

method.en: Lime at the counter, never in the vessel.
method.l: लिंबू वाडपाच्या जाग्यार, आयदनांत कदींच न्हय.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head. Every quarters compound in Quepem has a papaya tree and the green fruit that will not ripen before the rains is free.
recipes.why_l: सात रुपया दर मनशाक. केपेंच्या दर वसतयेंत पपयेचें झाड आसा, आनी पावसाआदीं जें फळ पिकना तें फुकट.

start.en: Grate and drain. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: किसात आनी चीक देंवचो दियात. वाडपाआदीं पन्नास मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai and two graters. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल आनी दोन किसण्यो. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kuttu ki Puri
recipes.sub: Buckwheat puri for fasting days

method.en: Buckwheat has no gluten, so the dough has nothing holding it together. Boiled mashed potato does that job — roughly one part potato to two of flour.
method.l: कुट्टूंत ग्लुटेन ना. उकडिल्लो बटाट तें काम करता — एक वांटो बटाट, दोन वांटे पीठ.

method.en: Use cold boiled potato, grated rather than mashed, so no lumps go into the dough.
method.l: थंड उकडिल्लो बटाट किसात, कुसकरचो न्हय.

method.en: Knead with as little water as possible, greasing the palms with ghee. The dough must be firm; a soft kuttu dough cannot be rolled.
method.l: उदक थोडेंच घालून, हातांक तूप लावन मळात. पीठ घट्ट जाय.

method.en: Do not let it stand. Kuttu dough turns slack within twenty minutes, so roll and fry as you go.
method.l: दवरचें न्हय. कुट्टूचें पीठ वीस मिनटांनीं ढिलें जाता.

method.en: Roll between two greased sheets rather than on a floured board.
method.l: पिठाच्या पोळपाटार न्हय, तेल लायिल्ल्या दोन कागदांमदीं लाटात.

method.en: Fry in medium-hot ghee. Kuttu browns faster than wheat and needs a lower flame than an ordinary puri.
method.l: मध्यम तापिल्ल्या तुपांत तळात. कुट्टू बेगीन तांबसार जाता.

recipes.why: The dough is the whole difficulty. Get the potato proportion right and the frying is ordinary.
recipes.why_l: सगळें कठीण तें पीठ. बटाट्याचें प्रमाण बरोबर जाल्यार तळप सादें.

start.en: Boil and cool the potatoes first. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं बटाट उकडून थंड करात.

vessel.en: Two deep kadhais and a rolling board. Three cooks.
vessel.l: दोन खोल कढयो आनी पोळपाट. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Samak ke Chawal
recipes.sub: Barnyard millet cooked like rice

method.en: Rinse the samak and drain it well, then let it stand twenty minutes. Wet grain in hot ghee steams and turns the vessel sticky.
method.l: समक धुवन उदक काडात आनी वीस मिनटां दवरात.

method.en: Use two parts water to one of grain, not three. Samak swells more and takes less water than it looks.
method.l: एका वांट्या समकाक दोन वांटे उदक, तीन न्हय.

method.en: Temper the cumin in ghee, add the ginger and chilli, then the drained samak and fry two minutes.
method.l: तुपांत जिरें घालात, आलें आनी मिरसांग घालात, मागीर समक दोन मिनटां परतात.

method.en: Add water and rock salt, bring to a boil, cover, and cook twelve minutes on the lowest flame.
method.l: उदक आनी सैंधव घालून उकडात, झांपात, धिम्या उज्यार बारा मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Rest ten minutes with the lid on before opening. Stirred hot, samak becomes paste faster than any rice.
method.l: उगडचेआदीं झांपून धा मिनटां दवरात.

method.en: Fork through the crushed peanut, coriander and lemon just before serving.
method.l: वाडचेआदीं शेंगदाणे, कोथिंबीर आनी लिंब भरसात.

recipes.why: Twelve minutes and it feeds a fasting hall. The only trap is treating it like rice and drowning it.
recipes.why_l: बारा मिनटांनीं तयार. शीत समजून उदक चड घालप ही एकच चूक.

start.en: Rinse and drain twenty minutes before cooking.
start.l: शिजोवचेआदीं वीस मिनटां धुवन उदक काडात.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: घट्ट झांपणेचें ३० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Vrat ke Aloo
recipes.sub: Potato with cumin and rock salt

method.en: Boil the potatoes the day before and chill them. Cold potato breaks into clean pieces; warm potato mashes at a touch.
method.l: बटाट आदल्या दिसा उकडून थंड करात. थंड बटाट निवळ फोडींनीं मोडटा.

method.en: Break them by hand rather than cutting — torn faces hold the tempering.
method.l: कापचे न्हय, हातान मोडात — मोडिल्ली कूस मसालो धरता.

method.en: Temper a generous quantity of cumin in ghee. On a fasting day there is no asafoetida, so cumin carries the dish alone.
method.l: तुपांत भरपूर जिरें घालात. उपासाच्या दिसा हिंग ना.

method.en: Add the ginger and green chilli, then the chopped tomato, and cook until it collapses.
method.l: आलें आनी मिरसांग घालात, मागीर टोमॅटो, आनी तो मोडपासर शिजयात.

method.en: Add the potato with rock salt and crushed pepper and turn with a flat ladle rather than stirring.
method.l: बटाट, सैंधव आनी मिरीं घालात आनी ढवळचेबदला सपाट डावान परतात.

method.en: Add a little hot water if it looks dry and finish with coriander and lemon off the fire.
method.l: सुकें दिसल्यार थोडें गरम उदक घालात, उजो बंद करून कोथिंबीर आनी लिंब घालात.

recipes.why: Rock salt only, no asafoetida, and cumin doing all the work.
recipes.why_l: फकत सैंधव, हिंग ना, आनी सगळें काम जिऱ्याचें.

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before.
start.l: बटाट आदल्या सांजेक उकडात.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: रुंद ३० ली. कढई. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Singhare ka Halwa
recipes.sub: Water chestnut flour halwa

method.en: Roast the singhara flour in ghee on a low flame for a full thirty minutes. It is heavier than semolina and takes longer to lose its raw smell.
method.l: शिंगाड्याचें पीठ तुपांत धिम्या उज्यार पुराय तीस मिनटां भाजात.

method.en: It is ready when it turns pinkish-brown and smells sweet. Under-roasted it tastes chalky and sits heavy.
method.l: तें गुलाबी-तांबसार जावन गोड वास येता तेन्ना तयार.

method.en: Stir constantly. Singhara flour is fine and catches on the bottom faster than semolina.
method.l: सतत ढवळात. तें रव्यापरस बेगीन बुडाक लागता.

method.en: Boil the water and sugar separately and keep the syrup at a rolling boil.
method.l: उदक आनी साकर वेगळी उकडात आनी उकडटच दवरात.

method.en: Pour the boiling syrup into the roasted flour and stand back. Syrup that is not boiling lumps the halwa instantly.
method.l: उकडटो पाक भाजिल्ल्या पिठांत घालात आनी फाटीं सरात.

method.en: Stir until the ghee separates, then fold in cardamom and nuts and cover five minutes off the fire.
method.l: तूप वेगळें जावपासर ढवळात, मागीर येलचीं आनी बदाम घालून उजो बंद करून पांच मिनटां झांपात.

recipes.why: The fasting sweet that does not feel like a compromise, provided the flour is properly roasted.
recipes.why_l: पीठ बरें भाजल्यार उपासाचें गोड उणें दिसना.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: भिजोवंक ना. वाडपाआदीं साठ मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: रुंद ४० ली. कढई. एक रांदपी, जो सोडिना.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
recipes.sub: Sago with peanut and coconut

method.en: Soak the sago in water level with the grain, never above — a finger of extra water and the whole vessel is paste.
method.l: साबूदाणो दाण्याच्या बरोबरीन उदकांत भिजयात, वयर कदींच न्हय — एक बोट चड उदक आनी आख्खें आयदन लापशी.

method.en: Five hours; a grain pressed between two fingers should crush with no white centre.
method.l: पांच वरां; दोन बोटां मदीं दाबल्यार मदीं धवें उरचें न्हय.

method.en: Roast and crush the peanut coarse — the powder coats the grains and keeps them apart.
method.l: शेंगदाणे भाजून जाडसर कुटात — तें पीठ दाण्यांक लागता आनी ते एकठांय चिकटनात.

method.en: Ten minutes covered on a low flame, no more.
method.l: धिम्या उज्यार धांपून धा मिनटां, ते परस चड न्हय.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees a head and it fills where a plate of fruit does not. What goes out at noon on Ekadashi to people with a day's work still ahead.
recipes.why_l: एकुणीस रुपया दर मनशाक; फळांचें ताट जें करूंक शकना तें हें करता. एकादशीक दनपारां जांकां दिसभर काम आसा तांकां हेंच वता.

start.en: Soak five hours. Start six hours before serving.
start.l: पांच वरां भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं स वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai and a wide tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल आनी रुंद ताट. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Falahari Kadhi
recipes.sub: Curd thickened with water chestnut flour
recipes.sub_l: शिंगाड्याच्या पिठान घट्ट केल्ली दंयची कढी

method.en: Whisk the flour into cold curd and strain the mix — singhare flour lumps harder than besan.
method.l: पीठ थंड दंयांत घुसळात आनी गाळात — शिंगाड्याचें पीठ बेसनापरस चड गुठळ्यो करता.

method.en: Bring it up stirring one way and do not cover it until it has boiled once.
method.l: एकाच वटेन घुसळत उकडात आनी एक उकड येसर धांपूंक नाकात.

method.en: Thirty minutes on a low flame; the raw taste of the flour needs that long to leave.
method.l: धिम्या उज्यार तीस मिनटां; पिठाचो कच्चो सवाद वचूंक तितलो वेळ लागता.

method.en: The ghee tempering goes on at the counter.
method.l: तुपाची फोडणी वाडपाच्या जाग्यार घालात.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head from curd that has already turned, and on a fast day it is the one hot liquid on the tray.
recipes.why_l: आंबट जाल्ल्या दंयांतल्यान सोळा रुपया दर मनशाक; आनी उपासाच्या दिसा ताटांतलो एकूच हुनसाण पदार्थ.

start.en: Forty minutes on the fire. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: चाळीस मिनटां उज्यार. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot and a whisk. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी घुसळणी. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Rajgira Laddu
recipes.sub: Puffed amaranth bound with jaggery

method.en: Melt the jaggery to the hard-ball stage: a drop in cold water must set and snap.
method.l: गोड घट्ट पाकांत विरगळायात: थंड उदकांत घाल्ल्या थेंब्यान घट्ट जावन कडकडूंक जाय.

method.en: Take it off the fire before mixing — jaggery held on the flame with the grain in it turns the laddu to a rock.
method.l: भरसचेआदीं उज्यावयल्यान काडात — दाणे घालून उज्यार दवरल्यार लाडू फातर जाता.

method.en: Roll while it is too hot to hold comfortably; a wet palm makes that possible.
method.l: हातांत धरूंक जाता ते परस चड हुनसाण आसतनाच वळयात; ओली तळी हातान तें जमता.

method.en: Cool completely before the tin is shut.
method.l: डबो धांपचेआदीं सामकें थंड करात.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head and it keeps three weeks in a tin, which means the Ekadashi sweet is made once a month and not twice.
recipes.why_l: चवदा रुपया दर मनशाक आनी डब्यांत तीन सप्तकां रावता; म्हळ्यार एकादशीची गोडशी म्हयन्याक एकदाच करची पडटा, दोनदा न्हय.

start.en: Thirty minutes of work. Make a day ahead.
start.l: तीस मिनटांचें काम. एक दीस आदीं करात.

vessel.en: A heavy kadhai and a greased stone. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जड कायल आनी तेल लायिल्लो फातर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Sabudana Nariyal Kheer
recipes.sub: Sago simmered in coconut milk with jaggery

method.en: Take the first pressing of the coconut separately and hold it back for the end.
method.l: नाल्लाचो पयलो रोस वेगळो काडात आनी निमाण्याक दवरात.

method.en: Cook the sago in the thin second and third pressings until every pearl is clear.
method.l: दुसऱ्या आनी तिसऱ्या पातळ रोसांत साबूदाणो दर दाणो पारदर्शक जासर शिजयात.

method.en: Strained jaggery off the fire; boiled into coconut milk it splits.
method.l: गोड गाळून उजो पालवून घालात; नाल्लाच्या दुदांत उकडल्यार तें फुटता.

method.en: The first pressing goes in last and is never boiled.
method.l: पयलो रोस निमाणें घालात आनी तो कदींच उकडचो न्हय.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees a head, and it is the Ekadashi sweet a devotee who takes no milk can eat — which on this shelf is the only one.
recipes.why_l: चोवीस रुपया दर मनशाक; दूद घेवंक नाशिल्लो भक्त खावंक शकता अशी एकादशीची एकूच गोडशी ह्या फळयेर आसा.

start.en: Press the coconut fresh. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: नाल्लाचो रोस ताजो काडात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot, a grinder and muslin. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन, ग्राइंडर आनी मलमल. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Vade
recipes.sub: Fried rice and dal puri

method.en: Vade are the fried bread that goes with a tonak, and the two are almost never served apart in Goa.
method.l: वडे आनी तोणाक हीं दोनूय गोंयांत वेगळीं वाडिनांत.

method.en: Soak the rice and both dals together three hours and grind coarse with the coconut. This dough is ground, not kneaded from flour.
method.l: तांदूळ आनी दोनूय डाळी तीन वर भिजयात आनी नाल्लाकडेन जाडसर दळात.

method.en: Grind with as little water as the machine will take. A wet dough cannot be rolled and vade cannot be rescued once the dough is loose.
method.l: ग्राइंडर घेता तितलेंच उदक. वल्लें पीठ लाटूंक येना.

method.en: Roll on a lightly oiled sheet rather than a floured board. Loose flour burns in the kadhai and darkens the oil within two batches.
method.l: पिठाच्या पोळपाटार न्हय, तेल लायिल्ल्या कागदार लाटात.

method.en: Roll thick — about twice a puri. A vade is meant to be substantial and a thin one goes hard within minutes.
method.l: जाड लाटात — पुरयेपरस दुप्पट.

method.en: Fry in hot oil, pressing lightly so it puffs, and drain on mesh.
method.l: गरम तेलांत तळात, हळुवार दामून फुगयात, आनी जाळयेर काडात.

recipes.why: Ground, not kneaded, and rolled thick. Both are what make a vade rather than a puri.
recipes.why_l: दळिल्लें, मळिल्लें न्हय, आनी जाड. हेंच वडो करता.

start.en: Soak and grind three hours ahead. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: तीन वर आदीं भिजयात आनी दळात.

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: तीन खोल कढयो आनी दोन पोळपाट. चार रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kele Phodi
recipes.sub: Raw banana slices fried in semolina

method.en: Phodi means slices fried in a semolina coat, and it is the Goan way with almost any firm vegetable.
method.l: फोडी म्हळ्यार रव्यांत घोळावन तळिल्ल्यो चकत्यो — गोंयांत सगळ्या घट्ट भाजयेक हीच रीत.

method.en: Peel and slice the banana into thick rounds and put them straight into salted water, or they blacken within a minute.
method.l: केळीं सोलून जाड चकत्यो करात आनी मिठाच्या उदकांत घालात, न्हय जाल्यार तीं काळीं जातात.

method.en: Rub the slices with turmeric, chilli and salt and leave them thirty minutes. This draws the water out and is what lets the coat stick.
method.l: चकत्यांक हळद, तिखें आनी मीठ लावन तीस मिनटां दवरात.

method.en: Pat each slice dry before coating. A wet slice sheds its semolina in the oil and the pan fills with grit.
method.l: घोळावचेआदीं दर चकती सुकयात.

method.en: Use fine semolina with a quarter part rice flour. Semolina alone falls off; rice flour is what holds it on.
method.l: बारीक रवो आनी चवथो वांटो तांदळाचें पीठ. फकत रवो सुटटा.

method.en: Shallow-fry in coconut oil, not deep-fry, turning once. A phodi is fried flat in a little oil and that is the whole difference.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत उथळ तळात, एकदाच परतात.

recipes.why: Salt first, dry second, coat third. Skip any one and the semolina ends up in the pan.
recipes.why_l: पयलीं मीठ, मागीर सुकोवप, मागीर घोळप.

start.en: Salt the slices thirty minutes ahead. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: फोडींक तीस मिनटां आदीं मीठ लावात.

vessel.en: Three shallow pans. Three cooks.
vessel.l: तीन उथळ कढयो. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Neerphanas Phodi
recipes.sub: Breadfruit slices fried in semolina

method.en: Oil the knife and the hands before cutting. Breadfruit bleeds a sticky white latex that sets like glue on a dry blade and does not wash off.
method.l: कापचेआदीं कातयाक आनी हातांक तेल लावात. नीरफणसांतलो चीक डिंकाभशेन घट्ट जाता.

method.en: Wipe the blade with oil again every few fruit. The latex builds up and after four or five the knife stops cutting cleanly.
method.l: दर चार-पांच फळांक कातयो परत तेलान पुसात.

method.en: Cut into thick slices and put them straight into salted water. Breadfruit browns faster than banana.
method.l: जाड चकत्यो करून मिठाच्या उदकांत घालात.

method.en: Rub with turmeric, chilli and salt and leave thirty minutes, then pat each slice dry before coating.
method.l: हळद, तिखें आनी मीठ लावन तीस मिनटां दवरात, मागीर सुकयात.

method.en: Breadfruit is denser than banana and needs a lower flame and longer in the pan — about four minutes a side.
method.l: नीरफणस केळ्यापरस घट्ट. धिमो उजो आनी दर वटेन चार मिनटां जाय.

method.en: Test one before the batch goes out. An undercooked breadfruit slice is chalky in the middle and there is no telling from the outside.
method.l: खेप भायर वचचेआदीं एक चाकात. उणी शिजिल्ली फोड भितर कच्ची उरता.

recipes.why: Oil the knife or the latex wins. Four months a year, and nothing else in Goa fries like it.
recipes.why_l: कातयाक तेल लावात, न्हय जाल्यार चीक जिखता.

start.en: Salt the slices thirty minutes ahead. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: फोडींक तीस मिनटां आदीं मीठ लावात.

vessel.en: Three shallow pans and an oiled knife. Three cooks.
vessel.l: तीन उथळ कढयो आनी तेल लायिल्लो कातयो. तीन रांदपी.

season.en: March to July, while the breadfruit is on the tree.
season.l: मार्च ते जुलय, नीरफणस झाडार आसतना.

recipes.name: Vaingan Phodi
recipes.sub: Brinjal slices in rice flour and chilli
recipes.sub_l: तांदळाच्या पिठांत आनी मिरसांगेंत वांयगणाच्यो चाकयो

method.en: Cut rounds a finger thick — thinner and they go limp, thicker and the middle stays raw.
method.l: एक बोट जाड चाकयो कातरात — पातळ जाल्यो जाल्यार त्यो निबर जातात, जाड जाल्यो जाल्यार मदीं कच्च्यो उरतात.

method.en: Rub salt, turmeric and chilli on and leave them fifteen minutes.
method.l: मीठ, हळद आनी मिरसांग लावन पंदरा मिनटां दवरात.

method.en: Press each slice into the rice flour and semolina mix on both faces just before it goes into the oil.
method.l: तेलांत घालचेआदीं दर चाकी तांदळाचें पीठ आनी रुलांवाच्या मिश्रणांत दोनूय वटांनी दाबात.

method.en: Fry in coconut oil on a medium flame; groundnut oil gives a phodi that could have come from anywhere.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत मध्यम उज्यार तळात; शेंगदाण्याच्या तेलांतली फोडी खंयचीय जावंक शकता.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head. Brinjal is twenty rupees a kilo through the winter and this is the plate the hall reaches for before the sabji.
recipes.why_l: बारा रुपया दर मनशाक. थंडेंत वांयगणां वीस रुपया किलो, आनी पंगत भाजयेआदीं हेच ताटाक हात घालता.

start.en: Salt fifteen minutes, then fry. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: पंदरा मिनटां मीठ लावात, मागीर तळात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: Two frying kadhais and a slotted ladle. Three cooks.
vessel.l: दोन तळपाच्यो कायली आनी झारो. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Mirsangechim Bhajjim
recipes.sub: Stuffed banana chillies in gram flour

method.en: Use the fat pale banana chilli. A hot variety at eight kilos sends the whole hall to the water drum.
method.l: जाड फिक्कट केळी मिरसांगच वापरात. आठ किलो तिखट जात आख्खी पंगत उदकाच्या ड्रमाकडेन धाडटली.

method.en: Slit along one side and take the seed out with a spoon.
method.l: एके वटेन चीर मारात आनी चमच्यान बियो काडात.

method.en: Stuff with coconut, cumin and amchur — a bhajji stuffed this way needs no chutney.
method.l: नाल्ल, जिरें आनी आमसूल पिठान भरात — अशी भरिल्ली भजी चटणेवीण खावंक जाता.

method.en: The batter should coat a finger and drip slowly; thin batter slides off in the oil.
method.l: पीठ बोटाक लागून सवकास देंवचें; पातळ पीठ तेलांत सुटून वता.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head and it is what sells at the gate on a wet July evening faster than anything else the kitchen fries.
recipes.why_l: पंदरा रुपया दर मनशाक; जुलयाचे भिजिल्ले सांजवेळार रांदणकुडींत तळिल्ल्या हेर सगळ्यां परस हेंच बेगीन दारार सोंपता.

start.en: Stuff, then fry. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: भरात, मागीर तळात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: Two kadhais and a stuffing table. Four cooks.
vessel.l: दोन कायली आनी भरपाची मेज. चार रांदपी.

recipes.name: Batata Vade
recipes.sub: Spiced potato balls in a gram flour coat

method.en: Boil the potatoes the day before and keep them cold; a warm filling will not hold a ball.
method.l: बटाटे एक दीस आदीं उकडून थंड दवरात; हुनसाण भरणीचो गोळो बांदना.

method.en: Temper mustard, curry leaf, ginger and chilli in oil and fold the potato in off the fire.
method.l: तेलांत सांसव, कढीपत्तो, आलें आनी मिरसांगेची फोडणी करात आनी उजो पालवून बटाटो भरसात.

method.en: Lime in the filling, not in the batter.
method.l: लिंबू भरणेंत, पिठांत न्हय.

method.en: Fry in oil hot enough that the vada rises in four seconds; cooler and it drinks oil.
method.l: तेल इतलें तापयात की वडो चार सेकंदांनी वयर येता; थंड आसल्यार तो तेल पियेता.
