recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head and two hundred of them come off one kadhai in forty minutes, which is what a Sunday gate needs.
recipes.why_l: चवदा रुपया दर मनशाक आनी एका कायलींतल्यान चाळीस मिनटांनी दोनशें वडे भायर येतात — आयतारच्या दाराक तेंच जाय.

start.en: Boil the potato a day ahead. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: बटाटे एक दीस आदीं उकडात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai and a rolling table. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल आनी वळपाची मेज. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Phov Chivdo
recipes.sub: Beaten rice fried with cashew and curry leaf

method.en: Dry the thin poha on a low flame or in the sun before anything else — damp poha will not crisp in oil, it will only soften.
method.l: हेर कांय करचेआदीं पातळ फोव धिम्या उज्यार वा उन्हांत सुकयात — ओले फोव तेलांत करकरीत जायनात, फकत मऊ जातात.

method.en: Fry the cashew, peanut, coconut and curry leaf separately and keep each aside.
method.l: काजू, शेंगदाणे, नाल्ल आनी कढीपत्तो वेगवेगळे तळात आनी वेगळे दवरात.

method.en: Turmeric and asafoetida go into the hot oil, then the poha, for under a minute.
method.l: हळद आनी हिंग हुन तेलांत, मागीर फोव, एका मिनटा भितर.

method.en: Cool completely before the tin is shut or the whole batch goes soft overnight.
method.l: डबो धांपचेआदीं सामकें थंड करात, ना जाल्यार आख्खो चिवडो रातभरांत निबर जाता.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head and it keeps three weeks. What is handed to the men on the night shift and what travels with a party going out to a village program.
recipes.why_l: वीस रुपया दर मनशाक आनी तीन सप्तकां रावता. रातपाळेच्या मनशांक हेंच दितात, आनी गांवच्या कार्यावळीक वचपी पंगडा वांगडा हेंच वता.

start.en: Dry the poha first. Start two hours before packing.
start.l: पयलीं फोव सुकयात. भरचेआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai, a slotted ladle and tins. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल, झारो आनी डबे. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kelyachim Chips
recipes.sub: Raw banana sliced thin and fried in coconut oil
recipes.sub_l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत तळिल्ल्यो कच्च्या केळ्याच्यो बारीक चाकयो

method.en: Slice straight into the hot oil off a mandoline held over the kadhai — slices left standing in water come out pale and soft.
method.l: कायलीवयर धरिल्ल्या किसणेंतल्यान सरळ हुन तेलांत चाकयो सोडात — उदकांत दवरिल्ल्यो चाकयो फिक्क्यो आनी मऊ भायर येतात.

method.en: Salt and turmeric dissolved in a little water, flicked into the oil in the last ten seconds.
method.l: मीठ आनी हळद थोड्या उदकांत विरगळावन निमण्या धा सेकंदांनी तेलांत शिंपडात.

method.en: Stand back when it goes in; the oil will spit.
method.l: तें घालतना फाटीं सरात; तेल उडटलें.

method.en: Drain standing on edge in a wide tray, never heaped.
method.l: रुंद ताटांत उबीं दवरून तेल देंवचें दियात, कदींच रास करूं नाकात.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees a head. The plantation behind the guest house gives forty kilos of green banana a month that will not ripen evenly enough to serve as fruit.
recipes.why_l: तेरा रुपया दर मनशाक. सोयऱ्यांच्या घरा फाटली बागायत म्हयन्याक चाळीस किलो हिरवीं केळीं दिता, जीं सारकीं पिकनात म्हूण फळ म्हूण वाडूंक जायनात.

start.en: Fry the same morning. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: त्याच सकाळीं तळात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai, a mandoline and wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल, किसणी आनी रुंद ताटां. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Aamsol
recipes.sub: Salt-cured kokum rinds

method.en: Aamsol is the salt-cured kokum rind, and it is the souring agent behind nearly every dish in this book.
method.l: आमसोल म्हळ्यार मिठांत मुरयल्ली कोकमाची साल. ह्या पुस्तकांतल्या सगळ्या आंबटपणा फाटल्यान तीच.

method.en: Halve the fruit and squeeze the pulp and seeds out, keeping only the rind. The pulp is used fresh or made into syrup; the rind is what is cured.
method.l: फळ अर्दें करून गर आनी बीयो काडात, फकत साल दवरात.

method.en: Rub the rinds with salt and leave them overnight. They will release a deep purple liquid.
method.l: सालींक मीठ लावन रातभर दवरात. जांबळें उदक सुटतलें.

method.en: Dry them in full sun by day and return them to their own liquid at night. Repeat this for three weeks.
method.l: दिसा उन्हांत सुकयात आनी रातीं परत त्याच उदकांत घालात. तीन सप्तकां अशें करात.

method.en: That soak-and-dry cycle is the whole method. Rinds simply dried in the sun go pale and brittle and lose most of their sourness.
method.l: भिजोवप आनी सुकोवप हीच सगळी रीत. फकत उन्हांत सुकयल्यो सालीं फिकट जातात.

method.en: They are ready when the rind is dark, leathery and still slightly damp to the touch. Store in a dry jar and they keep a full year.
method.l: साल गडद, चिवट आनी थोडीशी वल्ली उरता तेन्ना तयार. वर्सभर उरता.

recipes.why: Twenty kilos of a three-week fruit turned into a year of sourness. The soak-and-dry cycle cannot be shortened.
recipes.why_l: तीन सप्तकांच्या फळाचे वीस किलो वर्सभराचें आंबटपण जालें.

start.en: A three-week sun cure. Made in May and used all year.
start.l: तीन सप्तकां उन्हांत. मे म्हयन्यांत करतात.

vessel.en: Drying trays and a 20 L jar. One cook, twenty minutes a day.
vessel.l: सुकोवपाच्यो ट्रे आनी २० ली. बरणी. एक रांदपी.

season.en: May only, when the kokum is picked.

recipes.name: Tendli Loncho
recipes.sub: Ivy gourd pickle in coconut oil

method.en: Wipe the tendli dry rather than washing them on the day of pickling. A single drop of water in the jar grows mould and takes the batch.
method.l: लोणचें घालपाच्या दिसा तेंडलीं धुवचीं न्हय, पुसून घेयात.

method.en: Quarter them lengthways, salt them heavily and leave them two hours.
method.l: लांबट चार वांटे करात, भरपूर मीठ लावन दोन वर दवरात.

method.en: Squeeze the liquid out and throw it away, then spread the pieces in full sun for a whole day until the surfaces are dry to the touch.
method.l: उदक काडून उडयात, मागीर पुराय दीस उन्हांत सुकयात.

method.en: Heat the coconut oil to smoking and cool it completely. Raw oil in a pickle stays raw and the jar turns within a month.
method.l: नाल्लाचें तेल धुंवर येसर तापयात आनी पुरायपणान थंड करात.

method.en: Roast the fenugreek lightly and crush it coarsely. Ground fine it turns a pickle bitter within a fortnight.
method.l: मेथी हळुवार भाजून जाडसर कुटात. बारीक कुटल्यार लोणचें कडू जाता.

method.en: Mix everything, pack into a dry jar with the oil standing above the vegetable, and sun it a week.
method.l: सगळें भरसात, सुक्या बरणेंत भरात, तेल भाजयेवयर उरचें, आनी सप्तकभर उन्हांत दवरात.

recipes.why: Four months on the shelf from a vegetable that is cheapest in October. The drying day cannot be skipped.
recipes.why_l: ऑक्टोबरांत सवाय आशिल्ल्या भाजयेपसून चार म्हयन्यांचो सांठो.

start.en: Salt and sun-dry the cut tendli a full day. Ready in a week.
start.l: कापिल्लीं तेंडलीं मीठ लावन पुराय दीस उन्हांत सुकयात.

vessel.en: A 20 L jar and drying trays. One cook.
vessel.l: २० ली. बरणी आनी ट्रे. एक रांदपी.

season.en: October to February, while the sun is still strong.
season.l: ऑक्टोबर ते फेब्रुवारी, उर्बेचें ऊन आसतना.

recipes.name: Aam Loncho
recipes.sub: Raw mango pickle in coconut oil

method.en: Use hard, sour green mangoes with a white stone. A mango that has begun to turn will go soft in the jar within a month.
method.l: घट्ट, आंबट, धवी बी आशिल्लो आंबो घेयात.

method.en: Wipe them dry, cut into large pieces with the skin on, and salt them heavily for a full day.
method.l: पुसून सुकयात, सालीसयत व्हड फोडी करात, आनी पुराय दीस भरपूर मीठ लावात.

method.en: Drain the liquid off and spread the pieces in full sun for a whole day until the surfaces are dry to the touch.
method.l: उदक काडात आनी पुराय दीस उन्हांत सुकयात.

method.en: Do not skip the drying day. Every failed mango pickle in a temple kitchen traces back to fruit that went into the oil still wet.
method.l: सुकोवपाचो दीस सोडचो न्हय. नाशिल्लें लोणचें सदांच वल्ल्या फळावेल्यान.

method.en: Use coconut oil, heated to smoking and cooled. In Goa the oil is part of the flavour and a mango pickle in mustard oil tastes of somewhere else.
method.l: नाल्लाचें तेल वापरात. गोंयांत तेल हो रुचीचो वांटो.

method.en: Pack into a dry jar with the oil standing a finger above the fruit, sun it three weeks, shaking daily, then shelve.
method.l: सुक्या बरणेंत भरात, तेल फळावयर बोटभर उरचें, तीन सप्तकां उन्हांत दवरात.

recipes.why: Six weeks of cheap fruit turned into a year of pickle, and coconut oil rather than mustard is what makes it Goan.
recipes.why_l: स सप्तकांचें सवाय फळ वर्सभराचें लोणचें जालें.

start.en: Salt and sun-dry the cut mango a full day. Ready in three weeks.
start.l: कापिल्लो आंबो मीठ लावन पुराय दीस उन्हांत सुकयात.

vessel.en: A 25 L jar and drying trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: २५ ली. बरणी आनी ट्रे. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: April and May only, and the whole year's supply is made then.
season.l: फकत एप्रिल आनी मे, आनी आख्ख्या वर्साचें तेन्नाच करतात.

recipes.name: Limbya Loncho
recipes.sub: Lime cured in salt for a year

method.en: Wipe every lime dry with a cloth — one drop of water and the jar grows a white bloom by the second month.
method.l: दर लिंबू कापडान पुसून सुकयात — उदकाचो एक थेंब आनी दुसऱ्या म्हयन्यांत बरणयेर धवी बुरशी येता.

method.en: Quarter without cutting through, pack with salt and turmeric, and shut the jar.
method.l: पुराय कापनासतना चार फोडी करात, मीठ आनी हळद भरात, बरणी धांपात.

method.en: Sun it forty days and shake it every morning — the skin softens and darkens on its own.
method.l: चाळीस दीस उन्हांत दवरात आनी दर सकाळीं हालयात — साल आपशीच मऊ आनी काळसर जाता.

method.en: The dry spices and oil go in only after the forty days.
method.l: सुके मसाले आनी तेल फकत चाळीस दिसां उपरांत.

recipes.why: Two rupees a head and it only improves for three years. The one pickle the kitchen can put on a sick tray, because there is no oil in it for the first six weeks.
recipes.why_l: दोन रुपया दर मनशाक आनी तीन वर्सां चडूच बरें जाता. पयल्या स सप्तकांनी तातूंत तेल नासता, देखून दुयेंत्याच्या ताटार दवरूंक जाता तें एकूच लोंचें.

start.en: Forty days in the sun before it is opened.
start.l: उगडचेआदीं चाळीस दीस उन्हांत.

vessel.en: Two 10 L glass jars and a sunny terrace. One cook.
vessel.l: दोन १० ली. काचेच्यो बरण्यो आनी उन्हाळी गच्ची. एक रांदपी.

season.en: Made in March, eaten all year.

recipes.name: Bibbe Loncho
recipes.sub: Tender cashew kernels pickled in mustard

method.en: Bibbe are only good in the three weeks before the nut hardens; outside those weeks this pickle cannot be made at all.
method.l: गरो घट्ट जावचेआदींच्या तीन सप्तकांनीच बिब्बे बरे आसतात; ते भायर हें लोंचें करूंकच जायना.

method.en: Boil them ten minutes and drain them dry — raw bibbe ferment in the jar and burst the lid.
method.l: धा मिनटां उकडात आनी सामके सुके करात — कच्चे बिब्बे बरणयेंत आंबतात आनी झांकण उडयतात.

method.en: Heat the oil to smoking and cool it fully before it goes in.
method.l: तेल धुंवर सुटसर तापयात आनी सामकें थंड करून मागीर घालात.

method.en: Keep the jar in the sun a week and use it inside two months.
method.l: बरणी एक सप्तक उन्हांत दवरात आनी दोन म्हयन्यां भितर वापरात.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a plate, and it is the one pickle a Goan guest will notice and mention. The bibbe are bought at the plantation for a fortnight in March and not after.
recipes.why_l: आठ रुपया दर ताटाक; गोंयकार सोयरो जें लोंचें बघून उलयतलो तें हेंच. बिब्बे मार्चांत पंदरा दीस बागायतींत मेळटात, ते उपरांत न्हय.

start.en: Boil, dry, pack. One week in the sun before it is opened.
start.l: उकडात, सुकयात, भरात. उगडचेआदीं एक सप्तक उन्हांत.

vessel.en: A 10 L glass jar and a drying cloth. One cook.
vessel.l: १० ली. काचेची बरणी आनी सुकोवपाचें कापड. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Karmalachem Loncho
recipes.sub: Star fruit pickled with mustard and jaggery

method.en: Trim the brown ridge off each fin and cut across into stars.
method.l: दर पंखाची तांबडी देग कातरात आनी आडवीं कापून चांदणां करात.

method.en: Salt them overnight and throw the water they give — that water is what rots a pickle.
method.l: रातभर मीठ लावात आनी सुटिल्लें उदक उडयात — तेच उदकान लोंचें कुसता.

method.en: Jaggery goes in warm, not hot, or the fruit collapses.
method.l: गोड हुनसाण घालात, तापिल्लो न्हय, ना जाल्यार फळ मोडून पडटा.

method.en: It is ready in four days and does not want a month.
method.l: चार दिसांनी तयार जाता, म्हयनो रावचें पडना.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head from a fruit nobody buys and every backyard has. Sweet, sour and hot in one spoon, which is what a plain plate of ukde rice wants.
recipes.why_l: नोव रुपया दर मनशाक — कोणूच विकत घेना आनी दर परसांत आसा त्या फळांतल्यान. एका चमच्यांत गोड, आंबट आनी तिखट; सादो उकडो भात मागता तेंच.

start.en: Salt overnight, pack the next day. Ready in four days.
start.l: रातभर मीठ, दुसऱ्या दिसा भरात. चार दिसांनी तयार.

vessel.en: A 10 L jar and a draining tray. One cook.
vessel.l: १० ली. बरणी आनी निथारपाचें ताट. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Ambade Loncho
recipes.sub: Hog plum in mustard and chilli

method.en: Use fruit still hard and green — a soft ambade turns to pulp in the jar within a week.
method.l: घट्ट आनी हिरवें फळच वापरात — मऊ आंबाडो सप्तकाभितर बरणयेंत गरो जाता.

method.en: Halve them with the stone in; the stone holds the piece together.
method.l: बियेसयत अर्दे करात; बीच कुडको एकठांय धरता.

method.en: Salt three days in the sun and pour the water off each morning.
method.l: तीन दीस उन्हांत मीठ लावात आनी दर सकाळीं सुटिल्लें उदक व्हांवयात.

method.en: Smoked and cooled coconut oil last.
method.l: निमाणें धुंवर सुटयल्लें आनी थंड केल्लें नाल्लाचें तेल.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head. The tree at the back gate drops fifty kilos in a fortnight and the whole year's jar is filled out of what would otherwise be swept away.
recipes.why_l: आठ रुपया दर मनशाक. फाटल्या दारा कडलें झाड पंदरा दिसांनी पन्नास किलो घालता, आनी जें झाडून उडयलें आसतें तातूंतल्यान वर्सभराची बरणी भरता.

start.en: Three days of salting in the sun before packing.
start.l: भरचेआदीं तीन दीस उन्हांत मीठ.

vessel.en: Two 10 L jars and a drying tray. One cook.
vessel.l: दोन १० ली. बरण्यो आनी सुकोवपाचें ताट. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kokam Agal
recipes.sub: Salt-drawn kokum extract, the year's sourness
recipes.sub_l: मिठान काडिल्लो कोकमाचो अर्क, वर्साचें आंबटपण

method.en: Halve the fruit, squeeze the seed out and keep the skins.
method.l: फळ अर्दें करात, बियो काडात आनी सालीं दवरात.

method.en: Layer skins and salt in a jar and stand it in the sun.
method.l: बरणयेंत सालीं आनी मिठाचे थर लायात आनी उन्हांत दवरात.

method.en: Press down every morning and pour the liquor that gathers into a second jar.
method.l: दर सकाळीं दाबात आनी जमिल्लो रोस दुसऱ्या बरणयेंत वतात.

method.en: Fifteen days of this and the agal is done — nothing is cooked and nothing is added.
method.l: पंदरा दीस अशें केल्यार आगळ तयार — कांयच शिजयना आनी कांयच घालचें पडना.

recipes.why: Two rupees a plate. Eighteen litres put down in May is the sourness for every ambat, sol kadi and saar until the next May, and nothing bought comes close.
recipes.why_l: दोन रुपया दर ताटाक. मेयांत भरिल्ले अठरा लीटर फुडल्या मेयामेरेन दर आंबट, सोलकडी आनी सारांचें आंबटपण; विकत घेतिल्लें कांयच हाचे लागीं येना.

start.en: Fifteen days in the sun. Nothing is cooked.
start.l: पंदरा दीस उन्हांत. रांदप ना.

vessel.en: Two 20 L glass jars and a sunny terrace. One cook.
vessel.l: दोन २० ली. काचेच्यो बरण्यो आनी उन्हाळी गच्ची. एक रांदपी.

season.en: Made in May, used all year.

recipes.name: Taak Kadhi
recipes.sub: Buttermilk kadhi with coconut and teppal

method.en: A Goan kadhi is thickened with coconut rather than gram flour, and that is the whole difference from a plains kadhi.
method.l: गोंयची कढी बेसनान न्हय, नाल्लान घट्ट करतात. हेंच वेगळेंपण.

method.en: Grind the fresh coconut with the chilli and ginger to a very fine paste. A gritty coconut paste will not hold in buttermilk.
method.l: ताजो नाल्ल, मिरसांग आनी आलें बारीक वाटात.

method.en: Whisk the curd smooth first, with no water, then thin it gradually. Lumps formed now never come out.
method.l: दंय पयलीं उदक घालिनासतना घोटात, मागीर हळूहळू पातळ करात.

method.en: Stir continuously in one direction until it comes to a boil. Stop stirring before that and it splits, and a split kadhi cannot be brought back.
method.l: उकडसर एकाच दिशेन सतत ढवळात. आदीं थांबल्यार ती फाटता.

method.en: Do not let it boil hard. A coconut and buttermilk kadhi splits at a rolling boil and there is no recovering it.
method.l: जोरान उकडूंक दिवचें न्हय.

method.en: Crush the teppal at the last moment and stir it in off the fire. Boiled, teppal goes bitter and numbs the mouth.
method.l: तेप्पल निमाण्या घडयेक चुरडात आनी उजो बंद करून भरसात.

recipes.why: Coconut instead of gram flour, and teppal off the fire. Both are what make it a Goan kadhi.
recipes.why_l: बेसनाबदला नाल्ल, आनी उजो बंद करून तेप्पल.

start.en: Sour the curd a day ahead. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: दंय एक दीस आदीं आंबट करात.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel and a grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: ४० ली. जड आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Dahi Koshimbir
recipes.sub: Curd with cucumber and coconut

method.en: Grate the cucumber and squeeze the water out in the hand, keeping that water to thin the curd.
method.l: खीर किसून हातान उदक पिळात, आनी तें उदक दंय पातळ करपाक दवरात.

method.en: Fold the fresh grated coconut in raw. A Goan koshimbir has coconut in it and that is what distinguishes it from a plains raita.
method.l: खवयल्लो नाल्ल कच्चोच घालात. गोंयच्या कोशिंबिरींत नाल्ल आसता.

method.en: Whisk the curd smooth with that liquid and the salt.
method.l: दंय त्या उदकाकडेन आनी मिठाकडेन घोटात.

method.en: Taste it cold — chilled curd needs more salt than it seems to.
method.l: थंड आसतनाच चाकात — थंड दंयाक चड मीठ जाय.

method.en: Temper mustard, curry leaf and asafoetida in coconut oil and pour it over at the end.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव, कढीपत्तो आनी हिंग तडतडावन निमाणें घालात.

method.en: Do not hold it more than an hour. Curd with fresh coconut in it sours faster than plain curd.
method.l: एका वरापरस चड दवरचें न्हय. नाल्ल घाल्लें दंय बेगीन आंबट जाता.

recipes.why: Raw coconut and a coconut oil tempering. Both are small and both make it Goan.
recipes.why_l: कच्चो नाल्ल आनी नाल्लाच्या तेलाचो तडको.

start.en: Make it within an hour of serving.
start.l: वाडपाच्या एका वरांभितर करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year, doubled in the hot months.

recipes.name: Kelyache Sasav
recipes.sub: Ripe banana in mustard and coconut curd
recipes.sub_l: सांसव आनी नाल्लाच्या दंयांत पिकिल्लीं केळीं

method.en: Sasav is the mustard-and-coconut dressing and it is served cold, closer to a raita than to a curry.
method.l: सासव म्हळ्यार सांसव आनी नाल्लाचो मसालो, आनी तें थंड वाडटात.

method.en: Soak the mustard seed thirty minutes and grind it with the coconut and dry chilli. Ground mustard turns bitter if it stands more than an hour, so grind it close to serving.
method.l: सांसव तीस मिनटां भिजयात आनी नाल्ल आनी मिरसांगीकडेन वाटात. वाटिल्लें सांसव एका वरापरस चड दवरल्यार कडू जाता.

method.en: Grind it fine but briefly. A machine run long heats the mustard and it turns sharply bitter.
method.l: बारीक पूण बेगीन वाटात. मशीन चड चलयल्यार सांसव कडू जाता.

method.en: Use bananas that are properly ripe. An underripe banana is starchy and the dish is meant to be sweet against the mustard.
method.l: बरीं पिकिल्लीं केळीं घेयात.

method.en: Whisk the curd smooth and fold the ground paste in by hand rather than in the machine.
method.l: दंय घोटात आनी वाटिल्लो मसालो हातान भरसात.

method.en: Never heat a sasav. The mustard turns acrid and the curd splits, and it is served cold for exactly that reason.
method.l: सासव केन्नाच तापोवचें न्हय. सांसव तिखट जाता आनी दंय फाटता.

recipes.why: Ground late, never heated. Both rules are about the mustard, which turns within the hour.
recipes.why_l: उशीरां वाटप, केन्नाच तापोवंक न्हय. दोनूय सांसवाखातीर.

start.en: Grind the mustard an hour ahead. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: सांसव एक वर आदीं वाटात.

vessel.en: A wet grinder and a 30 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: ओलो ग्राइंडर आनी ३० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year. Served at temple feasts and at weddings.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. देवळाच्या जेवणांनीं आनी काजारांनीं.

recipes.name: Ambya Sasav
recipes.sub: Ripe mango in mustard and coconut curd
recipes.sub_l: सांसव आनी नाल्लाच्या दंयांत पिकिल्लो आंबो

method.en: Use the small fibrous mango, not the table variety — the stringy ones are what a sasav is made of and they cost a quarter as much.
method.l: खावपाचो न्हय, धाकटो तंतुमय आंबो वापरात — सासव तेच आंब्यांचें जाता आनी तो चवथ्या वाटयान सवाय.

method.en: Grind the mustard with the coconut in the last ten seconds only; ground long, mustard turns bitter.
method.l: सांसव नाल्लासयत फकत निमण्या धा सेकंदांनी वाटात; चड वाटल्यार सांसव कडू जाता.

method.en: Nothing is cooked in this dish beyond the tempering.
method.l: फोडणे भायर ह्या पदार्थांत कांयच शिजयना.

method.en: Fold the curd in cold and keep the vessel out of the sun.
method.l: दंय थंडच भरसात आनी आयदन उन्हांत दवरूं नाकात.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head in the six weeks the small mangoes come in by the sackful, and the fibre nobody wants in a fruit bowl is exactly what carries this dish.
recipes.why_l: जे स सप्तकांनी धाकटे आंबे पोत्यांनी येतात तेदना वीस रुपया दर मनशाक; फळांच्या ताटांत जो तंतू कोणाकूच नाका, तोच ह्या पदार्थाक व्हरता.

start.en: Nothing is cooked. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: रांदप ना. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A grinder and a 30 L drum. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ग्राइंडर आनी ३० ली. ड्रम. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Dudhya Raita
recipes.sub: Cooked bottle gourd folded into curd

method.en: Grate the gourd and cook it in its own water, covered, eight minutes.
method.l: दुदयो किसात आनी तिच्याच उदकांत धांपून आठ मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Cool it fully before it meets the curd; warm gourd splits the curd and there is no mending it.
method.l: दंयांत घालचेआदीं सामकी थंड करात; हुनसाण दुदयो दंय फोडटा आनी तें मागीर सुदारना.

method.en: Salt at the counter only.
method.l: मीठ फकत वाडपाच्या जाग्यार.

method.en: A mustard and curry leaf tempering in coconut oil over the top.
method.l: वयल्यान नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव आनी कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head from a vegetable at twelve rupees a kilo, and being cooked rather than raw it can go to the elderly and to the sick room.
recipes.why_l: बारा रुपया किलोच्या भाजयेंतल्यान बारा रुपया दर मनशाक; कच्ची न्हय, शिजयल्ली आसा देखून ती म्हाताऱ्यांक आनी दुयेंत्यांक वचूंक शकता.

start.en: Cook and cool the gourd first. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं दुदयो शिजोवन थंड करात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 15 L pot and a 30 L drum. One cook.
vessel.l: १५ ली. आयदन आनी ३० ली. ड्रम. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Karlyachem Sasav
recipes.sub: Bitter gourd fried and dropped into curd

method.en: Slice thin, salt for twenty minutes and squeeze hard — that squeezing takes out half the bitterness and none of the good.
method.l: बारीक कातरात, वीस मिनटां मीठ लावात आनी घट्ट पिळात — तेन्ना अर्दें कडूपण वता आनी गुण उरता.

method.en: Fry the slices crisp in coconut oil and drain them well.
method.l: चाकयो नाल्लाच्या तेलांत करकरीत तळात आनी तेल बरें देंवचें दियात.

method.en: Grind coconut, mustard and chilli and whisk it through the cold curd.
method.l: नाल्ल, सांसव आनी मिरसांग वाटात आनी थंड दंयांत घुसळात.

method.en: Drop the fried gourd in at the counter, not before — put in early it goes soft and the dish is only bitter curd.
method.l: तळिल्लें कारलें वाडपाच्या जाग्यार घालात, आदीं न्हय — पयलीं घाल्यार तें मऊ जाता आनी उरता तें फकत कडू दंय.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head, and it is what makes a hall eat bitter gourd without complaint — the frying and the jaggery do the persuading.
recipes.why_l: चवदा रुपया दर मनशाक; पंगत कुरकुर करिनासतना कारलें खाता तें हेच खातीर — तळप आनी गोड तें पटयतात.

start.en: Salt, squeeze, fry. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: मीठ लावात, पिळात, तळात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A frying kadhai and a 30 L drum. Two cooks.
vessel.l: तळपाची कायल आनी ३० ली. ड्रम. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Phanasachem Sasav
recipes.sub: Ripe jackfruit bulbs in mustard curd

method.en: Oil the hands and the knife before the jackfruit is opened, or the sap sets like glue on both.
method.l: फणस उगडचेआदीं हात आनी सुरी तेलान माखात, ना जाल्यार चीक दोनूय वटांनी डिंकाभशेन बसता.

method.en: Take the seeds out and keep them — they are another day's vegetable.
method.l: बियो काडून दवरात — त्यो दुसऱ्या दिसाची भाजी.

method.en: Tear the bulbs by hand into three; cut with a knife they go slippery.
method.l: गरे हातान तीन कुडके करात; सुऱ्यान कापल्यार ते निसरडे जातात.

method.en: Grind mustard with coconut at the very end and fold in cold.
method.l: सांसव नाल्लासयत सामकें निमाणें वाटात आनी थंडच भरसात.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head in a fortnight when a hundred jackfruit come off the temple land at once and half of them would go soft before anyone ate them.
recipes.why_l: देवळाच्या जमनींतल्यान एकाच वेळार शंबर फणस येतात त्या पंदरा दिसांनी पंदरा रुपया दर मनशाक; ना जाल्यार अर्दे कोणें खावचेआदीं मऊ जातले.

start.en: Open and clean the jackfruit first. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं फणस उगडून निवळावात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: An oiled board, a grinder and a 30 L drum. Three cooks.
vessel.l: तेल लायिल्लो फळो, ग्राइंडर आनी ३० ली. ड्रम. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Masalyachem Taak
recipes.sub: Thin buttermilk with curry leaf and ginger

method.en: Churn the curd with a wooden churner and a little water before the rest goes in.
method.l: उरिल्लें उदक घालचेआदीं दंय लांकडे रवयेन थोड्या उदकांत घुसळात.

method.en: Bruise the ginger and curry leaf rather than grinding them — ground, they cloud the taak and it looks like a thin kadhi.
method.l: आलें आनी कढीपत्तो वाटचे परस ठेचात — वाटल्यार ताक गढूळ जाता आनी पातळ कढीभशेन दिसता.

method.en: Temper mustard and asafoetida in coconut oil, cool it, and stir it in.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव आनी हिंगाची फोडणी करात, थंड करात आनी भरसात.

method.en: Serve cold and within four hours.
method.l: थंड आनी चार वरां भितर वाडात.

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head. In May the hall drinks more of this than it eats of anything else, and it uses curd that is a day past sweet.
recipes.why_l: धा रुपया दर मनशाक. मेयांत पंगत हेर कितेंय खाता ते परस चड हेंच पियेता, आनी एक दीस जुनें जाल्लें दंय तातूंत वता.

start.en: Nothing is cooked but the tempering. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: फोडणे भायर रांदप ना. वाडपाआदीं चाळीस मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L drum and a wooden churner. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. ड्रम आनी लांकडी रवी. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Moong Khichdi
recipes.sub: Rice and moong dal with coconut oil
recipes.sub_l: नाल्लाच्या तेलाकडेन शीत आनी मुगाची डाळ

method.en: Use more dal and less rice than in an ordinary khichdi. That is what makes this the dish given to someone unwell.
method.l: सादारण खिचडेपरस चड डाळ आनी उणे तांदूळ घालात.

method.en: Wash both in three changes of water and soak thirty minutes.
method.l: दोनूय तीन फावटीं धुयात आनी तीस मिनटां भिजयात.

method.en: Cook it looser than a normal khichdi — closer to four parts water than three.
method.l: सादारण खिचडेपरस पातळ शिजयात.

method.en: Season with black pepper rather than chilli. This is meant to be gentle and chilli defeats the purpose entirely.
method.l: मिरसांगेबदला मिरीं घालात. हें सौम्य आसपाक जाय.

method.en: Temper the cumin and asafoetida in ghee, and add a spoon of coconut oil at the end. That spoon is what makes it Goan.
method.l: तुपांत जिरें आनी हिंग तडतडयात, आनी निमाणें नाल्लाच्या तेलाचो एक चमचो घालात.

method.en: Cook covered on a low flame twenty-five minutes, stirring up from the bottom twice.
method.l: झांपून धिम्या उज्यार पंचवीस मिनटां शिजयात, दोन फावटीं बुडासावन ढवळात.

recipes.why: The dish to have ready when someone cannot eat what everyone else is eating. Nothing in it is heavy.
recipes.why_l: हेर सगळे जें जेवतात तें कोणें जेवंक शकना तेन्ना.

start.en: Soak rice and dal thirty minutes. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: तांदूळ आनी डाळ तीस मिनटां भिजयात.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: घट्ट झांपणेचें ४० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The dish for a sick tray.

recipes.name: Sabzi Khichdi
recipes.sub: Khichdi with seasonal vegetables

method.en: Cut all the vegetables to the same size. Mixed sizes mean the carrot is raw when the beans are collapsing.
method.l: सगळी भाजी एकाच आकाराची कापात.

method.en: Temper mustard, cumin, curry leaf and asafoetida in coconut oil, then add the vegetables and fry four minutes.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव, जिरें, कढीपत्तो आनी हिंग तडतडयात, मागीर भाजी घालून चार मिनटां परतात.

method.en: Frying the vegetables first is what keeps them from disappearing. Added straight to the water they go to pulp before the rice is done.
method.l: भाजी पयलीं परतल्यार ती नश्ट जायना.

method.en: Add the soaked grain, hot water, turmeric and salt.
method.l: भिजयल्लें धान्य, गरम उदक, हळद आनी मीठ घालात.

method.en: Cook covered on a low flame twenty-five minutes, stirring up from the bottom twice.
method.l: झांपून धिम्या उज्यार पंचवीस मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Stir the fresh grated coconut in off the fire. Cooked in, coconut goes stringy and grey.
method.l: उजो बंद करून खवयल्लो नाल्ल भरसात.

recipes.why: One vessel and whatever the market gave. The coconut goes in off the fire or it turns stringy.
recipes.why_l: एक आयदन आनी बाजारांत जें मेळ्ळें तें. नाल्ल उजो बंद करून.

start.en: Soak rice and dal thirty minutes, cut the vegetables an hour ahead.
start.l: तांदूळ आनी डाळ तीस मिनटां भिजयात.

vessel.en: A heavy 45 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४५ ली. जड आयदन. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: All year with whatever the market gave.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स, बाजारांत जें मेळटा तें.

recipes.name: Ukde Khichdi
recipes.sub: Parboiled rice khichdi with kokum

method.en: Use parboiled rice and toor dal rather than moong. This is the heavier everyday khichdi, not the one for a sick tray.
method.l: उकडे तांदूळ आनी तुरीची डाळ घालात. ही रोजची जड खिचडी.

method.en: Soak both together thirty minutes and cook until the grains have gone soft but not collapsed.
method.l: दोनूय एकठांय तीस मिनटां भिजयात आनी दाणे मोव जावसर शिजयात.

method.en: Add the kokum only in the last ten minutes. Acid added early stops the dal softening and it will stay hard.
method.l: कोकम निमाण्या धा मिनटांनीं घालात. आदीं घाल्यार डाळ शिजना.

method.en: Temper in coconut oil rather than ghee. A Goan khichdi is tempered in coconut oil and that is what places it.
method.l: तुपाबदला नाल्लाच्या तेलांत तडको करात.

method.en: Pour the tempering over in the serving vessel rather than the cooking pot, so it is still fragrant at the counter.
method.l: तडको रांदपाच्या आयदनांत न्हय, वाडपाच्या आयदनांत घालात.

method.en: Stir the fresh grated coconut in off the fire and keep hot water aside — it thickens as it stands.
method.l: उजो बंद करून नाल्ल भरसात आनी गरम उदक बाजूक दवरात.

recipes.why: Kokum late, coconut oil for the tempering. Both are small and both place the dish in Goa.
recipes.why_l: कोकम उशीरां, तडको नाल्लाच्या तेलांत.

start.en: Soak thirty minutes. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: तीस मिनटां भिजयात.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ४० ली. जड आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Nachne Khichdi
recipes.sub: Cracked ragi cooked with moong dal

method.en: Use cracked ragi, not flour — flour gives a paste and cracked grain gives a khichdi.
method.l: पीठ न्हय, भरडिल्ली नाचणी वापरात — पिठाची लापशी जाता, भरडाची खिचडी.

method.en: Roast the moong dal before washing it.
method.l: मुगाची दाळ धुवचेआदीं भाजात.

method.en: Four and a half parts water; ragi drinks more than rice does.
method.l: साडेचार वांटे उदक; नाचणी तांदळा परस चड पियेता.

method.en: Do not stir once it is on the fire.
method.l: उज्यार दवरल्या उपरांत घुसळूं नाकात.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head and ragi is grown on the hill plots behind Sanguem where nothing else will take. More iron in one plate than in three of rice.
recipes.why_l: पंदरा रुपया दर मनशाक. सांगेफाटल्या दोंगराळ जमनींत, जंय हेर कांयच पिकना, थंय नाचणी पिकता. एका ताटांत तीन ताटां भाता परस चड लोखण.

start.en: Forty minutes on the fire. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: चाळीस मिनटां उज्यार. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot with a heavy lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जड झांकणासयत ४० ली. आयदन. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Toor Dalichi Khichdi
recipes.sub: Rice and toor dal with whole spice and ghee
recipes.sub_l: खडे मसाले आनी तुपासयत तांदूळ आनी तुरीची दाळ

method.en: Tie the whole spices in a cloth — a clove in the mouth of a devotee is a complaint and the bundle costs nothing.
method.l: खडे मसाले कापडांत बांदात — भक्ताच्या तोंडांत आयिल्ली लवंग म्हळ्यार कागाळ, आनी पुडी करूंक कितेंच लागना.

method.en: Roast the toor dal a minute before it is washed; it changes the whole vessel.
method.l: तुरीची दाळ धुवचेआदीं एक मिनट भाजात; आख्खें आयदन बदलता.

method.en: Four parts water to one of grain and no stirring after it is covered.
method.l: एका वांटयाक चार वांटे उदक आनी धांपल्या उपरांत घुसळप ना.

method.en: Ghee at the counter, a spoon a plate.
method.l: तूप वाडपाच्या जाग्यार, ताटाक एक चमचो.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head, one vessel and one fire, and a full meal in it. What the kitchen cooks on the day it is short of hands.
recipes.why_l: सत्रा रुपया दर मनशाक — एक आयदन, एक उजो आनी तातूंत पुराय जेवण. हात उणे पडटात त्या दिसा रांदणकूड हेंच रांदता.

start.en: Thirty minutes on the fire. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: तीस मिनटां उज्यार. वाडपाआदीं सत्तर मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot with a heavy lid. One cook.
vessel.l: जड झांकणासयत ४० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Tambdi Bhaji Khichdi
recipes.sub: Moong khichdi green with red amaranth
recipes.sub_l: तांबडे भाजयेन हिरवी जाल्ली मुगाची खिचडी

method.en: Chop the amaranth fine and put it in only when the khichdi is nearly done — boiled from the start it turns the vessel grey.
method.l: भाजी बारीक कातरात आनी खिचडी जवळजवळ जाल्या उपरांतच घालात — सुरवेक घाल्यार आख्खें आयदन मळकट जाता.

method.en: Do not cover it after the greens go in.
method.l: भाजी घाल्या उपरांत धांपूं नाकात.

method.en: Coconut ground with cumin, folded in off the fire.
method.l: नाल्ल जिऱ्यासयत वाटात आनी उजो पालवून भरसात.

method.en: Lime at the counter — greens need an acid or they eat flat.
method.l: लिंबू वाडपाच्या जाग्यार — भाजयेक आंबटपण नाशिल्यार ती सपक लागता.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head, and the children who push a plate of greens aside eat them here without noticing.
recipes.why_l: पंदरा रुपया दर मनशाक; जीं भुरगीं भाजयेचें ताट बाजूक दवरतात, तीं हांगा नकळटच ती खातात.

start.en: Wash the greens well first. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं भाजी बरी धुवात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot and a wash trough. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन आनी धुवपाची टांकी. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Nariyal Khichdi
recipes.sub: Khichdi finished in thick coconut milk

method.en: Cook the grain in the thin second pressing of the coconut, never in plain water.
method.l: दाणें नाल्लाच्या दुसऱ्या पातळ रोसांत शिजयात, सादे उदकांत कदींच न्हय.

method.en: The thick first pressing goes in off the fire at the very end — boiled, it splits and the khichdi looks curdled.
method.l: पयलो घट्ट रोस उजो पालवून सामकें निमाणें घालात — उकडल्यार तो फुटता आनी खिचडी नासल्ली दिसता.

method.en: Fry the cashew in coconut oil and keep it back for the counter.
method.l: काजू नाल्लाच्या तेलांत तळात आनी वाडपाखातीर वेगळे दवरात.

method.en: It thickens as it stands; keep it looser than looks right.
method.l: दवरल्या उपरांत ती घट्ट जाता; दिसता ते परस पातळ दवरात.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees a head and no dairy in it at all, which means the one vessel feeds the whole hall including those who take no milk.
recipes.why_l: एकुणीस रुपया दर मनशाक आनी तातूंत दूद मात ना; म्हळ्यार दूद घेवंक नाशिल्ल्यांसयत आख्खी पंगत एकाच आयदनांतल्यान जेवता.

start.en: Press the coconut fresh. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: नाल्लाचो रोस ताजो काडात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a grinder and muslin. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, ग्राइंडर आनी मलमल. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Vatana Khichdi
recipes.sub: Khichdi with dried peas, thick and heavy
recipes.sub_l: सुक्या वाटाण्यांची घट्ट आनी भरपूर खिचडी

method.en: Soak the peas ten hours and cook them soft before the rice ever joins them.
method.l: वाटाणे धा वरां भिजयात आनी तांदूळ घालचेआदींच मऊ शिजयात.

method.en: Put them in together and one is stone while the other is paste.
method.l: दोनूय एकठांय घाल्यार एक फातर उरता आनी दुसरो लापशी जाता.

method.en: Three and a half parts water — this khichdi is eaten thick.
method.l: साडेतीन वांटे उदक — ही खिचडी घट्ट खातात.

method.en: Crushed pepper rather than chilli powder is what makes it sit right in the stomach.
method.l: मिरसांग पिठा परस कुटिल्लीं मिरीं तिका पोटांत सारकी बसयतात.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head, and it holds a man until night in a way a moong khichdi does not. What goes to the men unloading sand at ten in the morning.
recipes.why_l: सोळा रुपया दर मनशाक; मुगाची खिचडी जें करूंक शकना, ती ही रातमेरेन पोट भरून दवरता. सकाळीं धा वरांचेर रेंव देंवयतल्यांक हेंच वता.

start.en: Soak ten hours. Start twelve hours before serving.
start.l: धा वरां भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं बारा वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot and a pressure vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन आनी कुकर. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The monsoon most of all.

recipes.name: Goan Masala
recipes.sub: The house blend, roasted

method.en: This blend is chilli-and-coriander led, and there is no fennel and no fenugreek in it. A Goan masala is simpler than a plains garam masala.
method.l: हो मसालो मिरसांग आनी धण्यांचेर आदारिल्लो. तातूंत बडीशोप ना, मेथी ना.

method.en: Use Kashmiri or Byadgi chilli for the colour and a smaller quantity of a hotter chilli for the heat. Goan gravies are red and mild rather than brown and sharp.
method.l: रंगाक काश्मिरी वा ब्याडगी मिरसांग आनी तिखेपणाक थोडी तिखी मिरसांग.

method.en: Spread the whole spices in the sun for half a day. Moisture left in them clogs the grinder and shortens the life of the blend.
method.l: मसाले अर्दो दीस उन्हांत दवरात. ओलसाण उरल्यार ग्राइंडर भरता.

method.en: Roast each spice separately on a dry pan on a low flame. They are different sizes and roasting them together burns the small ones.
method.l: दर मसालो वेगळो भाजात. एकठांय भाजल्यार ल्हान जळटात.

method.en: Take each off the moment it smells, not when it changes colour. Colour is a late signal.
method.l: वास येतकच काडात, रंग बदलतकच न्हय.

method.en: Cool completely, grind in small batches, sieve, and store in glass away from the stove.
method.l: पुरायपणान थंड करात, थोडें थोडें दळात, चाळात, आनी उज्यापसून पयस काचेंत दवरात.

recipes.why: Chilli-and-coriander led, and no fennel. Roasting each spice separately is the whole difference from a bought blend.
recipes.why_l: मिरसांग आनी धणे मुखेल. दर मसालो वेगळो भाजप हेंच वेगळेंपण.

start.en: Sun the whole spices half a day. Grind in one sitting.
start.l: मसाले अर्दो दीस उन्हांत दवरात. एकाच बशकेंत दळात.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a dry grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: जड कढई आनी सुको ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

season.en: Made twice a year, best in a dry month.
season.l: वर्सांतून दोन फावटीं, सुक्या म्हयन्यांत बरें.

recipes.name: Xacuti Masala
recipes.sub: Roasted coconut and spice paste

method.en: Xacuti masala is a wet paste, not a dry powder, and it cannot be stored the way a garam masala can. Make it on the day.
method.l: शकुती मसालो ओली वाटण, सुकी पूड न्हय. त्याच दिसा करात.

method.en: A restaurant xacuti is built on onion and garlic. This one is not, and the roasted coconut and the poppy seed carry the body instead.
method.l: हॉटेलांतलें शकुती कांदो-लसणाचेर. हें न्हय — भाजिल्लो नाल्ल आनी खसखस तें काम करतात.

method.en: Roast the grated coconut in a dry pan on a low flame for twenty minutes until it is a deep even brown, stirring constantly.
method.l: खवयल्लो नाल्ल सुक्या कढयेंत धिम्या उज्यार वीस मिनटां गडद तांबसार जावंक भाजात.

method.en: Roast the poppy seed separately and very briefly. Poppy burns in seconds and a burnt seed makes the whole paste bitter.
method.l: खसखस वेगळी आनी बेगीन भाजात. ती सेकंदांनीं जळटा.

method.en: Roast the whole spices separately, cool everything, and grind with the tamarind to a very fine paste.
method.l: मसाले वेगळे भाजात, सगळें थंड करात, आनी चिंचेकडेन बारीक वाटात.

method.en: Grind it finer than seems necessary. A xacuti is judged on being completely smooth and a gritty paste cannot be corrected in the pot.
method.l: गरजेपरस चड बारीक वाटात. शकुती पुरायपणान मोव आसपाक जाय.

recipes.why: Roasted coconut and poppy seed in place of onion. Ground fine and made the same day.
recipes.why_l: कांद्याबदला भाजिल्लो नाल्ल आनी खसखस. बारीक वाटप, त्याच दिसा.

start.en: Made fresh and used the same day. Keeps three days refrigerated.
start.l: ताजें करात आनी त्याच दिसा वापरात.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a wet grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जड कढई आनी ओलो ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

recipes.name: Teppal Vatap
recipes.sub: Coconut and teppal paste for a khatkhatem

method.en: This is the paste that goes into a khatkhatem and into any temple dish where garlic would otherwise be used. Teppal is doing that work.
method.l: ही वाटण खतखत्यांत वता आनी देवळाच्या ज्या जिनसांत लसूण घालपाचो थंय.

method.en: Do not roast the coconut for this one. A khatkhatem is a pale gravy and roasted coconut makes it brown and turns it into a tonak.
method.l: हांगा नाल्ल भाजचो न्हय. खतखत्याचो रस फिकट आसता.

method.en: Roast only the chilli and coriander, lightly, and grind them with the raw coconut.
method.l: फकत मिरसांग आनी धणे हळुवार भाजात आनी कच्च्या नाल्लाकडेन वाटात.

method.en: Crush the teppal in a mortar and stir it into the ground paste by hand. It is never ground in the machine.
method.l: तेप्पल उखळांत चुरडात आनी हातान वाटणेंत भरसात. तें मशिनांत केन्नाच दळचें न्हय.

method.en: Discard the small black seed inside each husk. The seed is gritty and bitter and the husk carries the flavour.
method.l: दर सालींतलो काळो बी काडून उडयात.

method.en: Use the paste within two days. Raw coconut ground with no acid in it sours quickly in this climate.
method.l: वाटण दोन दिसांभितर वापरात. कच्चो नाल्ल हांगा बेगीन आंबट जाता.

recipes.why: Raw coconut, not roasted, and teppal crushed by hand. Those two make a khatkhatem rather than a tonak.
recipes.why_l: कच्चो नाल्ल आनी हातान चुरडिल्लें तेप्पल. हेंच खतखतें करता, तोणाक न्हय.

start.en: Made fresh. Crush the teppal at the last moment.
start.l: ताजें करात. तेप्पल निमाण्या घडयेक चुरडात.

vessel.en: A wet grinder and a mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: ओलो ग्राइंडर आनी उखळ. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year; teppal is harvested in May.

recipes.name: Nariyal Vatap
recipes.sub: The ground coconut base every ghashi starts from
recipes.sub_l: दर घशयेची सुरवात जातकडल्यान जाता तें नाल्लाचें वाटप

method.en: Grind it raw for a ghashi and roast the coconut first for a tonak — the same vatap, two dishes, and the roasting is the whole difference.
method.l: घशयेखातीर कच्चें वाटात आनी तोणाकाखातीर नाल्ल पयलीं भाजात — तेंच वाटप, दोन पदार्थ; फरक फकत भाजपाचो.

method.en: Grind with as little water as the stone will take; water in the vatap sours it by the next morning.
method.l: फातर घेता तितल्याच उण्या उदकांत वाटात; वाटपांतलें उदक दुसऱ्या सकाळमेरेन तें आंबट करता.

method.en: Take it out of the grinder before it goes warm.
method.l: तें हुनसाण जावचेआदीं ग्राइंडरांतल्यान काडात.

method.en: Two days in the cold room, no more.
method.l: थंड कुडींत दोन दीस, ते परस चड न्हय.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a kilo of vatap and it is the base of nine dishes on this shelf. Ground once in the morning, it saves an hour on every vessel after.
recipes.why_l: वाटपाक चवदा रुपया किलो, आनी ह्या फळयेवयल्या नोव पदार्थांचो तोच पायो. सकाळीं एकदाच वाटलें जाल्यार फुडल्या दर आयदनाचो एक वर वाटयता.

start.en: Grind fresh each morning. Thirty minutes of work.
start.l: दर सकाळीं ताजें वाटात. तीस मिनटांचें काम.

vessel.en: A wet-grinder and a covered steel tray. One cook.
vessel.l: ओलो ग्राइंडर आनी धांपिल्लें स्टीलाचें ताट. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Sukhem Masalem
recipes.sub: The dry roasted blend, ground for the month

method.en: Roast each spice on its own — they are not the same size and will not colour at the same time.
method.l: दर मसालो वेगळो भाजात — तांचो आकार एक ना, देखून एकाच वेळार रंग धरिनात.

method.en: Sun the chillies half a day before roasting so they grind to powder and not to paste.
method.l: भाजचेआदीं मिरसांगो अर्दो दीस उन्हांत दवरात, जाका करून त्यो पिठाच्यो जातात, लेपाच्यो न्हय.

method.en: Cool everything fully before grinding.
method.l: वाटचेआदीं सगळें सामकें थंड करात.

method.en: Keep it in glass in the dark and grind afresh every month.
method.l: काचेंत, काळखांत दवरात आनी दर म्हयन्याक नवें वाटात.

recipes.why: A kilo bought outside is eight hundred rupees and smells of nothing by the second month. Ground here it is a third of that and the kitchen knows what is in it.
recipes.why_l: भायर घेतिल्लो किलो आठशें रुपयांचो आनी दुसऱ्या म्हयन्यांत वासूच उरना. हांगा वाटलें जाल्यार तिसऱ्या वाटयान पडटा आनी तातूंत कितें आसा तें रांदणकुडीक खबर आसता.

start.en: Sun half a day, roast, cool, grind. One day of work.
start.l: अर्दो दीस उन्हांत, भाजात, थंड करात, वाटात. एक दिसाचें काम.

vessel.en: A heavy tawa, a dry grinder and glass jars. One cook.
vessel.l: जड तवो, सुको ग्राइंडर आनी काचेच्यो बरण्यो. एक रांदपी.

season.en: Ground on the first of every month.

recipes.name: Kokam Solam
recipes.sub: Kokum skins dried black for the year

method.en: Halve, deseed and rub each skin with a little salt.
method.l: अर्दीं करात, बियो काडात आनी दर सालीक थोडें मीठ चोळात.

method.en: Dry in the sun six days, taking them in every evening before the dew — dew on a half-dried skin is what makes it mould.
method.l: स दीस उन्हांत सुकयात, दर सांजे दंव पडचेआदीं भितर घेयात — अर्द्या सुकिल्ल्या सालीर पडिल्ल्या दंवान बुरशी येता.

method.en: Rub them each morning with the juice that collects underneath; that is what turns them black rather than brown.
method.l: दर सकाळीं सकयल जमिल्ल्या रोसान त्यो चोळात; तेच खातीर त्यो तांबड्यो न्हय, काळ्यो जातात.

method.en: They are done when a skin bends but does not break.
method.l: साल वाकता पूण मोडना तेदना त्यो तयार.

recipes.why: Thirty kilos of fruit in June gives six kilos of solam, and that is the sourness for the whole shelf until the next June. Bought dried it is four hundred rupees a kilo.
recipes.why_l: जुनांतल्या तीस किलो फळांतल्यान स किलो सोलां जातात, आनी फुडल्या जुनामेरेन आख्ख्या फळयेचें आंबटपण तेंच. विकत घेतल्यार चारशें रुपया किलो.

start.en: Six days in the sun. Nothing is cooked.
start.l: स दीस उन्हांत. रांदप ना.

vessel.en: Drying mats, a terrace and cloth bags. Two cooks.
vessel.l: सुकोवपाच्यो चटयो, गच्ची आनी कापडी पोतीं. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Sasavachem Vatap
recipes.sub: Mustard and coconut paste for the sasav dishes
recipes.sub_l: सासव पदार्थांखातीर सांसव आनी नाल्लाचें वाटप

method.en: Grind the coconut, chilli and tamarind first and the mustard only in the last ten seconds.
method.l: पयलीं नाल्ल, मिरसांग आनी चिंच वाटात आनी सांसव फकत निमण्या धा सेकंदांनी.

method.en: Mustard ground long goes bitter, and a bitter vatap cannot be saved by anything.
method.l: सांसव चड वाटल्यार कडू जाता, आनी कडू वाटप कशेनूच सुदारना.

method.en: Use it the same day; mustard loses its sharpness overnight.
method.l: त्याच दिसा वापरात; सांसवाचो तिखटपणा रातभरांत वता.

method.en: Never heat it — every sasav on this shelf is folded in cold.
method.l: तें कदींच तापोवंक नाकात — ह्या फळयेवयलीं सगळीं सासवां थंडच भरसतात.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a kilo and it is what four dishes here begin from. Ground once, it makes an ambya sasav, a phanasachem sasav and two vegetables in the same hour.
recipes.why_l: इकरा रुपया किलो, आनी हांगाचे चार पदार्थ तातूंतल्यानच सुरू जातात. एकदाच वाटलें जाल्यार त्याच वरांत आंब्याचें सासव, फणसाचें सासव आनी दोन भाज्यो जातात.

start.en: Grind fresh. Twenty minutes of work.
start.l: ताजें वाटात. वीस मिनटांचें काम.

vessel.en: A wet-grinder and a covered tray. One cook.
vessel.l: ओलो ग्राइंडर आनी धांपिल्लें ताट. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kaju Vatap
recipes.sub: Cashew paste for the feast gravies

method.en: Soak the cashew four hours in warm water, no longer — soaked overnight it ferments and the gravy sours on the counter.
method.l: काजू कोमट उदकांत चार वरां भिजयात, ते परस चड न्हय — रातभर भिजयल्यार ते आंबतात आनी रोस काउंटरार आंबट जाता.

method.en: Soak the poppy seed separately and grind it first, alone.
method.l: खसखस वेगळी भिजयात आनी पयलीं तीच एकटी वाटात.

method.en: Grind on the wet stone, not in a mixer — a mixer heats the nut and the oil separates out.
method.l: मिक्सरांत न्हय, ओल्या फातरार वाटात — मिक्सरांत गरो तापता आनी तेल वेगळें जाता.

method.en: Use it the same day.
method.l: त्याच दिसा वापरात.

recipes.why: Twenty-eight rupees a kilo of paste, and it is what lets a feast gravy be thick without cream. Broken kernels at half the price of whole do exactly the same work.
recipes.why_l: वाटपाक अठ्ठावीस रुपया किलो; क्रीमावीण फेस्ताचो रोस घट्ट करूंक तेंच जाय. अख्ख्या गऱ्यांच्या अर्द्या दरान मेळपी तुटिल्ले गरे तेंच काम करतात.

start.en: Soak four hours, grind. Start five hours before the gravy is wanted.
start.l: चार वरां भिजयात, वाटात. रोस जाय ते आदीं पांच वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A wet-grinder and a covered steel tray. One cook.
vessel.l: ओलो ग्राइंडर आनी धांपिल्लें स्टीलाचें ताट. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Ukde Sheet
recipes.sub: Parboiled red rice, boiled and drained

method.en: Goa eats a parboiled red rice, not a white basmati. Do not buy basmati for this book — it is wrong on the plate and costs three times as much.
method.l: गोंय उकडे तांबडे तांदूळ खाता, बासमती न्हय. ह्या पुस्तकाखातीर बासमती घेवची न्हय.

method.en: Parboiled rice takes longer than raw. Allow thirty minutes of boiling rather than twenty, and test a grain rather than watching the clock.
method.l: उकडे तांदूळ चड वेळ घेतात. वीस न्हय, तीस मिनटां दियात.

method.en: Rinse until the water runs clear and soak thirty minutes.
method.l: उदक निवळ येसर धुयात आनी तीस मिनटां भिजयात.

method.en: Boil in an open vessel with plenty of water and drain the excess off. This is the drained method and it is what Goa uses.
method.l: उगत्या आयदनांत भरपूर उदक घालून शिजयात आनी उरिल्लें गाळात.

method.en: Keep the rice water. It is drunk with salt, given to anyone unwell, and thrown away only by a wasteful kitchen.
method.l: पेज दवरात. ती मिठाकडेन पियेतात आनी दुयेंतीक दितात.

method.en: Cover and rest ten minutes after draining. The grains are meant to sit together and a sol kadi is poured over them.
method.l: गाळ्ळ्या उपरांत झांपून धा मिनटां दवरात.

recipes.why: Parboiled red rice and thirty minutes of boiling. Buying the right rice matters more than anything done to it afterwards.
recipes.why_l: उकडे तांबडे तांदूळ आनी तीस मिनटां. बरे तांदूळ घेवप सगळ्यांत म्हत्वाचें.

start.en: Rinse and soak thirty minutes. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: धुवन तीस मिनटां भिजयात.

vessel.en: A heavy 45 L vessel and a large strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: ४५ ली. जड आयदन आनी व्हडली चाळण. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Coconut Rice
recipes.sub: Rice with coconut and curry leaf

method.en: Cook the rice first and spread it on a tray to cool before anything is added. Hot rice breaks when it is turned and the dish becomes a mash.
method.l: पयलीं शीत शिजयात आनी ट्रेयर पातळावन थंड करात.

method.en: Roast the grated coconut in a dry pan to a pale gold, not brown. This is not a tonak and a dark roast makes it heavy.
method.l: खवयल्लो नाल्ल सुक्या कढयेंत फिकट सोनेरी भाजात, तांबसार न्हय.

method.en: Temper mustard, urad dal, dry chilli and curry leaf in coconut oil. Wait for the urad dal to turn gold before the curry leaf goes in.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव, उडीद डाळ, मिरसांग आनी कढीपत्तो तडतडयात.

method.en: The urad dal is not a pulse here — it is a spice, and it is what gives the dish its crunch.
method.l: उडीद डाळ हांगा डाळ न्हय, मसालो. तीच कुरकुरीतपण दिता.

method.en: Fry the cashew in the same oil and lift it out before it darkens.
method.l: त्याच तेलांत काजू भाजून तांबसार जावचेआदीं काडात.

method.en: Fold everything through the cooled rice with a flat ladle rather than stirring. Never stir rice with a spoon.
method.l: थंड शितांत सपाट डावान भरसात, ढवळचें न्हय.

recipes.why: Cool the rice first and roast the coconut only to gold. Both keep it a rice dish rather than a mash.
recipes.why_l: पयलीं शीत थंड करात आनी नाल्ल फकत सोनेरी भाजात.

start.en: Rinse and soak twenty minutes. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: धुवन वीस मिनटां भिजयात.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: घट्ट झांपणेचें ४० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Godache Sheet
recipes.sub: Sweet rice with jaggery and coconut

method.en: Boil the rice in plenty of water until three-quarters done, then drain it completely.
method.l: तांदूळ भरपूर उदकांत तीन चतुर्थांश शिजयात आनी पुरायपणान गाळात.

method.en: Three-quarters, not fully cooked. The rice finishes in the syrup, and rice that was already soft turns to a pudding.
method.l: तीन चतुर्थांश, पुराय न्हय. शीत पाकांत पुरें जाता.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in a little water and strain it. Jaggery always carries grit and unstrained it goes into the rice.
method.l: गोड थोड्या उदकांत विरगळावन गाळात.

method.en: Cook the strained jaggery to a thick syrup before the rice goes in. A thin syrup makes the rice wet and it will not hold.
method.l: शीत घालचेआदीं पाक घट्ट करात.

method.en: Fold the rice into the syrup with the grated coconut, cover, and cook fifteen minutes on the lowest flame.
method.l: शीत पाकांत आनी नाल्लांत भरसात, झांपून धिम्या उज्यार पंदरा मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Grate the nutmeg over at the very end. It is the one spice that makes this Goan rather than a plains sweet rice, and it is added off the fire.
method.l: निमाणें जायफळ किसात. हेंच ह्या शिताक गोंयचें करता.

recipes.why: Three-quarter rice, thick syrup and nutmeg off the fire. The nutmeg is what places it.
recipes.why_l: तीन चतुर्थांश शीत, घट्ट पाक, आनी उजो बंद करून जायफळ.

start.en: Soak the rice twenty minutes. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: तांदूळ वीस मिनटां भिजयात.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: घट्ट झांपणेचें ४० ली. आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Vatana Pulav
recipes.sub: Green peas and whole spice in long rice
recipes.sub_l: लांब तांदळांत हिरवे वाटाणे आनी खडे मसाले

method.en: Soak the rice twenty minutes and no longer, then drain it fully.
method.l: तांदूळ वीस मिनटांच भिजयात, ते परस चड न्हय, मागीर उदक सामकें देंवचें दियात.

method.en: Turn the drained rice in the spiced ghee before any water goes in — that is what keeps the grains separate.
method.l: उदक घालचेआदीं निथारिल्लो तांदूळ मसाल्याच्या तुपांत परतात — दाणे वेगवेगळे उरतात ते तेच खातीर.

method.en: One and a half measures of water to one of rice, and cover it tight.
method.l: एका वांटयाक दीड वांटो उदक, आनी घट्ट धांपात.

method.en: Ten minutes off the fire before the lid comes off.
method.l: झांकण उगडचेआदीं धा मिनटां उजो पालवून दवरात.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head in the two months peas are twenty rupees a kilo, and it is shelled by whoever is sitting in the courtyard at four.
recipes.why_l: जे दोन म्हयने वाटाणे वीस रुपया किलो आसतात तेदना अठरा रुपया दर मनशाक; चार वरांचेर अंगणांत बसिल्ले जे कोण, ते सोलतात.

start.en: Soak twenty minutes. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: वीस मिनटां भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं सत्तर मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot with a heavy lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जड झांकणासयत ४० ली. आयदन. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kaju Bhat
recipes.sub: Rice with fried cashew and whole spice
recipes.sub_l: तळिल्ले काजू आनी खडे मसाल्यांसयत भात

method.en: Fry the cashew separately and hold it back — cashew cooked with the rice goes soft and tastes of nothing.
method.l: काजू वेगळे तळात आनी दवरात — भाता वांगडा शिजयल्ले काजू मऊ जातात आनी तांची रूच उरना.

method.en: The raisins go into the hot ghee only until they swell.
method.l: बेदाणे हुन तुपांत फकत फुगसर.

method.en: Cook the rice by the draining method for a hall this size — a measured-water pot of forty litres is a gamble.
method.l: इतले व्हडले पंगतीखातीर भात निथारून रांदात — चाळीस लीटरांत मापाचें उदक म्हळ्यार जुगार.

method.en: Fold the cashew and raisin in at the counter.
method.l: काजू आनी बेदाणे वाडपाच्या जाग्यार भरसात.

recipes.why: Thirty-six rupees a head. Bicholim's cashew is bought at the plantation gate in April for half the market rate and a kilo and a half feeds a hundred.
recipes.why_l: छत्तीस रुपया दर मनशाक. डिचोलेचो काजू एप्रीलांत बागायतीच्या दारांत बाजाराच्या अर्द्या दरान मेळटा, आनी दीड किलो शंबर जणांक पुरो.

start.en: Fry the cashew first. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं काजू तळात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 60 L pot, a draining basket and a kadhai. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ६० ली. आयदन, निथारपाची टोपली आनी कायल. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Limbya Bhat
recipes.sub: Lime rice with mustard and curry leaf

method.en: Cook the rice, spread it on a tray and let it go cold before anything is mixed in.
method.l: भात रांदात, ताटांत पातळावन थंड जावंक दियात, मागीरच कांय भरसात.

method.en: Lime juice must never see the flame — squeezed into a hot vessel it turns bitter within minutes.
method.l: लिंबाचो रोस उज्याक दिसचो न्हय — हुन आयदनांत पिळ्ळ्यार मिनटांनी तो कडू जाता.

method.en: Temper the dals until they are the colour of straw; they are the crunch in the dish.
method.l: दाळी सुकिल्ल्या गवताच्या रंगाच्यो जासर फोडणींत भाजात; पदार्थांतलो करकरीतपणा तोच.

method.en: Fold with two flat spatulas rather than a ladle.
method.l: डावा परस दोन चपट्या उलथण्यांनी भरसात.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head, no gravy, and it holds three hours in a hot box — which is why it is what travels to a village programme.
recipes.why_l: चवदा रुपया दर मनशाक, रोस ना, आनी हुन पेटयेंत तीन वरां रावता — देखून गांवच्या कार्यावळीक हेंच वता.

start.en: Cook and cool the rice first. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं भात रांदून थंड करात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 60 L pot, wide trays and a kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ६० ली. आयदन, रुंद ताटां आनी कायल. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Dahi Bhat
recipes.sub: Curd rice with ginger and pomegranate

method.en: Overcook the rice on purpose and mash it a little — a grainy curd rice is a salad, not a curd rice.
method.l: भात मुद्दाम चड शिजयात आनी थोडो कुसकुरात — दाणेदार दंय भात म्हळ्यार कोशिंबीर, दंय भात न्हय.

method.en: A little milk with the curd keeps it from going sour by the second hour on the counter.
method.l: दंया वांगडा थोडें दूद घाल्यार तो काउंटरार दुसऱ्या वरामेरेन आंबट जायना.

method.en: Cool the rice fully before the curd goes in.
method.l: दंय घालचेआदीं भात सामको थंड करात.

method.en: Pomegranate at the counter; put in early it bleeds pink through the whole vessel.
method.l: डाळिंब वाडपाच्या जाग्यार; पयलीं घाल्यार आख्खें आयदन गुलाबी जाता.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head and it needs no sabji, no dal and no roti beside it. In May the queue asks for it by name.
recipes.why_l: सत्रा रुपया दर मनशाक; वांगडा भाजी, दाळ वा पोळी कांयच नाका. मेयांत रांगेंतले नांव घेवन तेंच मागतात.

start.en: Cook and cool the rice first. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं भात रांदून थंड करात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 60 L pot and two 30 L drums. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ६० ली. आयदन आनी दोन ३० ली. ड्रम. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Fodnicho Bhat
recipes.sub: Yesterday's rice tempered and served hot
recipes.sub_l: कालचो भात फोडणी घालून हुनसाण वाडिल्लो

method.en: Only rice that was cooled within an hour of cooking and kept cold overnight goes in this vessel — rice left standing warm is not safe and no tempering will fix that.
method.l: शिजयल्ल्या एका वरा भितर थंड केल्लो आनी रातभर थंड दवरिल्लो भातच ह्या आयदनांत घालात — हुनसाण उरिल्लो भात सुरक्षीत न्हय आनी फोडणी तें सुदारची ना.

method.en: Break the lumps by hand before the pan is lit.
method.l: आयदन उज्यार दवरचेआदीं हातान गुठळ्यो मोडात.

method.en: Heat it right through, not merely warm — a hot centre is the whole point.
method.l: सामकें भितरमेरेन हुन करात, फकत कोमट न्हय — मदलो हुनसाणपणा तोच मुद्दो.

method.en: Lime and coriander off the fire.
method.l: लिंबू आनी कोथमीर उजो पालवून.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head out of eighteen kilos that would otherwise go to the compost pit. A kitchen this size cooks twenty kilos too much every second day.
recipes.why_l: जे अठरा किलो ना जाल्यार खत खणयेंत वतले, तातूंतल्यान आठ रुपया दर मनशाक. इतले व्हडले रांदणकुडींत दर दुसऱ्या दिसा वीस किलो चड शिजता.

start.en: The rice must have been cold overnight. Twenty-five minutes of work.
start.l: भात रातभर थंड आशिल्लो जाय. पंचवीस मिनटांचें काम.

vessel.en: A 40 L kadhai and two flat spatulas. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. कायल आनी दोन चपटीं उलथणीं. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Rice Bhakri
recipes.sub: Flatbread from parboiled rice flour

method.en: Pour boiling water onto the rice flour, not the flour into the water, and stir hard with a wooden spoon.
method.l: उकडटें उदक पिठाचेर घालात, पीठ उदकांत न्हय.

method.en: Boiling water, not warm. Rice flour has no gluten and it is the heat that gelatinises the starch — that is the only thing holding the bhakri together.
method.l: उकडटें उदक, कोमट न्हय. तांदळाच्या पिठांत ग्लुटेन ना.

method.en: Work the fresh grated coconut into the hot dough. It is what keeps a rice bhakri from going hard within the hour.
method.l: गरम पिठांत खवयल्लो नाल्ल मळात. तोच भाकरी घट्ट जावंक दिना.

method.en: Knead as soon as it can be handled, while still genuinely hot. A cooled dough will not come together and cannot be rescued.
method.l: हातांत घेवंक जाता तेन्ना, गरम आसतनाच मळात.

method.en: Pat between two oiled sheets rather than rolling on a floured board, and keep the dough covered — it dries within minutes.
method.l: तेल लायिल्ल्या दोन कागदांमदीं थापात, आनी पीठ झांपून दवरात.

method.en: Cook on a medium tawa and expect a shorter shelf than a wheat roti. These are made to the line.
method.l: मध्यम तव्यार भाजात. ह्यो वाडपाच्या वेळारच करच्यो.

recipes.why: Boiling water, hot hands, and coconut in the dough. The coconut is what buys it an extra half hour.
recipes.why_l: उकडटें उदक, गरम हात, आनी पिठांत नाल्ल.

start.en: The dough must be made with boiling water and used hot.
start.l: पीठ उकडत्या उदकान मळचें आनी गरम आसतनाच वापरचें.

vessel.en: Four heavy tawas. Four cooks.
vessel.l: चार जड तवे. चार रांदपी.

season.en: All year. Goa is rice country and this section is thin for that reason.

recipes.name: Poori
recipes.sub: Fried wheat puri

method.en: Knead a stiff dough — stiffer than for a roti — with a spoon of oil worked in, and rest it only twenty minutes.
method.l: घट्ट पीठ मळात, आनी फकत वीस मिनटां दवरात.

method.en: A soft or long-rested dough drinks oil. A puri dough should feel almost too firm to roll.
method.l: मोव वा चड वेळ दवरिल्लें पीठ तेल पियेता.

method.en: Add a handful of fine semolina to the flour. It keeps the puri crisp for the twenty minutes it takes to reach the hall.
method.l: पिठांत मूठभर बारीक रवो घालात. तो पुरी कुरकुरीत दवरता.

method.en: Roll on a lightly oiled board rather than a floured one. Loose flour burns in the kadhai and darkens the oil within two batches.
method.l: पिठाच्या पोळपाटार न्हय, तेल लायिल्ल्या फळयेर लाटात.

method.en: Fry in hot oil, pressing the centre with a slotted spoon so the puri puffs in one go.
method.l: गरम तेलांत तळात, मदें दामून एकाच फावटीं फुगयात.

method.en: Drain on mesh, never in a heap. Puri steaming on each other go soft within minutes.
method.l: जाळयेर काडात, रास घालचे न्हय.

recipes.why: Stiff dough, semolina in the flour, and an oiled board. All three are about keeping oil out of the puri.
recipes.why_l: घट्ट पीठ, रवो, आनी तेल लायिल्लो पोळपाट.

start.en: Rest the dough twenty minutes. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: पीठ वीस मिनटां दवरात.

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: तीन खोल कढयो आनी दोन पोळपाट. चार रांदपी.

recipes.name: Chapati
recipes.sub: Plain wheat flatbread

method.en: Knead soft — softer than feels right. A stiff dough gives a chapati that will not puff no matter how hot the flame.
method.l: मोव मळात — दिसता तापरस चड मोव.

method.en: Rest thirty minutes under a damp cloth so the flour takes up the water fully.
method.l: वल्ल्या कापडाखाला तीस मिनटां दवरात.

method.en: Knead again briefly after the rest, then divide into equal balls.
method.l: उपरांत परत थोडें मळात आनी सारक्यो उंडयो करात.

method.en: Roll evenly. A chapati thicker in the middle than at the edge will puff only at the rim.
method.l: सारकें लाटात. मदें जाड आसल्यार फकत देगेर फुगता.

method.en: Cook the first side lightly, the second until spots appear, then move it onto the open flame where it should balloon in seconds.
method.l: एक वटेन थोडें, दुसरे वटेन ठिपके येसर, मागीर उगत्या उज्यार.

method.en: Smear coconut oil rather than ghee and stack in a cloth-lined basket. The oil is the one thing that places this in Goa.
method.l: तुपाबदला नाल्लाचें तेल लावात. तेंच हिका गोंयची करता.

recipes.why: Soft dough, even rolling, open flame — and coconut oil rather than ghee.
recipes.why_l: मोव पीठ, सारकें लाटप, उगतो उजो — आनी तुपाबदला नाल्लाचें तेल.

start.en: Rest the dough thirty minutes. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: पीठ तीस मिनटां दवरात.

vessel.en: Six tawas and an open flame. Six cooks.
vessel.l: स तवे आनी उगतो उजो. स रांदपी.

season.en: All year. Wheat is brought in rather than grown here.

recipes.name: Nachne Bhakri
recipes.sub: Ragi rotis patted by hand

method.en: Knead with boiling water in small lots — ragi has nothing to hold it and a cold-water dough falls apart on the tawa.
method.l: उकडपी उदकान थोडें थोडें मळात — नाचणीक धरून दवरपाक कांयच ना आनी थंड उदकाचें पीठ तव्यार मोडून पडटा.

method.en: Have the flour milled the same week; ragi turns bitter within a month of milling.
method.l: पीठ त्याच सप्तकांत दळून घेयात; दळ्ळे उपरांत म्हयन्याभितर नाचणी कडू जाता.

method.en: Pat each bhakri between wet palms on a plantain leaf rather than rolling it.
method.l: दर भाकरी लाटचे परस ओल्या तळहातांनी केळीच्या पानार थापात.

method.en: Cook slow on a heavy tawa, wet the top face once, and let it puff.
method.l: जड तव्यार धिम्यान भाजात, वयली वटेन एक खेप उदक लावात आनी फुगूंक दियात.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head. Ragi is cheaper than wheat here and it is what the hill villages behind Sanguem have eaten at night for as long as anyone remembers.
recipes.why_l: इकरा रुपया दर मनशाक. हांगा नाचणी गंवा परस सवाय, आनी सांगेफाटले दोंगराळ गांव जेदनासावन याद आसा तेदनासावन रातचें हेंच खातात.

start.en: Knead with boiling water. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: उकडपी उदकान मळात. वाडपाआदीं सत्तर मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: Four heavy tawas and plantain leaves. Four cooks.
vessel.l: चार जड तवे आनी केळीचीं पानां. चार रांदपी.

recipes.name: Ukdya Pithachi Roti
recipes.sub: Steamed rice dough patted thin
recipes.sub_l: उकडिल्ल्या तांदळाच्या पिठाची पातळ थापिल्ली रोटी

method.en: Bring the water to a hard boil with salt and oil before the flour goes anywhere near it.
method.l: पीठ लागींय हाडचेआदीं उदक मीठ आनी तेलासयत बरें उकडात.

method.en: Take the pot off the fire, rain the flour in and stir once, then cover it for ten minutes without touching it.
method.l: आयदन उज्यावयल्यान काडात, पीठ भुरकयात, एकदा घुसळात आनी धा मिनटां हात लायनासतना धांपून दवरात.

method.en: Knead it while it is almost too hot to hold; cooled, the dough will not come together at all.
method.l: हातांत धरूंक जायना इतलें हुनसाण आसतनाच मळात; थंड जाल्यार पीठ एकठांयच येना.

method.en: Pat thin on an oiled sheet and cook on a medium tawa.
method.l: तेल लायिल्ल्या चादरीचेर पातळ थापात आनी मध्यम तव्यार भाजात.

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head with no wheat in it at all, which matters on a shelf where wheat is brought in from outside the state and rice is grown across the road.
recipes.why_l: धा रुपया दर मनशाक आनी तातूंत गंव मात ना — ज्या फळयेर गंव भायल्यान हाडटात आनी तांदूळ रस्त्या पलतडी पिकता, थंय हें म्हत्वाचें.

start.en: Steam the dough first. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं पीठ उकडात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot and four tawas. Four cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी चार तवे. चार रांदपी.

recipes.name: Godachi Poli
recipes.sub: Jaggery and coconut sealed inside wheat
recipes.sub_l: गंवाच्या पिठांत बंद केल्लो गोड आनी नाल्ल

method.en: Cook the coconut and jaggery until the mixture pulls away from the pan and no syrup runs off a spoon.
method.l: नाल्ल आनी गोड आयदनाची देग सोडसर शिजयात आनी चमच्यावयल्यान पाक देंवचो न्हय.

method.en: Cool the filling completely before it is put in — warm filling steams inside and splits the poli on the tawa.
method.l: भरणी सामकी थंड करून मागीरच भरात — हुनसाण भरणी भितर वाफ करता आनी तव्यार पोळी फुटता.

method.en: Rest the dough an hour with ghee rubbed in; a rested dough stretches around the filling instead of tearing.
method.l: पिठाक तूप लावन एक वर दवरात; दवरिल्लें पीठ भरणेभोंवतणी ओडटा, फाटना.

method.en: Roll from the centre out, turning it a quarter after every stroke.
method.l: मदल्यान भायर लाटात, दर लाटपाउपरांत पावपट घुंवडावन.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees a head. This is what a Goan household makes for a festival, and a hundred and fifty of them can be rolled by six hands in two hours.
recipes.why_l: चोवीस रुपया दर मनशाक. गोंयकार घर फेस्ताखातीर हेंच करता, आनी स हातांनी दोन वरांनी दिडशें पोळ्यो लाटूंक जातात.

start.en: Make and cool the filling first. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं भरणी करून थंड करात. वाडपाआदीं तीन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A heavy kadhai, a rolling table and four tawas. Six cooks.
vessel.l: जड कायल, लाटपाची मेज आनी चार तवे. स रांदपी.

recipes.name: Methichi Poli
recipes.sub: Fenugreek leaves kneaded into the dough

method.en: Chop the methi fine, salt it ten minutes and squeeze it — that water is bitter and it is also what makes the dough sticky.
method.l: मेथी बारीक कातरात, धा मिनटां मीठ लावात आनी पिळात — तें उदक कडू आसता आनी पीठ चिकट करता.

method.en: Knead with no extra water at all for the first ten minutes; the leaves give more than you expect.
method.l: पयलीं धा मिनटां उदक मात घालूं नाकात; पानां तुमी सोचता ते परस चड सोडटात.

method.en: The besan keeps the poli soft two hours after it comes off the tawa.
method.l: बेसनाक लागून पोळी तव्यावयल्यान देंविल्या उपरांत दोन वरां मऊ उरता.

method.en: Cook on a medium tawa with oil at the edge.
method.l: मध्यम तव्यार देगेक तेल घालून भाजात.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head and it stands beside a plain dal when there is no sabji. Methi is fifteen rupees a bundle in December and the leaves keep two days.
recipes.why_l: बारा रुपया दर मनशाक; भाजी नासल्यार सादे दाळी वांगडा हीच पुरो. डिसेंबरांत मेथी पंदरा रुपया जुडी आनी पानां दोन दीस रावतात.

start.en: Salt and squeeze the leaves first. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं पानांक मीठ लावन पिळात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: Four tawas and a kneading trough. Four cooks.
vessel.l: चार तवे आनी मळपाची टांकी. चार रांदपी.

recipes.name: Nariyalachi Poli
recipes.sub: Savoury coconut stuffed flatbread

method.en: Dry-roast the coconut two minutes only, until it smells but has not coloured.
method.l: नाल्ल फकत दोन मिनटां सुको भाजात — वास येसर, रंग बदलचेआदीं.

method.en: Do not salt the filling until the last minute; salted early, coconut weeps and the poli tears.
method.l: भरणेंत मीठ निमाण्या मिनटाक घालात; पयलीं घाल्यार नाल्ल उदक सोडटा आनी पोळी फाटता.

method.en: Seal with the fingers and press the edges before the middle.
method.l: बोटांनीं बंद करात आनी मदल्याआदीं देगो दाबात.

method.en: Cook on a medium tawa; a hot tawa browns the outside before the coconut inside has warmed.
method.l: मध्यम तव्यार भाजात; तापिल्ल्या तव्यार भितरलो नाल्ल हुन जावचेआदीं भायर रंग येता.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head and it needs nothing beside it but a chutney — one bread instead of a bread and a sabji, which on a busy morning is a whole vessel and one cook saved.
recipes.why_l: सत्रा रुपया दर मनशाक; वांगडा फकत चटणी पुरो — पोळी आनी भाजी बदला फकत पोळी; व्यस्त सकाळीं म्हळ्यार एक आयदन आनी एक रांदपी वाटयलो.

start.en: Make the filling first. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं भरणी करात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A tawa for roasting, a rolling table and four tawas. Five cooks.
vessel.l: भाजपाक एक तवो, लाटपाची मेज आनी चार तवे. पांच रांदपी.

recipes.name: Tendli Bhaji
recipes.sub: Ivy gourd with coconut

method.en: Slice the tendli lengthways into quarters rather than into rounds. Rounds go soft and lose their bite; lengths hold it.
method.l: तेंडलीं लांबट चार वांटे करात, गोल चकत्यो न्हय.

method.en: Discard any tendli that is red inside. An overripe one is cottony and one of them spoils a whole batch.
method.l: भितर तांबडें आशिल्लें तेंडलें उडयात.

method.en: Temper mustard, urad dal, dry chilli and curry leaf in coconut oil, waiting for the dal to turn gold before the leaf goes in.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव, उडीद डाळ, मिरसांग आनी कढीपत्तो तडतडयात.

method.en: Fry on a medium flame with the lid off for the first ten minutes, then cover for eight. Tendli needs both — uncovered it stays raw, covered throughout it goes grey.
method.l: पयलीं धा मिनटां उगतें, मागीर आठ मिनटां झांपून.

method.en: Add a little jaggery. It is not for sweetness — it balances the faint bitterness that tendli always carries.
method.l: थोडो गोड घालात. तो गोडपणाक न्हय, तेंडल्याचो कडवटपणा उणो करता.

method.en: Stir the fresh grated coconut in off the fire. Cooked in, coconut goes stringy and grey.
method.l: उजो बंद करून खवयल्लो नाल्ल भरसात.

recipes.why: Lengthways, half covered, and coconut off the fire. Three small things and all three show on the plate.
recipes.why_l: लांबट कापप, अर्दें झांपप, आनी उजो बंद करून नाल्ल.

start.en: Cut the tendli an hour ahead. Start forty-five minutes before serving.
start.l: तेंडलीं एक वर आदीं कापात.

vessel.en: Two wide 30 L kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: दोन रुंद ३० ली. कढयो. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: All year, cheapest October to February.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स, ऑक्टोबर ते फेब्रुवारी सवाय.

recipes.name: Batata Bhaji
recipes.sub: Potato with mustard and curry leaf

method.en: Boil the potatoes the day before and chill them. Cold potato breaks into clean pieces; warm potato mashes at a touch.
method.l: बटाट आदल्या दिसा उकडून थंड करात.

method.en: Break them by hand rather than cutting — torn faces hold the tempering.
method.l: कापचे न्हय, हातान मोडात.

method.en: Temper mustard and urad dal in coconut oil and wait for the dal to turn gold. That gold is the signal and nothing else is.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव आनी उडीद डाळ घालात आनी डाळ सोनेरी जावसर रावात.

method.en: Add a generous amount of asafoetida. There is no onion here and this is what carries the base.
method.l: भरपूर हिंग घालात. हांगा कांदो ना.

method.en: Add the potato with turmeric and salt and toss with a flat ladle, cooking eight minutes.
method.l: बटाट, हळद आनी मीठ घालात आनी सपाट डावान परतात, आठ मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Stir the fresh coconut in off the fire and finish with lemon and a great deal of coriander.
method.l: उजो बंद करून नाल्ल भरसात आनी लिंब आनी भरपूर कोथिंबीर घालात.

recipes.why: Coconut oil, urad dal in the tempering, and coconut off the fire. Three things and all three are Goan.
recipes.why_l: नाल्लाचें तेल, तडक्यांत उडीद डाळ, आनी उजो बंद करून नाल्ल.

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: बटाट आदल्या सांजेक उकडात.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: रुंद ३० ली. कढई. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Mooga Gathi
recipes.sub: Sprouted moong with coconut, dry

method.en: Sprout the moong for a day and a half until the tail is about the length of the grain. Longer and it turns fibrous.
method.l: मूग दीड दीस मोडयात, मोड दाण्याइतलो लांब जावसर.

method.en: Steam the sprouts eight minutes rather than boiling them. Boiled sprouts go soft and a gathi is meant to have bite.
method.l: मोड उकडचेबदला आठ मिनटां वाफेर शिजयात.

method.en: Drain them thoroughly. A gathi is a dry dish and any water left turns it into a ghashi.
method.l: पुरायपणान उदक काडात. गाठी सुकी आसता.

method.en: Temper mustard, green chilli and curry leaf in coconut oil with a generous amount of asafoetida.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव, मिरसांग आनी कढीपत्तो, भरपूर हिंगाकडेन तडतडयात.

method.en: Add a little jaggery and lemon together. Goan cooking balances sweet against sour in almost every dish and this is the plainest example of it.
method.l: थोडो गोड आनी लिंब एकठांय घालात. गोंयचें रांदप गोड आनी आंबट एकठांय हाडटा.

method.en: Stir the fresh grated coconut in off the fire. This is a gathi and not a ghashi precisely because the coconut is raw and dry.
method.l: उजो बंद करून खवयल्लो नाल्ल भरसात.

recipes.why: Steamed not boiled, and raw coconut at the end. Both are what make a gathi rather than a ghashi.
recipes.why_l: उकडचें न्हय, वाफेर; आनी निमाणें कच्चो नाल्ल.

start.en: Sprout the moong two days ahead. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: मूग दोन दीस आदीं मोडयात.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: रुंद ३० ली. कढई. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Sukhi Bhaji
recipes.sub: Mixed greens with coconut

method.en: Alsande leaves, amaranth, taro leaf, drumstick leaf and radish greens all work. Keep the tender and the tough separate.
method.l: आळसांद्याचीं पानां, तांबडी भाजी, आळू, शेवगो — सगळीं चलतात.

method.en: Wash in three changes of water. Greens grown in a Goan monsoon come in with a great deal of grit.
method.l: तीन फावटीं धुयात. पावसाळ्यांतल्या भाजयेंत माती चड.

method.en: Fry on a high flame with the lid off. A lid traps the water and the whole kadhai turns to a wet green mass.
method.l: व्हड उज्यार, उगतें ठेवन परतात. झांपल्यार सगळें वल्लें जाता.

method.en: Add the tough stems four minutes before the leaves.
method.l: घट्ट देंठ पानांआदीं चार मिनटां घालात.

method.en: Salt only in the last two minutes. Greens salted early collapse and release everything they hold.
method.l: मीठ निमाण्या दोन मिनटांनीं घालात.

method.en: Stir the fresh grated coconut in off the fire. Six minutes on the fire, no more.
method.l: उजो बंद करून नाल्ल भरसात. उज्यार स मिनटां, चड न्हय.

recipes.why: No lid, late salt, coconut off the fire. Six minutes and it is done.
recipes.why_l: झांपचें न्हय, उशीरां मीठ, उजो बंद करून नाल्ल.

start.en: Wash three times. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: तीन फावटीं धुयात.

vessel.en: Two wide 30 L kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: दोन रुंद ३० ली. कढयो. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: June to October, while the monsoon greens are in.
season.l: जून ते ऑक्टोबर, पावसाळी भाजी आसतना.

recipes.name: Kadgi Chakko
recipes.sub: Raw jackfruit cooked dry with roasted coconut
recipes.sub_l: भाजिल्ल्या नाल्लासयत सुको रांदिल्लो कच्चो फणस

method.en: Oil the knife and both hands before the jackfruit is opened.
method.l: फणस उगडचेआदीं सुरी आनी दोनूय हात तेलान माखात.

method.en: Boil the pieces in salted water first and throw that water — it carries the sap.
method.l: कुडके पयलीं मिठाच्या उदकांत उकडात आनी तें उदक उडयात — चीक तातूंत वता.

method.en: Roast the coconut to the colour of wet earth; a chakko made with raw coconut is only a boiled vegetable.
method.l: नाल्ल ओल्या मातयेच्या रंगाचो जासर भाजात; कच्च्या नाल्लाचो चक्को म्हळ्यार फकत उकडिल्ली भाजी.

method.en: Finish it dry, with the masala clinging to each piece.
method.l: सुको सोंपयात, मसालो दर कुडक्याक चिकटून उरचो.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head in the two months a raw jackfruit off the temple land is free and every household in Canacona is cooking the same thing.
recipes.why_l: जे दोन म्हयने देवळाच्या जमनींतलो कच्चो फणस फुकट आसता आनी काणकोणांतलें दर घर तेंच रांदता, तेदना नोव रुपया दर मनशाक.

start.en: Clean, boil, then cook. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: निवळावात, उकडात, मागीर रांदात. वाडपाआदीं अडेच वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: An oiled board, a 30 L pot and a kadhai. Three cooks.
vessel.l: तेल लायिल्लो फळो, ३० ली. आयदन आनी कायल. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Vaingan Bhaji
recipes.sub: Brinjal cooked dry with coconut and teppal
recipes.sub_l: नाल्ल आनी तिरफळासयत सुकी रांदिल्ली वांयगणां

method.en: Cut into water so the flesh does not blacken before the pan is hot.
method.l: कापून उदकांत घालात, जाका करून आयदन तापचेआदीं गर काळो जावचो न्हय.

method.en: Fry the pieces in oil first, on a high flame, before any masala.
method.l: मसालो घालचेआदीं कुडके व्हड उज्यार तेलांत भाजात.
