method.en: Crack the teppal and discard the black seed; the husk is what is wanted and the seed is bitter.
method.l: तिरफळ फोडून काळी बी उडयात; जाय ती फकत साल, बी कडू आसता.

method.en: Cook uncovered — a covered brinjal steams and goes to pulp.
method.l: धांपनासतना रांदात — धांपल्यार वांयगण वाफेन गरो जाता.

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head. Brinjal is twenty rupees a kilo all winter, and the teppal is what makes this a Bicholim dish rather than any dry brinjal from anywhere.
recipes.why_l: धा रुपया दर मनशाक. आख्खे थंडेंत वांयगणां वीस रुपया किलो, आनी तिरफळाक लागूनच ही खंयचीय सुकी वांयगणां न्हय, तर डिचोलेची भाजी जाता.

start.en: Cut into water, fry, then cook. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: उदकांत कापात, भाजात, मागीर रांदात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Bhende Upkari
recipes.sub: Okra fried dry with mustard and coconut
recipes.sub_l: सांसव आनी नाल्लासयत सुकी तळिल्ली भेंडी

method.en: Wash the okra the evening before and dry it overnight on a cloth — a drop of water and eleven kilos turn to glue.
method.l: भेंडयो एक सांज आदीं धुवन कापडार रातभर सुकयात — उदकाचो एक थेंब आनी इकरा किलो चिकट जातात.

method.en: Cut with a dry knife on a dry board and wipe the blade every few minutes.
method.l: सुक्या सुऱ्यान सुक्या फळ्यार कापात आनी दर थोड्या मिनटांनी पातें पुसात.

method.en: High flame, uncovered, and do not stir for the first five minutes.
method.l: व्हड उजो, धांपनासतना, आनी पयलीं पांच मिनटां घुसळूंक नाकात.

method.en: Coconut at the very end, off the fire.
method.l: नाल्ल सामकें निमाणें, उजो पालवून.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees a head, and it comes off the fire in twenty minutes — the sabji cooked when a group arrives unannounced at noon.
recipes.why_l: तेरा रुपया दर मनशाक आनी वीस मिनटांनी उज्यावयल्यान देंवता — कळयनासतना दनपारां पंगड आयलो जाल्यार हीच भाजी करतात.

start.en: Wash and dry the night before. Twenty-five minutes on the fire.
start.l: आदल्या रातीं धुवन सुकयात. पंचवीस मिनटां उज्यार.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai and dry boards. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल आनी सुके फळे. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Suranachi Bhaji
recipes.sub: Elephant foot yam fried with tamarind

method.en: Boil the cut pieces once in water with tamarind in it and throw that water — that is what takes the itch out.
method.l: कातरिल्ले कुडके चिंचेच्या उदकांत एक खेप उकडात आनी तें उदक उडयात — खाज तेच वयल्यान वता.

method.en: Rub oil on the hands before peeling; the raw skin itches for hours afterwards.
method.l: साल काडचेआदीं हातांक तेल लायात; कच्च्या सालीन वरांमेरेन खाज सुटता.

method.en: Fry the boiled pieces until the edges are brown before the masala goes on.
method.l: मसालो घालचेआदीं उकडिल्ले कुडके देगो तांबश्यो जासर तळात.

method.en: Tamarind again at the end, and jaggery to hold it.
method.l: निमाणें परत चिंच, आनी ती सांबाळपाक गोड.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head. Yam keeps three months in a dry corner of the store, which is what a monsoon kitchen twenty kilometres from a market needs.
recipes.why_l: इकरा रुपया दर मनशाक. सुरण भंडाराच्या सुक्या कोनशांत तीन म्हयने रावता — बाजारा सावन वीस किलोमीटर पयस आशिल्ल्या पावसाळी रांदणकुडीक तेंच जाय.

start.en: Peel, boil once, then fry. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: साल काडात, एक खेप उकडात, मागीर तळात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot and a kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी कायल. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Khatkhatem
recipes.sub: Mixed vegetables and dal with teppal

method.en: Khatkhatem is the great Goan temple dish and it is already made without onion or garlic. Nothing in this recipe is an adaptation.
method.l: खतखतें हें गोंयच्या देवळाचें मुखेल जिनस आनी तें आदींच कांदो-लसणाबगर करतात.

method.en: The vegetables should be at least five and traditionally an odd number — pumpkin, sweet potato, raw banana, breadfruit, yam, drumstick, beans. Cut them large.
method.l: भाजी किमान पांच आनी परंपरेन विजोड संख्येन — कोंवळें, कणगां, कच्चीं केळीं, नीरफणस, शेवगो.

method.en: Cut everything large and add them in order of hardness, twenty minutes apart. A khatkhatem in which everything has collapsed is a failed one.
method.l: सगळें व्हड कापात आनी घट्टपणाप्रमाण वीस मिनटांच्या अंतरान घालात.

method.en: Do not roast the coconut. This is a pale gravy and roasted coconut turns it into a tonak.
method.l: नाल्ल भाजचो न्हय. हो फिकट रस.

method.en: Crush the teppal at the last moment and stir it in off the fire. Boiled, teppal goes bitter and numbs the mouth, and this is the dish it exists for.
method.l: तेप्पल निमाण्या घडयेक चुरडून उजो बंद करून घालात.

method.en: Balance the kokum against the jaggery at the very end. A khatkhatem should land sweet first, then sour, then the teppal.
method.l: निमाणें कोकम आनी गोड सांबाळात. खतखतें पयलीं गोड, मागीर आंबट, मागीर तेप्पल.

recipes.why: Already onion-free, teppal off the fire, and an odd number of vegetables cut large. This is the dish this book exists to record.
recipes.why_l: आदींच कांद्याबगर, उजो बंद करून तेप्पल, आनी विजोड भाजी व्हड कापिल्ली.

start.en: Soak the toor dal one hour, cut the vegetables an hour ahead. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: तुरीची डाळ एक वर भिजयात, भाजी एक वर आदीं कापात.

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ५० ली. जड आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: Festivals, and it is the dish of the Goan temple feast.
season.l: फेस्तां — गोंयच्या देवळाच्या जेवणाचें मुखेल जिनस.

recipes.name: Vaingan Tonak
recipes.sub: Brinjal in roasted coconut gravy

method.en: Cut the brinjal into large chunks and drop them straight into salted water. Brinjal blackens within a minute of being cut.
method.l: वांगीं व्हड फोडींनीं कापून सिदीं मिठाच्या उदकांत घालात.

method.en: Roast the grated coconut in a dry pan on a low flame for twenty minutes until it is a deep even brown, stirring constantly.
method.l: खवयल्लो नाल्ल सुक्या कढयेंत वीस मिनटां गडद तांबसार जावंक भाजात.

method.en: Deep brown, not golden. An under-roasted coconut gives a pale sweet gravy that is not a tonak at all.
method.l: गडद तांबसार, सोनेरी न्हय.

method.en: Grind everything with the tamarind to a very fine paste. A gritty tonak is a failed one.
method.l: चिंचेकडेन सगळें बारीक वाटात.

method.en: Fry the drained brinjal in coconut oil until the cut faces colour, then add the paste and water.
method.l: उदक काडिल्लीं वांगीं नाल्लाच्या तेलांत परतात, मागीर वाटण आनी उदक घालात.

method.en: Simmer twenty minutes and never let it boil hard — a coconut gravy splits at a rolling boil. Add the jaggery at the end.
method.l: वीस मिनटां उकडात, जोरान न्हय. गोड निमाणें घालात.

recipes.why: Twenty minutes on the coconut, ground fine, and never boiled hard. The same three rules as every tonak.
recipes.why_l: नाल्लाचेर वीस मिनटां, बारीक वाटप, आनी जोरान उकडचें न्हय.

start.en: Cut the brinjal into salted water an hour ahead. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: वांगीं कापून मिठाच्या उदकांत घालात.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai, a heavy pan and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: रुंद ४० ली. कढई, जड कढई आनी ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

recipes.name: Neerphanas Tonak
recipes.sub: Breadfruit in roasted coconut gravy

method.en: Oil the knife and the hands before cutting. Breadfruit bleeds a sticky white latex that sets like glue on a dry blade.
method.l: कापचेआदीं कातयाक आनी हातांक तेल लावात.

method.en: Wipe the blade with oil again every few fruit. After four or five the latex builds up and the knife stops cutting cleanly.
method.l: दर चार-पांच फळांक कातयो परत तेलान पुसात.

method.en: Cut into large chunks and drop them into salted water. Breadfruit browns faster than brinjal.
method.l: व्हड फोडी करून मिठाच्या उदकांत घालात.

method.en: Boil the breadfruit fifteen minutes in plain water before it goes into the gravy. It is denser than brinjal and will not soften in a coconut gravy alone.
method.l: रसांत घालचेआदीं नीरफणस साध्या उदकांत पंदरा मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Roast the coconut deep brown, grind fine with the tamarind, and simmer the boiled breadfruit in it for twenty minutes.
method.l: नाल्ल गडद तांबसार भाजात, चिंचेकडेन बारीक वाटात, आनी वीस मिनटां उकडात.

method.en: Never let it boil hard. A coconut gravy splits at a rolling boil and there is no recovering it.
method.l: जोरान उकडूंक दिवचें न्हय.

recipes.why: Boil it first, then the gravy. Breadfruit will not soften in coconut milk alone and four months a year is all you get.
recipes.why_l: पयलीं उकडात, मागीर रस. नीरफणस फकत नाल्लाच्या रसांत शिजना.

start.en: Oil the knife. Cut into salted water an hour ahead. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: कातयाक तेल लावात. कापून मिठाच्या उदकांत घालात.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai, a heavy pan and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: रुंद ४० ली. कढई, जड कढई आनी ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: March to July, while the breadfruit is on the tree.

recipes.name: Ambade Sasav
recipes.sub: Hog plum in mustard and coconut

method.en: Ambade are hog plums and they are ferociously sour. The jaggery here is not optional and the balance is what the dish is about.
method.l: आंबाडे बरेच आंबट. हांगा गोड मरजेचो न्हय — तोच समतोल हो जिनस.

method.en: Bruise each fruit with a pestle before it goes in the pot. An unbruised ambada keeps its sourness inside the skin and the gravy stays flat.
method.l: दर आंबाडो घालचेआदीं ठेचात. न ठेचिल्लो आंबाडो आपली आंबटाय भितरच दवरता.

method.en: Boil the ambade in plain water for fifteen minutes and taste the water. If it is unbearably sour, throw half of it away and top up.
method.l: आंबाडे साध्या उदकांत पंदरा मिनटां उकडात आनी उदक चाकात.

method.en: Soak the mustard seed thirty minutes and grind it with the coconut and chilli. Ground mustard turns bitter if it stands more than an hour.
method.l: सांसव तीस मिनटां भिजयात आनी नाल्ल आनी मिरसांगीकडेन वाटात.

method.en: Add the ground paste off the fire and warm it through only. A sasav must never boil — the mustard turns acrid and the whole pot is lost.
method.l: वाटण उजो बंद करून घालात आनी फकत कोमट करात. सासव केन्नाच उकडचें न्हय.

method.en: Balance the jaggery against the sourness at the very end, tasting as you go.
method.l: निमाणें गोड आनी आंबटपण सांबाळात.

recipes.why: Bruise the fruit, and never boil the mustard. Both are what make a sasav work.
recipes.why_l: फळ ठेचात, आनी सांसव केन्नाच उकडचें न्हय.

start.en: Grind the mustard an hour ahead. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: सांसव एक वर आदीं वाटात.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a wet grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी ओलो ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

season.en: June to September, when the ambade come in.
season.l: जून ते सप्टेंबर, आंबाडे येतात तेन्ना.

recipes.name: Bibbyachem Tonak
recipes.sub: Tender cashew in a roasted coconut gravy

method.en: Boil the bibbe fifteen minutes in salted water and throw that water — raw tender cashew is sharp on the throat.
method.l: बिब्बे मिठाच्या उदकांत पंदरा मिनटां उकडात आनी तें उदक उडयात — कच्चे बिब्बे गळ्याक तोखतात.

method.en: Roast the coconut dark and grind it with the whole spices and tamarind.
method.l: नाल्ल गडद भाजात आनी खड्या मसाल्यांसयत आनी चिंचेसयत वाटात.

method.en: Simmer the bibbe in the masala twenty minutes so they take it in; they are bland on their own.
method.l: बिब्बे मसाल्यांत वीस मिनटां धिम्या उज्यार शिजयात, जाका करून मसालो भितर वता; ते एकटे सपक आसतात.

method.en: It thickens as it stands; keep it looser than it looks right.
method.l: दवरल्या उपरांत तें घट्ट जाता; दिसता ते परस पातळ दवरात.

recipes.why: Thirty-four rupees a head and it can be cooked only in March and April. In Bicholim a bibbe tonak on the plate is what tells a guest the feast is a real one.
recipes.why_l: चौतीस रुपया दर मनशाक आनी हें फकत मार्च आनी एप्रीलांतच जाता. डिचोलेंत ताटांतलें बिब्ब्याचें तोणाक सोयऱ्याक सांगता की फेस्त खरें आसा.

start.en: Boil, roast, grind, simmer. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: उकडात, भाजात, वाटात, शिजयात. वाडपाआदीं तीन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a heavy tawa and a grinder. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, जड तवो आनी ग्राइंडर. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Dudhi Ghashi
recipes.sub: Bottle gourd and chana in raw coconut gravy
recipes.sub_l: कच्च्या नाल्लाच्या रोसांत दुदयो आनी चणे

method.en: Taste a slice of every gourd before it is cut in.
method.l: दर दुदयेची एक चाक कापचेआदीं चाकात.

method.en: Grind the coconut raw for a ghashi — the moment it is roasted the dish becomes a tonak and it is no longer this.
method.l: घशयेखातीर नाल्ल कच्चें वाटात — तें भाजलें की पदार्थ तोणाक जाता आनी हो उरना.

method.en: Cook the gourd only eight minutes; it should hold its cut edge.
method.l: दुदयो फकत आठ मिनटां शिजयात; कापिल्ली देग तशीच उरची.

method.en: Do not boil after the ground coconut goes in.
method.l: वाटिल्लो नाल्ल घाल्या उपरांत उकडूंक नाकात.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head and the boiled chana carries the plate so the gourd does not have to. Both are in the store at any time of the year.
recipes.why_l: बारा रुपया दर मनशाक; उकडिल्ले चणे ताट सांबाळटात, दुदयेक तें करचें पडना. दोनूय वर्साच्या खंयच्याय वेळार भंडारांत आसतात.

start.en: Boil the chana ahead. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: चणे आदींच उकडात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Karlyachem Ambat
recipes.sub: Bitter gourd in a thin sour coconut gravy

method.en: Slice, salt twenty minutes and squeeze — half the bitterness leaves in that water.
method.l: कातरात, वीस मिनटां मीठ लावात आनी पिळात — अर्दें कडूपण त्याच उदकांत वता.

method.en: The jaggery is not to sweeten it but to stand against the bitterness; without it the vessel comes back full.
method.l: गोड तें गोड करपाक न्हय, कडूपणाक तोंड दिवपाक; ताचेवीण आयदन भरिल्लेंच परत येता.

method.en: Cook the toor dal soft first — it is what carries the gravy.
method.l: पयलीं तुरीची दाळ मऊ शिजयात — रोसाक तीच व्हरता.

method.en: Kokum at the end and never boiled hard after.
method.l: कोकम निमाणें आनी ते उपरांत जोरान उकडूं नाकात.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head and it is the one thing on the shelf the elderly devotees ask for by name in the monsoon, when bitter gourd is at its cheapest and its best.
recipes.why_l: बारा रुपया दर मनशाक; पावसाळ्यांत, जेदना कारलीं सगळ्यांत सवाय आनी सगळ्यांत बरीं आसतात, तेदना म्हातारे भक्त नांव घेवन जें मागतात तें हेंच.

start.en: Salt and squeeze first. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं मीठ लावन पिळात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Sandgyachem Tonak
recipes.sub: Sun-dried lentil dumplings in a dark gravy

method.en: Fry the sandge in oil until they darken; unfried they stay hard however long they simmer.
method.l: सांडगे तेलांत रंग बदलसर तळात; बिनतळिल्ले कितलेय शिजयले तरी घट्ट उरतात.

method.en: Soak the fried sandge in hot water ten minutes and squeeze them.
method.l: तळिल्ले सांडगे हुन उदकांत धा मिनटां भिजयात आनी पिळात.

method.en: Roast the coconut dark and grind with tamarind and spice.
method.l: नाल्ल गडद भाजात आनी चिंच आनी मसाल्यासयत वाटात.

method.en: Put the sandge in for the last ten minutes only — earlier and they swallow the whole gravy.
method.l: सांडगे फकत निमण्या धा मिनटांक घालात — आदीं घाल्यार ते आख्खो रोस पियेतात.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head from two kilos made on the roof in May. In August, when a landslide has shut the road for two days, this is a vegetable out of a sack.
recipes.why_l: मेयांत गच्चीर केल्ल्या दोन किलोंतल्यान चवदा रुपया दर मनशाक. ऑगस्टांत, जेदना दरड कोसळून दोन दीस रस्तो बंद आसता, तेदना ही पोत्यांतली भाजी.

start.en: Fry and soak the sandge first. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं सांडगे तळून भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a kadhai and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, कायल आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Tomato Saar
recipes.sub: Thin tomato and coconut broth

method.en: Boil the tomatoes whole and press them through a strainer rather than grinding. A grinder pulps the skin and seeds in and turns the saar cloudy.
method.l: टोमॅटो आख्खे उकडात आनी चाळणींतल्यान दामात, दळचे न्हय.

method.en: Grind the fresh coconut with a little water and press it through muslin. Use the first pressing only — this is a thin broth, not a gravy.
method.l: ताजो नाल्ल थोड्या उदकाकडेन दळून मलमलांतल्यान पिळात. पयलेंच पिळप वापरात.

method.en: Add the coconut milk off the fire and warm it through only. A saar must never boil after the coconut goes in.
method.l: नाल्लाचें दूद उजो बंद करून घालात आनी फकत कोमट करात.

method.en: Add the jaggery. It is not for sweetness — it corrects the acidity of the tomato, and without it the saar tastes thin and sharp.
method.l: गोड घालात. तो गोडपणाक न्हय, टोमॅट्याची आंबटाय सारकी करता.

method.en: Temper mustard, curry leaf, dry chilli and asafoetida in coconut oil and pour it over at the end.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव, कढीपत्तो, मिरसांग आनी हिंग तडतडावन निमाणें घालात.

method.en: Serve it hot and thin. A saar is drunk from the bowl before the meal, not poured over rice.
method.l: गरम आनी पातळ वाडात. सार जेवणाआदीं वाटयेंतल्यान पियेतात.

recipes.why: Strained not ground, and never boiled after the coconut. Both are about it staying clear.
recipes.why_l: दळचें न्हय, गाळचें; आनी नाल्ल घातल्या उपरांत उकडचें न्हय.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: भिजोवंक ना. वाडपाआदीं पन्नास मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, a strainer and a grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन, चाळण आनी ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

season.en: All year, served hot before the meal.

recipes.name: Kakdi Koshimbir
recipes.sub: Cucumber and coconut salad

method.en: Deseed the cucumber. The seeds and pulp are where nearly all the water is, and water is what ruins a koshimbir on a serving line.
method.l: खिरीच्यो बीयो काडात. उदक तातूंतच आसता.

method.en: Cut it into small dice rather than grating. A grated koshimbir weeps within twenty minutes; a diced one holds an hour.
method.l: किसचेबदला बारीक कापात. किसिल्ली कोशिंबीर वीस मिनटांनीं उदक सोडटा.

method.en: Roast and crush the peanut coarsely. Ground fine it turns to a paste and coats everything.
method.l: शेंगदाणे भाजून जाडसर कुटात. बारीक कुटल्यार ते लेप जातात.

method.en: Add a little jaggery with the lemon. Goan cooking balances sweet against sour in almost every dish and a koshimbir is no exception.
method.l: लिंबाकडेन थोडो गोड घालात.

method.en: Fold the fresh grated coconut in raw. This is what makes a koshimbir Goan rather than a plains kachumber.
method.l: खवयल्लो नाल्ल कच्चोच घालात.

method.en: Add the salt and lemon at the counter, not in the kitchen. Salted early the cucumber weeps and the tray sits in liquid.
method.l: मीठ आनी लिंब वाडपाच्या जाग्यार घालात.

recipes.why: Diced not grated, and salted at the counter. Both are about it not sitting in water.
recipes.why_l: किसचें न्हय, कापचें; आनी मीठ वाडपाच्या जाग्यार.

start.en: Cut within the hour of serving. Nothing is made ahead.
start.l: वाडपाच्या एका वरांभितर कापात.

vessel.en: Two large trays and sharp knives. Two cooks.
vessel.l: दोन व्हडल्यो ट्रे आनी धारदार कातये. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: All year, doubled in the hot months.

recipes.name: Sprout Koshimbir
recipes.sub: Sprouted moong with coconut and lemon

method.en: Soak the whole moong overnight, drain thoroughly, and tie it loosely in damp cloth for a further day and a half.
method.l: आख्खे मूग रातभर भिजयात आनी वल्ल्या कापडांत दीड दीस बांदून दवरात.

method.en: Rinse and re-drain twice a day. Sprouts sitting in their own water sour within a day and a soured batch cannot be served.
method.l: दिसाक दोन फावटीं धुवन उदक काडात.

method.en: Steam the sprouts three minutes before serving them to a crowd. Raw sprouts in quantity to a hall is not worth the risk, and three minutes changes nothing about the texture.
method.l: मोड वाडचेआदीं तीन मिनटां वाफेर शिजयात.

method.en: Cool them completely before anything else goes in. Warm sprouts wilt the coconut and the whole tray goes slack.
method.l: सगळें घालचेआदीं मोड पुरायपणान थंड करात.

method.en: Fold the fresh grated coconut in raw and add a little jaggery with the lemon.
method.l: खवयल्लो नाल्ल कच्चोच घालात आनी लिंबाकडेन थोडो गोड.

method.en: Salt and lemon at the counter only, in small lots as the line moves.
method.l: मीठ आनी लिंब फकत वाडपाच्या जाग्यार, थोडें थोडें.

recipes.why: Four kilos of dry moong becomes ten of salad, and three minutes of steam makes it safe for a hall.
recipes.why_l: चार किलो सुक्या मुगाचे धा किलो जातात.

start.en: Sprout the moong two days ahead.
start.l: मूग दोन दीस आदीं मोडयात.

vessel.en: Two cloth-lined baskets and a steamer. One cook.
vessel.l: दोन कापड घाल्ल्यो टोपल्यो आनी वाफेचें आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kokum Saar
recipes.sub: Thin kokum broth with cumin and jaggery
recipes.sub_l: जिरें आनी गोडासयत पातळ कोकम सार

method.en: Soak the kokum in warm water an hour and work the pulp off the skins by hand.
method.l: कोकम कोमट उदकांत एक वर भिजयात आनी हातांनीं सालींतलो गर काडात.

method.en: Never boil the saar hard — kokum boiled long turns from red to brown and from sour to flat.
method.l: सार जोरान उकडूं नाकात — चड उकडल्यार कोकम तांबड्यांतल्यान तांबूस जाता आनी आंबटांतल्यान सपक.

method.en: Bring it only to the point of steaming and take it off.
method.l: फकत वाफ सुटसर हाडात आनी उतरात.

method.en: A cumin and asafoetida tempering in coconut oil at the end.
method.l: निमाणें नाल्लाच्या तेलांत जिरें आनी हिंगाची फोडणी.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head, the cheapest thing on the shelf, and there is no fresh vegetable in it at all — which in the second week of July is the whole reason it exists.
recipes.why_l: सात रुपया दर मनशाक — फळयेवयली सगळ्यांत सवाय गजाल; आनी तातूंत ताजी भाजी मात ना, आनी जुलयाच्या दुसऱ्या सप्तकांत तेच खातीर तें आसा.

start.en: Soak the kokum an hour. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: कोकम एक वर भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं दीड वर सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी गाळणी. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Dudhya Saar
recipes.sub: Bottle gourd soup thickened with moong

method.en: Taste a slice of every gourd — a bitter one does not merely taste bad, it makes people ill.
method.l: दर दुदयेची एक चाक चाकात — कडू दुदयो फकत वायट लागना, ती मनशांक दुयेंती करता.

method.en: A handful of moong cooked with it gives body without any flour.
method.l: वांगडा शिजयल्ली एक मूठ मूग पिठावीण घट्टपण दिता.

method.en: Blend and pass it through a sieve.
method.l: वाटात आनी गाळणेंतल्यान गाळात.

method.en: Crushed pepper, not powder, and a cumin tempering over each bowl.
method.l: पिठाच्या न्हय, कुटिल्ल्या मिरयांचो, आनी दर वाटयेर जिऱ्याची फोडणी.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head. What goes to a devotee who has just come off a fast and to the guest house at nine at night, when a full plate is too much.
recipes.why_l: नोव रुपया दर मनशाक. उपास सोडिल्ल्या भक्ताक आनी रातीं नोव वरांचेर सोयऱ्यांच्या घरा, जेदना पुराय ताट चड जाता, तेदना हेंच वता.

start.en: Cook the dal first. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं दाळ शिजयात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot, a blender and a sieve. One cook.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन, ब्लेंडर आनी गाळणी. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Karmal Koshimbir
recipes.sub: Star fruit and coconut, cut at the counter
recipes.sub_l: वाडपाच्या जाग्यार कातरिल्लें कारमल आनी नाल्ल

method.en: Trim the brown ridge off each fin before slicing across.
method.l: आडवें कापचेआदीं दर पंखाची तांबडी देग कातरात.

method.en: Cut within the hour of serving; star fruit browns fast once it is cut.
method.l: वाडपाच्या एका वरा भितर कापात; कापल्या उपरांत कारमल बेगीन तांबूस जाता.

method.en: Salt at the counter — salted early it collapses into water.
method.l: मीठ वाडपाच्या जाग्यार — पयलीं घाल्यार तें उदक जाता.

method.en: Keep it in a shallow tray on ice, never in a deep drum.
method.l: बर्फार उथळ ताटांत दवरात, गुंडाय ड्रमांत कदींच न्हय.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head, no fire and no fuel, from a fruit nobody in Bardez buys because every second house has the tree.
recipes.why_l: सात रुपया दर मनशाक — ना उजो, ना इंदन; आनी बार्देशांत दर दुसऱ्या घरा तें झाड आसा म्हूण तें फळ कोणूच विकत घेना.

start.en: Nothing is cooked. Cut within the hour of serving.
start.l: रांदप ना. वाडपाच्या एका वरा भितर कापात.

vessel.en: Shallow trays on ice and four knives. Two cooks.
vessel.l: बर्फार उथळ ताटां आनी चार सुऱ्यो. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Mulyachi Koshimbir
recipes.sub: Grated radish with coconut and lime

method.en: Grate and squeeze the radish once; the water it gives is what makes the koshimbir smell an hour later.
method.l: मुळो किसात आनी एक खेप पिळात; तें उदकच एका वरा उपरांत कोशिंबीरीक वास दिता.

method.en: Use the young radish with the leaves still crisp; an old one is hollow and hot.
method.l: पानां ताजीं आशिल्लो कोवळो मुळो वापरात; जुनो मुळो पोकळ आनी तिखट आसता.

method.en: Crushed roasted peanut for body, coconut for sweetness, lime for the rest.
method.l: घट्टपणाक कुटिल्ले भाजिल्ले शेंगदाणे, गोडसाणीक नाल्ल, उरिल्ल्याक लिंबू.

method.en: Cut and dress at the counter, not in the kitchen.
method.l: वाडपाच्या जाग्यार कापात आनी भरसात, रांदणकुडींत न्हय.

recipes.why: Six rupees a head and no fire. Radish is eight rupees a kilo in December, and the greens off the top go into the next day's bhaji.
recipes.why_l: स रुपया दर मनशाक आनी उजो ना. डिसेंबरांत मुळो आठ रुपया किलो, आनी वयलीं पानां दुसऱ्या दिसाचे भाजयेंत वतात.

start.en: Nothing is cooked. Cut within the hour of serving.
start.l: रांदप ना. वाडपाच्या एका वरा भितर कापात.

vessel.en: Two graters and shallow trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: दोन किसण्यो आनी उथळ ताटां. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Ambyachi Koshimbir
recipes.sub: Raw mango grated with coconut and chilli
recipes.sub_l: नाल्ल आनी मिरसांगेसयत किसिल्लो कच्चो आंबो

method.en: Taste one mango before all seven kilos is grated; a very sour variety at this quantity puts the dish past eating.
method.l: सातूय किलो किसचेआदीं एक आंबो चाकात; इतल्या प्रमाणांत सामको आंबट आंबो पदार्थ खावपा भायर व्हरता.

method.en: Grate on the coarse side of the grater — fine grating gives a pulp.
method.l: किसणेच्या जाड वटेन किसात — बारीक किसल्यार गरो जाता.

method.en: Jaggery, not sugar; jaggery holds the sourness rather than covering it.
method.l: साकर न्हय, गोड; गोड आंबटपण लिपयना, सांबाळटा.

method.en: Dress at the counter and finish the tray the same meal.
method.l: वाडपाच्या जाग्यार भरसात आनी ताट त्याच जेवणांत सोंपयात.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head in April and May when mango is thirty rupees a kilo, and it needs no gas, no cook and no vessel on the fire.
recipes.why_l: एप्रील आनी मेयांत, जेदना आंबो तीस रुपया किलो, तेदना सात रुपया दर मनशाक; आनी गॅस, रांदपी वा उज्यावयलें आयदन कांयच नाका.

start.en: Nothing is cooked. Grate within the hour of serving.
start.l: रांदप ना. वाडपाच्या एका वरा भितर किसात.

vessel.en: Two graters and shallow trays on ice. Two cooks.
vessel.l: दोन किसण्यो आनी बर्फार उथळ ताटां. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Patoleo
recipes.sub: Rice cakes steamed in turmeric leaf

method.en: Patoleo are made in August and nowhere else in India is a cake steamed in a turmeric leaf. The leaf is not a wrapper — it is the flavour, and there is no substitute for it.
method.l: पातोळ्यो ऑगस्टांत करतात. पान हें फकत गुंडाळप न्हय — तीच रूच.

method.en: Pick broad, unblemished leaves and wipe them rather than washing. Wash them and the batter slides off.
method.l: रुंद, बरीं पानां वेंचात आनी धुवचेबदला पुसात.

method.en: Soak the parboiled rice five hours and grind to a thick, spreadable batter — thicker than for a sanna.
method.l: उकडे तांदूळ पांच वर भिजयात आनी घट्ट पीठ दळात.

method.en: Cook the coconut and jaggery together to a thick filling and cool it completely. A warm filling wets the batter and the patoli tears.
method.l: नाल्ल आनी गोड एकठांय घट्ट सारण करात आनी पुरायपणान थंड करात.

method.en: Spread the batter thin along one half of the leaf, spoon the filling down the centre, and fold the leaf over. Do not fill to the edges.
method.l: पानाच्या अर्द्या वटेन पीठ पातळ पातळावन मदें सारण घालात आनी पान दुमडात.

method.en: Steam twenty-five minutes. The leaf turns from green to olive when they are done and the smell is the signal, not the clock.
method.l: पंचवीस मिनटां उकडात. पान हिरव्यांतल्यान गडद जाता तेन्ना तयार.

recipes.why: The leaf is the dish. One month a year, and there is no substitute worth making.
recipes.why_l: पान हेंच जिनस. वर्सांतून एक म्हयनो, आनी ताका पर्याय ना.

start.en: Soak and grind the rice the night before. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: तांदूळ रातचें भिजयात आनी दळात.

vessel.en: Three steamers and a stack of turmeric leaves. Four cooks.
vessel.l: तीन वाफेचीं आयदनां आनी हळदीचीं पानां. चार रांदपी.

season.en: August only — Nag Panchami and the Assumption feasts, when the turmeric leaf is broad.
season.l: फकत ऑगस्ट — नाग पंचमी आनी फेस्तां, हळदीचीं पानां रुंद आसतना.

recipes.name: Dodol
recipes.sub: Coconut, jaggery and rice flour fudge
recipes.sub_l: नाल्ल, गोड आनी तांदळाच्या पिठाचो दोडोल

method.en: Grease the trays and lay them out before beginning. Dodol sets fast once it is ready and there is no time to look for a tray.
method.l: सुरू करचेआदीं ट्रे तयार दवरात.

method.en: Grind the coconut with warm water and press it through muslin twice. Use the thick first pressing and the thin second pressing separately.
method.l: नाल्ल दळून मलमलांतल्यान दोन फावटीं पिळात. घट्ट आनी पातळ दूद वेगळें दवरात.

method.en: Cook the thin second milk with the jaggery first and reduce it by half before the rice flour goes in.
method.l: पयलीं पातळ दूद गोडाकडेन अर्दें आटयात.

method.en: Slake the rice flour in the cold thick milk before it goes in. Tipped in dry it lumps instantly and no stirring recovers it.
method.l: तांदळाचें पीठ थंड घट्ट दुदांत विरगळावन घालात.

method.en: Stir without stopping for a full two hours on a low flame. This is why two cooks take turns — an arm gives out before the dodol is ready.
method.l: धिम्या उज्यार पुराय दोन वर न थांबतां ढवळात. देखूनच दोग रांदपी आळीपाळीन.

method.en: It is done when the mass comes away from the sides in one piece and a spoon drawn through leaves a clean line that holds. Pour into the trays at once.
method.l: सगळें एकठांय जावन कढयेपसून सुटता आनी डावाची रेग उरता तेन्ना तयार.

recipes.why: Two hours of unbroken stirring. There is no shortcut and every shortcut shows in the tray.
recipes.why_l: दोन वर न थांबतां ढवळप. ताका शॉर्टकट ना.

start.en: Grease the trays before starting. Allow three hours at the stove.
start.l: सुरू करचेआदीं ट्रेंक तेल लावात. उज्यार तीन वर.

vessel.en: A wide 50 L kadhai and greased trays. Two cooks in turns.
vessel.l: रुंद ५० ली. कढई आनी तेल लायिल्ल्यो ट्रे. दोग रांदपी, आळीपाळीन.

season.en: Christmas and festivals, and made in quantity in December.
season.l: नाताल आनी फेस्तां, डिसेंबरांत चड करतात.

recipes.name: Dhonas
recipes.sub: Baked pumpkin and coconut cake

method.en: Dhonas is the Goan answer to bebinca for a kitchen that cannot use egg, and unlike bebinca it was never made with egg in the first place.
method.l: धोणस हो अंडें वापरूंक शकनाशिल्ल्या रांदपाघराखातीर गोंयचो जाप, आनी तातूंत केन्नाच अंडें नाशिल्लें.

method.en: Grate the pumpkin coarsely, salt it lightly and leave it two hours, then squeeze the water out hard.
method.l: कोंवळें जाडसर किसात, थोडें मीठ लावन दोन वर दवरात, मागीर उदक पिळात.

method.en: Squeeze it thoroughly. Pumpkin is nearly all water and an unsqueezed dhonas will not set however long it bakes.
method.l: बरेंच पिळात. कोंवळें बरेंच उदकाळें.

method.en: Roast the semolina in ghee until it smells nutty. Raw semolina gives a dhonas that tastes of flour.
method.l: रवो तुपांत वास येसर भाजात.

method.en: Mix everything and let it stand thirty minutes before baking. The semolina needs that time to take up the pumpkin's remaining moisture.
method.l: सगळें भरसून भाजचेआदीं तीस मिनटां दवरात.

method.en: Bake at a low heat for about an hour until a skewer comes out clean and the top is deep gold. Cool completely before cutting.
method.l: धिम्या उश्णतायेर सुमार एक वर भाजात. कापचेआदीं पुरायपणान थंड करात.

recipes.why: Squeeze the pumpkin and roast the semolina. Both decide whether it sets, and neither takes long.
recipes.why_l: कोंवळें पिळप आनी रवो भाजप. दोनूय तें घट्ट जावपाक.

start.en: Grate and drain the pumpkin two hours ahead. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: कोंवळें किसून दोन वर आदीं उदक काडात.

vessel.en: A heavy oven and four greased trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जड ओवन आनी चार तेल लायिल्ल्यो ट्रे. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: All year, and made at Ganesh Chaturthi.

recipes.name: Manganem
recipes.sub: Chana dal and coconut milk pudding
recipes.sub_l: चण्याची डाळ आनी नाल्लाच्या दुदाचो गोड

method.en: Grind the coconut with warm water and press it through muslin twice, keeping the thick first milk and the thin second milk separate.
method.l: नाल्ल दळून दोन फावटीं पिळात, घट्ट आनी पातळ दूद वेगळें दवरात.

method.en: Cook the chana dal in the thin second milk until it is soft but the grains still hold. Overcooked dal turns a manganem to porridge.
method.l: चण्याची डाळ पातळ दुदांत मोव जावसर शिजयात, पूण दाणे उरचे.

method.en: Add the rice with the dal. It is not there for bulk — it thickens the pudding and without it the coconut milk stays watery.
method.l: डाळीकडेन तांदूळ घालात. तो गोड घट्ट करता.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately, strain it, and add it only when the dal is fully soft. Jaggery added early stops the dal softening.
method.l: गोड वेगळो विरगळावन गाळात आनी डाळ मोव जातकच घालात.

method.en: Add the thick first milk off the fire and never let it boil after that. Coconut milk splits at a rolling boil and there is no recovering it.
method.l: घट्ट दूद उजो बंद करून घालात आनी उपरांत उकडूंक दिवचें न्हय.

method.en: Grate the nutmeg over at the very end. It is the one spice that places a manganem in Goa.
method.l: निमाणें जायफळ किसात.

recipes.why: Two pressings kept separate, and the thick milk off the fire. Both are what stop it splitting.
recipes.why_l: दोन पिळपां वेगळीं, आनी घट्ट दूद उजो बंद करून.

start.en: Soak the chana dal two hours. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: चण्याची डाळ दोन वर भिजयात.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel. One cook who stays with it.
vessel.l: ३० ली. जड आयदन. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Godshem
recipes.sub: Moong dal and jaggery in coconut milk
recipes.sub_l: नाल्लाच्या दुदांत मुगाची दाळ आनी गोड

method.en: Roast the moong dal in ghee until it smells of nuts before it is washed — that is the whole taste of a godshem.
method.l: मुगाची दाळ धुवचेआदीं तुपांत वास येसर भाजात — गोडश्याचो सगळो सवाद तोच.

method.en: Cook it in the thin second and third pressings of the coconut.
method.l: ती नाल्लाच्या दुसऱ्या आनी तिसऱ्या पातळ रोसांत शिजयात.

method.en: Strained jaggery goes in off the fire.
method.l: गाळिल्लो गोड उजो पालवून घालात.

method.en: The thick first pressing last, and never boiled after.
method.l: पयलो घट्ट रोस निमाणें, आनी ते उपरांत कदींच उकडूं नाकात.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a head. What is cooked for Chaturthi in every Goan house, and the dal makes it a sweet a child can be given a full bowl of.
recipes.why_l: बावीस रुपया दर मनशाक. दर गोंयकार घरा चतुर्थीक हेंच रांदतात, आनी दाळीक लागून भुरग्याक पुराय वाटी दिवंक येता अशी गोडशी जाता.

start.en: Roast the dal first, press the coconut fresh. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं दाळ भाजात, नाल्लाचो रोस ताजो काडात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a grinder and muslin. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, ग्राइंडर आनी मलमल. दोन रांदपी.

season.l: आख्खें वर्स. सगळ्यां परस चड चतुर्थीक.

recipes.name: Tandlachi Kheer
recipes.sub: Broken rice reduced in milk with cardamom

method.en: Wash the rice once only; washed clean, the starch that thickens the kheer goes down the drain.
method.l: तांदूळ फकत एक खेप धुवात; बरो धुतल्यार खीर घट्ट करपी माड मोरयेंतल्यान वता.

method.en: Scrape the base of the pot every few minutes with a flat spatula — a burnt bottom is tasted in every bowl.
method.l: दर थोड्या मिनटांनी चपट्या उलथण्यान आयदनाचो तळ खरडात — लागिल्लो तळ दर वाटयेंत लागता.

method.en: Sugar only in the last twenty minutes, or the rice stops softening.
method.l: साकर फकत निमण्या वीस मिनटांनी, ना जाल्यार तांदूळ मऊ जावचें थांबता.

method.en: Nutmeg grated over at the end.
method.l: निमाणें वयल्यान जायफळ किसात.

recipes.why: Twenty-six rupees a head and one vessel serves a hundred and fifty. What is offered on every birthday and every Ekadashi breaking in this temple.
recipes.why_l: सव्वीस रुपया दर मनशाक आनी एका आयदनांतल्यान दिडशें जणां. ह्या देवळांत दर जल्मदिसाक आनी दर एकादशीच्या पारण्याक हेंच अर्पण जाता.

start.en: Ninety minutes on a low fire. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: धिम्या उज्यार दीड वर. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L thick-based pot and a flat spatula. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जाड तळाचें ४० ली. आयदन आनी चपटें उलथणें. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kaju Barfi
recipes.sub: Cashew ground with sugar and rolled thin

method.en: Grind the cashew dry and sieve it; any grain left shows on the cut face.
method.l: काजू सुके वाटात आनी गाळात; उरिल्लो एकूय कण कापिल्ल्या वटेर दिसता.

method.en: Grind in short bursts — a mixer run long heats the nut and the oil separates into a paste that will never set.
method.l: थोडें थोडें वाटात — मिक्सर चड चलयल्यार गरो तापता आनी तेल वेगळें जावन अशी लाप जाता जी कदींच जमना.

method.en: Sugar to one thread and no further; a thread too far and the barfi is a biscuit.
method.l: साकर एका ताराचीच, ते फुडें न्हय; एक तार चड जाली जाल्यार बर्फी बिस्कीट जाता.

method.en: Knead warm on a greased stone, roll thin and cut before it cools.
method.l: तेल लायिल्ल्या फातरार हुनसाण आसतना मळात, पातळ लाटात आनी थंड जावचेआदीं कापात.

recipes.why: Fifty-two rupees a head, the dearest sweet on the shelf, and still half of what a halwai charges — because the cashew is bought at the plantation gate in April.
recipes.why_l: बावन्न रुपया दर मनशाक — फळयेवयली सगळ्यांत म्हारग गोडशी, आनी तरी हलवायाच्या अर्द्या दरान; कारण काजू एप्रीलांत बागायतीच्या दारांत घेतात.

start.en: Grind, cook the syrup, roll. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: वाटात, पाक करात, लाटात. वाडपाआदीं तीन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A dry grinder, a heavy kadhai and a greased stone. Two cooks.
vessel.l: सुको ग्राइंडर, जड कायल आनी तेल लायिल्लो फातर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Serradura
recipes.sub: Layered cream and biscuit crumb, set cold
recipes.sub_l: थंड जमयल्ले क्रीम आनी बिस्किटाच्या चुऱ्याचे थर

method.en: Whip the cream cold, in a cold bowl, and stop the moment it holds a peak — a second longer and it turns to butter.
method.l: क्रीम थंड वाटयेंत थंडच फेटात आनी शिखर उबें रावता तेदनाच थांबात — एक सेकंद चड आनी तें लोणी जाता.

method.en: Crush the biscuits to a coarse crumb, not a powder; the name of the dish means sawdust and it should look like it.
method.l: बिस्किटां जाडसर कुटात, पीठ न्हय; पदार्थाच्या नांवाचो अर्थच भुसो, आनी तें तशेंच दिसूंक जाय.

method.en: Layer crumb and cream in each cup, ending with crumb.
method.l: दर कपांत चुरो आनी क्रीमाचे थर लायात, निमाणो थर चुऱ्याचो.

method.en: Four hours in the cold room before it is served, and it must never leave it warm.
method.l: वाडचेआदीं चार वरां थंड कुडींत, आनी तें हुनसाण भायर वचूंक फावना.

recipes.why: Forty rupees a cup, made the day before with no fire at all, and the Salcete families who come for the Sunday feast know it from their own kitchens.
recipes.why_l: चाळीस रुपया दर कप; एक दीस आदीं, उज्यावीण जाता. आयतारच्या फेस्ताक येवपी साश्टीचीं कुटुंबां तें आपल्याच रांदणकुडींतल्यान वळखतात.

start.en: Set four hours in the cold room. Make a day ahead.
start.l: थंड कुडींत चार वरां जमयात. एक दीस आदीं करात.

vessel.en: A whisking machine, 200 cups and cold storage. Two cooks.
vessel.l: फेटपाचें यंत्र, २०० कप आनी थंड सांठो. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: Cool months only; it will not hold in May.
season.l: फकत थंड म्हयन्यांनी; मेयांत तें टिकना.

recipes.name: Nevreo
recipes.sub: Fried pastry with coconut and jaggery

method.en: Rub the ghee into the maida until a fistful holds its shape when squeezed. Too little and the pastry is hard; too much and it opens in the oil.
method.l: तूप मैद्यांत मळात, मूठ धरता तशी उरची.

method.en: Knead a stiff dough with cold water and rest it thirty minutes.
method.l: थंड उदकान घट्ट पीठ मळात आनी तीस मिनटां दवरात.

method.en: Cook the coconut and jaggery to a filling that is dry enough to hold its shape on a spoon. A wet filling bursts the nevri in the oil.
method.l: नाल्ल आनी गोड सुकें सारण जावसर शिजयात. वल्लें सारण नेवरी फोडटा.

method.en: Add the roasted semolina to the filling. It takes up the last of the moisture and is what stops a nevri leaking.
method.l: सारणांत भाजिल्लो रवो घालात. तो उरिल्ली ओलसाण घेता.

method.en: Cool the filling completely before it goes into the pastry. A warm filling steams inside and splits the seam.
method.l: सारण पुरायपणान थंड करात.

method.en: Seal the edge with a wet finger and crimp it firmly. Fry on a low to medium flame — a hot kadhai blisters the pastry and leaves it raw inside.
method.l: वल्ल्या बोटान देग बंद करात. धिम्या उज्यार तळात.

recipes.why: A dry filling, cooled, and a low flame. Every burst nevri is one of those three.
recipes.why_l: सुकें सारण, थंड, आनी धिमो उजो.

start.en: Rest the dough thirty minutes. Keeps two weeks in a tin.
start.l: पीठ तीस मिनटां दवरात. डब्यांत दोन सप्तकां.

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais and three rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: तीन खोल कढयो आनी तीन पोळपाट. चार रांदपी.

recipes.name: Perad
recipes.sub: Guava cheese

method.en: Use guavas that are ripe but still firm. An overripe guava has lost its pectin and the perad will not set however long it is cooked.
method.l: पिकिल्लीं पूण घट्ट पेरां घेयात. चड पिकिल्ल्या पेराचें पेक्टिन वता.

method.en: Boil the guavas whole with the water until soft, then press through a strainer. Do not grind — the seeds are hard and a grinder puts grit into the paste.
method.l: पेरां आख्खीं उकडात आनी चाळणींतल्यान दामात. दळचें न्हय.

method.en: Keep the pulp thick. A watery pulp adds an hour to the cooking and the colour goes dull.
method.l: गर घट्ट दवरात. पातळ गरान वेळ वाडटा.

method.en: Cook the pulp with the sugar on a medium flame, stirring constantly, for about ninety minutes.
method.l: गर साकरेकडेन मध्यम उज्यार सतत ढवळून सुमार नव्वद मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Add the lemon juice halfway through. The acid is what sets a perad and without it the paste stays soft and sticky.
method.l: मदेच लिंबाचो रस घालात. तेंच पेराद घट्ट करता.

method.en: It is done when a spoon drawn through leaves a clean line that holds for a count of three. Pour into the trays at once and cut when cold.
method.l: डावाची रेग तीन मेजसर उरता तेन्ना तयार. ट्रेंत घालात आनी थंड जातकच कापात.

recipes.why: Firm guava for the pectin and lemon halfway through. Both are what make it set rather than stay a jam.
recipes.why_l: घट्ट पेरां पेक्टिनाखातीर आनी मदेच लिंब.

start.en: Grease the trays before starting. Allow two hours at the stove.
start.l: सुरू करचेआदीं ट्रेंक तेल लावात.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai and greased trays. Two cooks in turns.
vessel.l: रुंद ४० ली. कढई आनी ट्रे. दोग रांदपी, आळीपाळीन.

season.en: November to February, when the guava is in.

recipes.name: Nariyal Laddu
recipes.sub: Coconut and jaggery balls

method.en: Use fresh coconut grated the same morning, not desiccated. A desiccated coconut laddu is dry and crumbles within two days.
method.l: त्याच सकाळचो ताजो खवयल्लो नाल्ल घेयात, सुको न्हय.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with a very little water and strain it. Jaggery always carries grit.
method.l: गोड थोड्याशा उदकांत विरगळावन गाळात.

method.en: Cook the coconut and jaggery together on a low flame for about forty minutes until the mixture leaves the sides of the kadhai.
method.l: नाल्ल आनी गोड धिम्या उज्यार सुमार चाळीस मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Add the roasted rice flour. It is not a filler — it takes up the last of the coconut's moisture and is what lets these keep ten days rather than three.
method.l: भाजिल्लें तांदळाचें पीठ घालात. तें उरिल्ली ओलसाण घेता.

method.en: Grate the nutmeg in at the end, off the fire. It is the one spice that places a coconut laddu in Goa.
method.l: निमाणें, उजो बंद करून जायफळ किसात.

method.en: Shape while warm with greased palms. Cool completely on trays before tinning, or they sweat and go soft.
method.l: गरम आसतना तेल लायिल्ल्या हातांनीं वळात. डब्यांत घालचेआदीं पुरायपणान थंड करात.

recipes.why: The roasted rice flour is what makes it keep ten days. Without it, fresh coconut wins by the third day.
recipes.why_l: भाजिल्लें तांदळाचें पीठ हांकां धा दीस दवरता.

start.en: Grate the coconut the same morning. Keeps ten days in a tin.
start.l: नाल्ल त्याच सकाळीं खवयात. डब्यांत धा दीस.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai and a large tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: रुंद ४० ली. कढई आनी व्हडली ट्रे. दोग रांदपी.

recipes.name: Nachne Laddu
recipes.sub: Ragi roasted with jaggery and coconut

method.en: Roast the ragi in ghee on the lowest flame forty minutes — under-roasted ragi tastes of raw earth and no jaggery hides it.
method.l: नाचणी धिम्या उज्यार तुपांत चाळीस मिनटां भाजात — उणी भाजिल्ली नाचणी कच्च्या मातयेभशेन लागता आनी गोड तें लिपोवंक शकना.

method.en: Dry the grated coconut on the same tawa after the flour comes off.
method.l: पीठ काडल्या उपरांत त्याच तव्यार खवयल्लो नाल्ल सुकयात.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in a little water and strain it — jaggery carries grit.
method.l: गोड थोड्या उदकांत विरगळावन गाळात — गोडांत रेंव आसता.

method.en: Roll while warm; cold, it will not bind at all.
method.l: हुनसाण आसतनाच वळयात; थंड जाल्यार तें बांदचेंच ना.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head, it keeps three weeks in a tin, and it is what goes to the boys' hostel at four in the afternoon when there is no kitchen open.
recipes.why_l: चवदा रुपया दर मनशाक, डब्यांत तीन सप्तकां रावता, आनी सांजवेळार चार वरांचेर, जेदना रांदणकूड उगडिल्ली ना, तेदना भुरग्यांच्या वसतयेंत हेंच वता.

start.en: Forty minutes of roasting. One hour of work.
start.l: चाळीस मिनटां भाजप. एक वराचें काम.

vessel.en: A heavy kadhai and a rolling table. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जड कायल आनी वळपाची मेज. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kaju Chikki
recipes.sub: Broken cashew set in jaggery brittle

method.en: Roast the cashew dry and keep it warm — cold nut dropped into hot syrup makes the syrup seize.
method.l: काजू सुके भाजात आनी हुनसाण दवरात — थंड गरो हुन पाकांत घाल्यार पाक घट्ट जाता.

method.en: Take the jaggery to the hard-crack stage: a drop in cold water must snap, not bend.
method.l: गोड कडक पाकामेरेन हाडात: थंड उदकांतलो थेंब वाकचो न्हय, मोडचो.

method.en: Off the fire before mixing, and pour onto a greased stone at once.
method.l: भरसचेआदीं उज्यावयल्यान काडात आनी तेदनाच तेल लायिल्ल्या फातरार वतात.

method.en: Roll thin with an oiled pin and score it before it cools; cold chikki shatters where it likes.
method.l: तेल लायिल्ल्या लाटण्यान पातळ लाटात आनी थंड जावचेआदीं कापाच्यो रेगो मारात; थंड चिक्की जंय जाय थंय फुटता.

recipes.why: Twenty-six rupees a head and it keeps a month with no cold room. Made in April when broken cashew is at its cheapest, and given out at the gate through the monsoon.
recipes.why_l: सव्वीस रुपया दर मनशाक आनी थंड कुडीवीण म्हयनोभर रावता. एप्रीलांत, जेदना तुटिल्ले काजू सगळ्यांत सवाय, तेदना करतात आनी पावसाळ्यांत दारार वांटतात.

start.en: Forty minutes of work. Make on a dry day only.
start.l: चाळीस मिनटांचें काम. फकत सुक्या दिसाच करात.

vessel.en: A heavy kadhai, a greased stone and an oiled pin. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जड कायल, तेल लायिल्लो फातर आनी तेल लायिल्लें लाटणें. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Fansa Poli
recipes.sub: Jackfruit pulp dried into sheets

method.en: Cook the pulp down with the jaggery until a spoon drawn across leaves a clean line on the pan.
method.l: गर गोडासयत तोमेरेन शिजयात जोमेरेन चमचो ओडल्यार आयदनार निवळ रेग उरना.

method.en: Spread it on oiled sheets one finger thick — thicker and the middle never dries and the whole sheet moulds.
method.l: तेल लायिल्ल्या चादरींचेर एक बोट जाड पातळावात — जाड जाल्यार मदलो भाग सुकनाच आनी आख्खी चादर बुरशी धरता.

method.en: Four days in the sun, brought in every evening before the dew.
method.l: चार दीस उन्हांत, दर सांजे दंव पडचेआदीं भितर.

method.en: Layer with a smear of coconut oil between sheets and roll them up.
method.l: चादरीं मदीं नाल्लाच्या तेलाचो हात मारून त्यो गुठलायात.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head from fruit that has to be eaten in a week or lost. Six kilos of poli off thirty kilos of jackfruit feeds the hall in November, when there is no fruit at all.
recipes.why_l: सप्तकाभितर खावंक ना जाल्यार वाया वचपी फळांतल्यान नोव रुपया दर मनशाक. तीस किलो फणसांतल्यान स किलो पोळी नोव्हेंबरांत, जेदना फळ मात मेळना, तेदना पंगत भरता.

start.en: Cook one day, dry four days in the sun.
start.l: एक दीस शिजयात, चार दीस उन्हांत सुकयात.

vessel.en: A 40 L kadhai, oiled sheets and a terrace. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. कायल, तेल लायिल्ल्यो चादरी आनी गच्ची. तीन रांदपी.

season.en: Made in May and June, eaten until December.
season.l: मे आनी जुनांत करतात, डिसेंबरमेरेन खातात.

recipes.name: Ambya Sat
recipes.sub: Mango pulp dried in layers on the roof

method.en: Squeeze the pulp by hand and sieve it; the fibre is what makes a sat crack rather than roll.
method.l: गर हातान काडात आनी गाळात; साठ वळचे बदला तुटता तो तंतवामुळें.

method.en: Spread one thin layer and let it dry a full day before the next goes on.
method.l: एक पातळ थर पातळावात आनी दुसरो घालचेआदीं आख्खो दीस सुकूंक दियात.

method.en: Seven layers over seven days is what makes a sat; poured thick in one go it sours in the middle.
method.l: सात दिसांनी सात थर — तेच साठ करतात; एकाच खेपेन जाड वतल्यार मदल्यान तो आंबता.

method.en: Bring it in every evening before the dew and cover it with muslin against the flies.
method.l: दर सांजे दंव पडचेआदीं भितर घेयात आनी माशयां आड मलमलीन धांपात.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head. In June the tree at the back drops more than the hall can eat in a week; in December this is the only fruit in the store.
recipes.why_l: आठ रुपया दर मनशाक. जुनांत फाटलें झाड सप्तकांत पंगत खावंक शकना ते परस चड घालता; डिसेंबरांत भंडारांत हेंच एक फळ उरता.

start.en: Seven days in the sun, one layer a day.
start.l: सात दीस उन्हांत, दिसाक एक थर.

vessel.en: Oiled trays, muslin and a terrace. Two cooks.
vessel.l: तेल लायिल्लीं ताटां, मलमल आनी गच्ची. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: Made in May and June, eaten until January.
season.l: मे आनी जुनांत करतात, जानेवारीमेरेन खातात.

recipes.name: Kulkul
recipes.sub: Coconut milk dough curled on a fork and fried
recipes.sub_l: नाल्लाच्या दुदाचें पीठ काट्यार वळून तळिल्लें

method.en: Knead with thick coconut milk and nothing else — water in the dough gives a kulkul that goes soft by evening.
method.l: घट्ट नाल्लाच्या दुदानच मळात, हेर कांयच न्हय — पिठांत उदक आयलें जाल्यार कुलकूल सांजेमेरेन मऊ जाता.

method.en: Rest the dough an hour, then roll marble-sized balls and press each one down the back of a fork.
method.l: पीठ एक वर दवरात, मागीर गोट्येयेवढे गोळे करात आनी दर गोळो काट्याच्या फाटल्यान दाबात.

method.en: Fry on a low flame until pale gold; browned, they taste of oil within a week.
method.l: धिम्या उज्यार फिकट सोनेरी जासर तळात; रंग गडद जालो जाल्यार सप्तकाभितर तेलाचो वास येता.

method.en: Coat in a one-thread syrup while warm and cool completely before the tin is shut.
method.l: हुनसाण आसतना एका ताराच्या पाकांत घोळात आनी डबो धांपचेआदीं सामके थंड करात.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head and it keeps three weeks. Every Salcete family makes these in December, and six pairs of hands can curl ten kilos in an evening.
recipes.why_l: वीस रुपया दर मनशाक आनी तीन सप्तकां रावता. डिसेंबरांत दर साश्टी कुटुंब हें करता, आनी स जोडपीं हातांनी एका सांजेक धा किलो वळटात.

start.en: Rest the dough an hour, then curl and fry. Three hours of work.
start.l: पीठ एक वर दवरात, मागीर वळात आनी तळात. तीन वरांचें काम.

vessel.en: A kadhai, forks and cooling trays. Six cooks.
vessel.l: कायल, काटे आनी थंड करपाचीं ताटां. स रांदपी.

recipes.name: Chana Ghashi
recipes.sub: Chickpeas in roasted coconut gravy

method.en: Soak the chana overnight and cook until a chickpea crushes to nothing between finger and thumb. Merely soft is not cooked.
method.l: चणे रातभर भिजयात आनी बोटांमदीं पुरायपणान चिरडपासर शिजयात.

method.en: Roast the coconut deep brown, twenty minutes on a low flame, stirring constantly. A ghashi is a roasted-coconut gravy and this is the whole dish.
method.l: नाल्ल धिम्या उज्यार वीस मिनटां गडद तांबसार भाजात.

method.en: Grind everything with the tamarind to a very fine paste. A gritty ghashi separates on a long drive and arrives looking curdled.
method.l: चिंचेकडेन सगळें बारीक वाटात. रवाळ घाशी वाटेर वेगळें जाता.

method.en: There is no onion and no garlic here. Asafoetida with the tempering does that work and this is a temple dish to begin with.
method.l: हांगा कांदो-लसूण ना. हिंग तें काम करता.

method.en: Simmer twenty minutes and never let it boil hard. A coconut gravy splits at a rolling boil and a split gravy will not survive a journey at all.
method.l: वीस मिनटां उकडात, जोरान न्हय.

method.en: Carry it thicker than it should be and thin it with hot water at the other end. It is better the next day.
method.l: जाय तापरस घट्ट व्हरात आनी थंय गरम उदकान पातळ करात.

recipes.why: Ground fine and never boiled hard. A coconut gravy that has split cannot be carried anywhere.
recipes.why_l: बारीक वाटप आनी जोरान न उकडप.

start.en: Soak the chana overnight. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: चणे रातभर भिजयात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pressure vessel, a heavy pan and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. प्रेशर आयदन, जड कढई आनी ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The catering dish that travels best.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. भायर व्हरपाक सगळ्यांत बरें.

recipes.name: Mix Veg Xacuti
recipes.sub: Mixed vegetables in xacuti paste

method.en: Sort the vegetables into hard and soft before anything else and cut everything to the same size.
method.l: पयलीं भाजी घट्ट आनी मोव अशी वेगळी करात आनी सगळें एकाच आकाराचें कापात.

method.en: Make the xacuti masala on the day. It is a wet paste and it sours within three days even refrigerated.
method.l: शकुती मसालो त्याच दिसा करात.

method.en: Fry the hard vegetables in coconut oil with the asafoetida for eight minutes before the paste goes in.
method.l: घट्ट भाजी नाल्लाच्या तेलांत हिंगाकडेन आठ मिनटां परतात.

method.en: Cook the paste itself for ten minutes before any water goes in. An underscooked xacuti paste tastes raw and the whole vessel is flat.
method.l: उदक घालचेआदीं वाटण धा मिनटां शिजयात.

method.en: Add water and simmer fifteen minutes, then the soft vegetables for the last six. Never let it boil hard.
method.l: उदक घालून पंदरा मिनटां, मागीर मोव भाजी निमाणीं स मिनटां.

method.en: Balance the jaggery against the kokum at the very end. A xacuti should land hot first, then sour, then faintly sweet.
method.l: निमाणें गोड आनी कोकम सांबाळात.

recipes.why: The paste cooked before the water goes in. Ten minutes, and it is the difference between a xacuti and a coconut curry.
recipes.why_l: उदकाआदीं वाटण शिजोवप. धा मिनटां, आनी हेंच शकुती करता.

start.en: Make the xacuti masala fresh. Cut the vegetables an hour ahead.
start.l: शकुती मसालो ताजो करात. भाजी एक वर आदीं कापात.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: रुंद ४० ली. कढई आनी ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: All year with whatever the market gave.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स, बाजारांत जें मेळटा तें.

recipes.name: Batata Tonak
recipes.sub: Potato in roasted coconut gravy

method.en: Boil and chill the potatoes the day before, then break them by hand into large pieces. Cold potato holds its shape in a carrier; warm potato arrives as mash.
method.l: बटाट आदल्या दिसा उकडून थंड करात, मागीर हातान व्हड फोडी करात.

method.en: Roast the coconut deep brown, twenty minutes on a low flame, stirring constantly.
method.l: नाल्ल धिम्या उज्यार वीस मिनटां गडद तांबसार भाजात.

method.en: Grind with the tamarind to a very fine paste. A gritty tonak separates on a long drive.
method.l: चिंचेकडेन बारीक वाटात.

method.en: Fry the paste in coconut oil with the asafoetida for eight minutes before any water goes in.
method.l: उदक घालचेआदीं वाटण नाल्लाच्या तेलांत हिंगाकडेन आठ मिनटां परतात.

method.en: Add the potato and water and simmer fifteen minutes, mashing a few pieces against the side to thicken the gravy.
method.l: बटाट आनी उदक घालून पंदरा मिनटां उकडात, थोड्यो फोडी कुसकरात.

method.en: Carry it thicker than it should be and thin it with hot water at the other end. Never let it boil hard at either end.
method.l: जाय तापरस घट्ट व्हरात आनी थंय गरम उदकान पातळ करात.

recipes.why: Ingredients that are always in the store, and a tonak travels better than any tomato gravy.
recipes.why_l: भांडारांत सदांच आशिल्ल्यो वस्तू, आनी तोणाक हेर खंयच्याय रसापरस बरें प्रवास करता.

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: बटाट आदल्या सांजेक उकडात.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai, a heavy pan and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: रुंद ४० ली. कढई, जड कढई आनी ग्राइंडर. दोग रांदपी.

season.en: All year. The dish for a morning when nothing was planned.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. कांयच थारायिल्लें ना अशा सकाळाक.

recipes.name: Paneer Xacuti
recipes.sub: Paneer in the roasted xacuti masala

method.en: Roast the coconut almost black — a xacuti is dark and a pale one is only a tonak with more spice in it.
method.l: नाल्ल जवळजवळ काळें जासर भाजात — शकुती काळसर आसता; फिकट आसल्यार तें फकत चड मसाल्याचें तोणाक.

method.en: Roast each whole spice separately and grind everything with tamarind and no water.
method.l: दर खडो मसालो वेगळो भाजात आनी सगळें चिंचेसयत, उदकावीण वाटात.

method.en: Keep the paneer in warm salted water until the gravy is ready.
method.l: रोस तयार जासर पनीर कोमट मिठाच्या उदकांत दवरात.

method.en: Paneer goes in for the last two minutes only; boiled, it turns to rubber.
method.l: पनीर फकत निमण्या दोन मिनटांक; उकडल्यार तें रबर जाता.

recipes.why: Forty-four rupees a head. Xacuti is the dish a Goan expects at a feast and this is the one that can be sent to an office lunch without a word of explanation.
recipes.why_l: चवेचाळीस रुपया दर मनशाक. फेस्ताक गोंयकार जें आपेक्षिता तें शकुती; आनी हेंच ऑफिसाच्या जेवणाक कसलीच सफाय दिवचेवीण धाडूंक जाता.

start.en: Roast and grind first. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं भाजात आनी वाटात. वाडपाआदीं अडेच वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A heavy tawa, a grinder and a 40 L pot. Three cooks.
vessel.l: जड तवो, ग्राइंडर आनी ४० ली. आयदन. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Rajma Tonak
recipes.sub: Kidney beans in a roasted coconut gravy

method.en: Soak the rajma ten hours and cook it in the same water.
method.l: राजमो धा वरां भिजयात आनी त्याच उदकांत शिजयात.

method.en: Salt only after it is soft; salted early it never gives in.
method.l: मऊ जाल्या उपरांतच मीठ; पयलीं घाल्यार तो कदींच मऊ जायना.

method.en: Roast the coconut dark and grind it with the whole spice and tamarind.
method.l: नाल्ल गडद भाजात आनी खड्या मसाल्यांसयत आनी चिंचेसयत वाटात.

method.en: Mash a ladle of beans into the gravy — that is the only thickener.
method.l: एक डाव राजमो रोसांत कुसकुरात — घट्ट करपाचो तोच एक मार्ग.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head. It holds two hours in a hot box without splitting, which a coconut milk gravy will not do on a thirty-kilometre run.
recipes.why_l: वीस रुपया दर मनशाक. हुन पेटयेंत तें दोन वरां फुटनासतना रावता; नाल्लाच्या दुदाचो रोस तीस किलोमीटरांच्या वाटेर तें करूंक शकना.

start.en: Soak ten hours. Start thirteen hours before serving.
start.l: धा वरां भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं तेरा वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a tawa and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, तवो आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Soya Wadi Tonak
recipes.sub: Soya chunks in the standard tonak masala

method.en: Boil the chunks ten minutes, drain, and squeeze them out three times in fresh water — the smell they carry is what people object to, and it washes out.
method.l: वडयो धा मिनटां उकडात, निथारात आनी नव्या उदकांत तीन खेपे पिळात — मनशांक जो वास नाका तो हाच, आनी तो धुतल्यार वता.

method.en: Squeeze them dry before they go in the pan or they carry water into the gravy.
method.l: आयदनांत घालचेआदीं सामक्यो पिळात, ना जाल्यार त्यो रोसांत उदक व्हरतात.

method.en: Roast the coconut dark and grind with the whole spice.
method.l: नाल्ल गडद भाजात आनी खड्या मसाल्यांसयत वाटात.

method.en: Simmer twenty minutes so the chunks take the masala in.
method.l: वीस मिनटां धिम्या उज्यार, जाका करून वडयो मसालो सोंकतात.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head with as much protein as a paneer vessel at a third of the cost, and it needs no cold storage on the way to a school programme.
recipes.why_l: पंदरा रुपया दर मनशाक — पनीराच्या आयदना इतलीच ताकद, तिसऱ्या दरान; आनी शाळेच्या कार्यावळीक व्हरतना थंड सांठ्याची गरज ना.

start.en: Boil and wash the chunks first. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं वडयो उकडून धुवात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a tawa and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, तवो आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kaju Paneer Ghashi
recipes.sub: Paneer and cashew in a raw coconut gravy
recipes.sub_l: कच्च्या नाल्लाच्या रोसांत पनीर आनी काजू

method.en: Grind the coconut raw — this is a ghashi and roasting turns it into something else.
method.l: नाल्ल कच्चें वाटात — ही घशी, आनी भाजल्यार ती हेरूच कितें जाता.

method.en: Soak and grind half the cashew into the gravy and fry the other half whole for the top.
method.l: अर्दे काजू भिजोवन रोसांत वाटात आनी अर्दे अखे तळून वयर घालात.

method.en: Do not boil after the ground coconut goes in.
method.l: वाटिल्लो नाल्ल घाल्या उपरांत उकडूंक नाकात.

method.en: Paneer at the very end, two minutes, no more.
method.l: पनीर सामकें निमाणें, दोन मिनटां, ते परस चड न्हय.

recipes.why: Forty-eight rupees a head, the most expensive vessel in this book, and it is what goes out when a family sponsors a feast for a wedding or a first birthday.
recipes.why_l: अठ्ठेचाळीस रुपया दर मनशाक — ह्या पुस्तकांतलें सगळ्यांत म्हारग आयदन; लग्न वा पयल्या वाडदिसाचें फेस्त कुटुंबान दिलें जाल्यार हेंच वता.

start.en: Soak the cashew four hours. Start five hours before serving.
start.l: काजू चार वरां भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं पांच वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot, a grinder and a small kadhai. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन, ग्राइंडर आनी धाकटी कायल. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Mix Bhaji Sukkem
recipes.sub: Five vegetables cooked dry with coconut

method.en: Cut everything the same size and put each vegetable in by how long it takes — carrot and tendli first, peas last.
method.l: सगळें एकाच मापान कातरात आनी दर भाजी तिच्या शिजपाच्या वेळा प्रमाण घालात — पयलीं गाजर आनी तेंडलीं, निमाणे वाटाणे.

method.en: A vessel of mixed vegetables tipped in together gives mush and stones on the same spoon.
method.l: सगळ्यो भाज्यो एकठांय घाल्यार एकाच चमच्यांत लापशी आनी कच्चे कुडके येतात.

method.en: Cook uncovered on a high flame so nothing steams.
method.l: व्हड उज्यार धांपनासतना रांदात, जाका करून कांयच वाफेन शिजना.

method.en: Coconut ground coarse and folded in at the end.
method.l: नाल्ल जाडसर वाटात आनी निमाणें भरसात.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head and it holds two hours in a hot box without going to water, which is what decides whether a Food for Life plate arrives looking like food.
recipes.why_l: चवदा रुपया दर मनशाक आनी हुन पेटयेंत दोन वरां उदक सुटनासतना रावता — फूड फॉर लायफाचें ताट खाणाभशेन पावतलें काय ना, तें तेच वयल्यान थारता.

start.en: Cut in order of cooking time. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: शिजपाच्या वेळा प्रमाण कातरात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L kadhai and a cutting table. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. कायल आनी कातरपाची मेज. तीन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Bhende Sasav
recipes.sub: Okra in ground mustard and coconut, uncooked at the end
recipes.sub_l: मोहरी आनी नाल्ल वाटून केल्लें भेंडे सासव

method.en: Wipe the okra dry before cutting it. Cut wet, a sasav ropes and nothing takes it back.
method.l: भेंडी कापचे आदीं पुसून सुकी करात. ओली कापल्यार सासव चिकट जाता आनी तें परतें येना.

method.en: Fry the okra in coconut oil until the edges brown and set it aside.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत भेंडी कडा तांबडी जायमेरेन तळात आनी बाजूक दवरात.

method.en: Grind the coconut with the chilli and half the mustard, and keep the other half of the mustard whole for the tempering.
method.l: नाल्ल, मिरसांग आनी अर्दी मोहरी वाटात; उरिल्ली मोहरी फोडणेक आखी दवरात.

method.en: Boil the paste with tamarind, jaggery, turmeric and salt ten minutes, put the okra back, and temper. A sasav is never boiled after the mustard goes in — it turns sharp.
method.l: वाटिल्लें मसालो, चिंच, गूळ, हळद आनी मीठ घालून धा मिनटां उकडात, भेंडी परतीं घालात आनी फोडणी करात. मोहरी घाल्ल्या उपरांत सासव उकडचें न्हय — तें तिखट जाता.

recipes.why: A sasav has coconut and mustard and nothing else for richness, so it is vegan as it stands and always was. Okra costs half what a tonak's beans cost and the dish is finished in half an hour.
recipes.why_l: सासवांत नाल्ल आनी मोहरी सोडून हेर कांयच ना, देखून तें सदांच दूद नाशिल्लें आसा. भेंडीक तोनकाच्या वालांच्या निम्म्या दामाक येता आनी अर्द्या वरांत जेवण तयार.

start.en: Soak the tamarind twenty minutes. Nothing else waits. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: चिंच वीस मिनटां भिजयात. हेर कांयच रावचें ना. वाडपाआदीं पन्नास मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A wide 20 L kadhai for frying and a 40 L vessel. A grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: तळपाक २० ली. कडाय आनी ४० ली. भांडें. ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: All year. Okra is on every Margao stall from June to February.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. जून ते फेब्रुवारी मडगांवच्या दर दुकानार भेंडी आसता.

recipes.name: Bhaji Randayi
recipes.sub: Mixed vegetables in thin coconut milk

method.en: Press the coconut twice. The second pressing goes in first with the vegetables and the first pressing goes in last, off the fire.
method.l: नाल्ल दोन फावटीं पिळात. दुसरें पिळप भाज्यांवांगडा घालात आनी पयलें पिळप निमाणें, उजो बंद केल्या उपरांत.

method.en: Roast the chilli and coriander in a spoon of coconut oil and grind them fine.
method.l: एका चमच्या नाल्लाच्या तेलांत मिरसांग आनी धणे भाजून बारीक वाटात.

method.en: Boil the vegetables in the thin milk with the paste, turmeric, tamarind and salt in the order they cook — banana first, ash gourd last.
method.l: पातळ दुदांत मसालो, हळद, चिंच आनी मीठ घालून भाज्यो शिजपाच्या क्रमान घालात — पयलीं केळीं, निमाणें कोहळें.

method.en: Stir the thick milk in off the fire and do not let it boil. Boiled coconut milk splits and cannot be brought back.
method.l: उजो बंद करून घट्ट दूद घालात आनी उकडूं दिवचें न्हय. उकडिल्लें नाल्लाचें दूद फाटता आनी परतें येना.

recipes.why: The gravy is coconut milk, so the dish that would elsewhere need cream needs nothing at all here. It uses five cheap vegetables at once, which is what makes it the everyday vessel in a Ponda kitchen rather than a festival one.
recipes.why_l: रस्सो नाल्लाचें दूद आसा, देखून हेर कडेन क्रीम जाय अशें जेवण हांगा कांयच मागना. एकाच वेळार पांच सवाय भाज्यो वता, देखून फोंड्याच्या रांदपाघरांत हें सदांचें भांडें.

start.en: Grate and press the coconut the same morning. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: नाल्ल त्याच सकाळीं खवून पिळात. वाडपाआदीं सत्तर मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel, a grinder and muslin for the milk. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ५० ली. भांडें, ग्राइंडर आनी दुदाखातीर मलमल. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: All year, and the dish to cook in the monsoon when the market has only gourds.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स; पावसांत बाजारांत फकत कोहळीं आसतना हेंच करात.

recipes.name: Nachne Satva
recipes.sub: Ragi set with coconut milk and jaggery, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: नाल्लाच्या दुदांत आनी गुळांत घट्ट केल्लें नाचणे सत्व

method.en: Mix the ragi flour into cold coconut milk before any heat touches it, and strain it once.
method.l: नाचणे पीठ थंड नाल्लाच्या दुदांत भरसात, ताप लागचे आदीं, आनी एक फावट गाळात.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it — jaggery carries sand and one grain ruins a satva.
method.l: गूळ वेगळो विरगळावन गाळात — गुळांत रेंव आसता आनी एक कणय सत्व पाडटा.

method.en: Cook the two together on a low fire, stirring without stopping, until it leaves the side of the vessel.
method.l: दोनूय एकठांय करून धिम्या उज्यार, न रावतां घुस्पावन, भांड्याची कूस सोडमेरेन शिजयात.

method.en: Pour into oiled trays, scatter fried coconut slivers over, and cut when cold. There is no milk and no ghee in it, which is why it holds a day in Goan heat.
method.l: तेल लायिल्ल्या ताटांनी वतात, वयर तळिल्ल्यो नाल्लाच्यो कापी घालात आनी थंड जातकच कातरात. दूद वा तूप ना, देखून गोंयच्या उश्णांत एक दीस रावता.

recipes.why: Every sweet in this book but this one is made on milk or ghee. Ragi and coconut milk give a sweet that a vegan devotee can take at a festival, and it costs a third of what a dodol does.
recipes.why_l: ह्या पुस्तकांतलीं हेर सगळीं गोडशीं दुदाचेर वा तुपाचेर आसात. नाचणी आनी नाल्लाचें दूद अशें गोड दितात जें फेस्ताक दूद न खाणाऱ्याक मेळटा, आनी दोदलाच्या तीन वांट्यांतल्या एका दामाक.

start.en: Press the coconut milk fresh. The satva must set two hours before it is cut, so start four hours ahead.
start.l: नाल्लाचें दूद ताजें पिळात. कातरचे आदीं सत्व दोन वरां घट्ट जावंक जाय, देखून चार वरां आदीं सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel and four flat trays. Two cooks, one stirring throughout.
vessel.l: ४० ली. जड भांडें आनी चार सपाट ताटां. दोन रांदपी, एकल्यान सदांच घुस्पावंक जाय.

season.en: All year. Ragi is a store item and coconut is never short in this state.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. नाचणी सांठवण आसा आनी ह्या राज्यांत नाल्ल केन्नाच उणो पडना.

recipes.name: Alsande Randayi
recipes.sub: Cowpea and pumpkin in coconut gravy

method.en: Soak the cowpea six hours and cook it soft before the pumpkin is anywhere near the pot.
method.l: आळसांदे स वरां भिजयात आनी कुवाळो आयदनाकडेन येवचेआदीं ते मऊ शिजयात.

method.en: Pumpkin with the skin on, in large pieces, and only eight minutes.
method.l: कुवाळो सालीसयत, व्हड कुडके, आनी फकत आठ मिनटां.

method.en: Grind the coconut raw — no ghee, no curd, nothing from a cow at any point in this vessel.
method.l: नाल्ल कच्चें वाटात — ह्या आयदनांत खंयच तूप, दंय वा गायेचें कांयच ना.

method.en: A mustard and curry leaf tempering in coconut oil at the end.
method.l: निमाणें नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सांसव आनी कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head, and a devotee who takes no milk eats the same vessel as the hall instead of a plate cooked apart.
recipes.why_l: पंदरा रुपया दर मनशाक; दूद घेवंक नाशिल्लो भक्त वेगळें रांदिल्लें ताट न्हय, पंगती वांगडा त्याच आयदनांतलें खाता.

start.en: Soak six hours. Start eight hours before serving.
start.l: स वरां भिजयात. वाडपाआदीं आठ वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Fansa Bikancho Sukkem
recipes.sub: Jackfruit seeds cooked dry with coconut

method.en: Peel both skins and halve the big seeds so everything cooks in the same time.
method.l: दोनूय सालीं काडात आनी व्हड बियो अर्द्यो करात, जाका करून सगळें एकाच वेळार शिजता.

method.en: Boil twenty-five minutes before the masala; a half-cooked seed is like a stone.
method.l: मसाल्याआदीं पंचवीस मिनटां उकडात; अर्दी शिजिल्ली बी फातराभशेन आसता.

method.en: Roast the coconut lightly and grind it coarse with the chilli.
method.l: नाल्ल थोडें भाजात आनी मिरसांगेसयत जाडसर वाटात.

method.en: Finish dry, in coconut oil, with nothing from a cow in it.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत सुकें सोंपयात, गायेचें कांयच घालनासतना.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head out of what the kitchen throws away in June, and it is on this page so that the vegan tray is not the poorest tray in the hall.
recipes.why_l: जुनांत रांदणकूड जें उडयता तातूंतल्यान सात रुपया दर मनशाक; आनी हें ह्या पानार आसा जाका करून वीगन ताट पंगतींतलें सगळ्यांत गरीब ताट जावंचें न्हय.

start.en: Peel and boil first. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: पयलीं सालीं काडात आनी उकडात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot and a kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन आनी कायल. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Nariyal Doodhachi Kheer
recipes.sub: Rice kheer on coconut milk and jaggery
recipes.sub_l: नाल्लाचें दूद आनी गोडाची तांदळाची खीर

method.en: Take the first pressing separately and keep it back for the end.
method.l: पयलो रोस वेगळो काडात आनी निमाण्याक दवरात.

method.en: Cook the rice in the thin second and third pressings until it falls apart.
method.l: तांदूळ दुसऱ्या आनी तिसऱ्या पातळ रोसांत मोडसर शिजयात.

method.en: Strained jaggery off the fire — boiled into coconut milk it splits and there is no bringing it back.
method.l: गाळिल्लो गोड उजो पालवून — नाल्लाच्या दुदांत उकडल्यार तें फुटता आनी परत येना.

method.en: The first pressing goes in last and is never boiled.
method.l: पयलो रोस निमाणें घालात आनी तो कदींच उकडचो न्हय.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees a head. A devotee who takes no milk can be handed a sweet at a feast without an apology, which on most shelves is not true.
recipes.why_l: चोवीस रुपया दर मनशाक. दूद घेवंक नाशिल्ल्या भक्ताक फेस्तांत गोडशी सफायेवीण दिवंक जाता — चडश्या फळयांचेर तशें ना.

start.en: Press the coconut fresh. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: नाल्लाचो रोस ताजो काडात. वाडपाआदीं दोन वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 30 L pot, a grinder and muslin. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ३० ली. आयदन, ग्राइंडर आनी मलमल. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Dudhya Randayi
recipes.sub: Bottle gourd in a thin coconut gravy

method.en: Taste a slice of every gourd before it is cut in.
method.l: दर दुदयेची एक चाक कापचेआदीं चाकात.

method.en: Cook the moong dal soft first; it is what gives the gravy its body without any dairy.
method.l: पयलीं मुगाची दाळ मऊ शिजयात; दुदावीण रोसाक घट्टपण तीच दिता.

method.en: Coconut ground raw, folded in off the fire.
method.l: नाल्ल कच्चें वाटात आनी उजो पालवून भरसात.

method.en: Coconut oil for the tempering; there is no ghee anywhere in this vessel.
method.l: फोडणेक नाल्लाचें तेल; ह्या आयदनांत खंयच तूप ना.

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head from a vegetable at twelve rupees a kilo, and it is the vegan vessel that costs the least on this whole shelf.
recipes.why_l: बारा रुपया किलोच्या भाजयेंतल्यान धा रुपया दर मनशाक; आनी आख्ख्या फळयेवयलें सगळ्यांत सवाय वीगन आयदन तेंच.

start.en: Cook the dal first. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: पयलीं दाळ शिजयात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 40 L pot and a grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: ४० ली. आयदन आनी ग्राइंडर. एक रांदपी.

recipes.name: Kelyachem Sukkem
recipes.sub: Raw banana cooked dry with coconut

method.en: Cut into water with a little turmeric or the flesh blackens before the pan is hot.
method.l: थोडे हळदीच्या उदकांत कापात, ना जाल्यार आयदन तापचेआदीं गर काळो जाता.

method.en: Steam the pieces five minutes before they go in the oil.
method.l: कुडके तेलांत घालचेआदीं पांच मिनटां वाफेर दवरात.

method.en: Roast the coconut lightly and grind it coarse.
method.l: नाल्ल थोडें भाजात आनी जाडसर वाटात.

method.en: Finish dry with the masala clinging to each piece.
method.l: मसालो दर कुडक्याक चिकटून उरचो अशें सुकें सोंपयात.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head, and green banana off the plantation behind the guest house is free forty kilos a month. Nothing from a cow anywhere in it.
recipes.why_l: नोव रुपया दर मनशाक; सोयऱ्यांच्या घरा फाटल्या बागायतींतल्यान म्हयन्याक चाळीस किलो हिरवीं केळीं फुकट. तातूंत गायेचें कांयच ना.

start.en: Cut into turmeric water, steam, then fry. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: हळदीच्या उदकांत कापात, वाफेर दवरात, मागीर भाजात. वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A steamer and a 30 L kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: वाफेचें आयदन आनी ३० ली. कायल. दोन रांदपी.

recipes.name: Jain Khatkhatem
recipes.sub: The temple mixed vegetable, without any root in it

method.en: Cut everything to the same large size. A khatkhatem is judged by the pieces holding their shape after an hour on the fire.
method.l: सगळें एकाच व्हड मापान कापात. एक वर उज्यार उरून लेगीत कुडके आपली आकार सांबाळटात काय ना, तातूंतल्यान खतखतें तपासतात.

method.en: Boil the toor dal separately and keep it — it is what binds the pot in place of the potato most cooks add.
method.l: तुरीची डाळ वेगळी शिजयात आनी दवरात — जायते रांदपी घालतात त्या बटाट्याची जागा हीच घेता.

method.en: Roast the chilli and coriander and grind with the coconut. Crack the teppal by hand and put it in whole.
method.l: मिरसांग आनी धणे भाजून नाल्लावांगडा वाटात. तेफळां हातान फोडून आखीं घालात.

method.en: Simmer the vegetables with the paste, turmeric, asafoetida and salt an hour without stirring more than twice, and fold the dal in at the end.
method.l: भाज्यो, मसालो, हळद, हिंग आनी मीठ घालून एक वर धिम्या उज्यार शिजयात, दोन फावटींपरस चड घुस्पावचें न्हय; निमाणें डाळ भरसात.

recipes.why: Khatkhatem is the temple dish of Goa and the version cooked at a zatra is half suran and batata. Rebuilt on gourd, banana and jackfruit it is the same pot, and the teppal that makes it Goan is untouched.
recipes.why_l: खतखतें म्हळ्यार गोंयचें देवळांतलें जेवण, आनी जत्रेंत करतात तें अर्दें सुरण आनी बटाट. कोहळें, केळीं आनी फणसाचेर परत बांदल्यार तेंच भांडें उरता, आनी ताका गोंयकार करपी तेफळ तशेंच आसा.

start.en: Cut everything an hour ahead and keep it in water. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: सगळें एक वर आदीं कापून उदकांत दवरात. वाडपाआदीं अडेच वरां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A 60 L vessel with a heavy base and a grinder. Two cooks.
vessel.l: जड बुडाचें ६० ली. भांडें आनी ग्राइंडर. दोन रांदपी.

season.en: October to February, and at every zatra whatever the month.
season.l: ऑक्टोबर ते फेब्रुवारी, आनी खंयचोय म्हयनो आसूं, दर जत्रेक.

recipes.name: Jain Tendli Bhaji
recipes.sub: Ivy gourd with coconut, dry, no onion and no potato
recipes.sub_l: कांदो आनी बटाट नाशिल्ली सुकी तेंडली भाजी

method.en: Quarter the tendli lengthwise. Cut in rounds it never softens in the middle.
method.l: तेंडलीं उब्यो चार कुडके करात. गोल कापल्यार मदलो भाग शिजना.

method.en: Temper mustard, chilli, curry leaf, asafoetida and dry ginger in coconut oil.
method.l: नाल्लाच्या तेलांत मोहरी, मिरसांग, कढीपत्तो, हिंग आनी सुकें आलें घालून फोडणी करात.

method.en: Add the tendli, turmeric and salt, cover, and cook without water for twenty-five minutes, shaking the pan rather than stirring.
method.l: तेंडलीं, हळद आनी मीठ घालून धांपात आनी उदक घालनासतना पंचवीस मिनटां शिजयात; घुस्पावचे बदला भांडें हालयात.

method.en: Add jaggery and coconut and fry it dry on a high flame.
method.l: गूळ आनी नाल्ल घालून व्हड उज्यार सुकें भाजात.

recipes.why: Tendli grows over the compound wall of every house in Bardez and is in the market all year. It takes a masala without wanting a potato beside it, which makes it the one dry sabji a Jain devotee can be given on any day of the calendar.
recipes.why_l: बार्देसांतल्या दर घराच्या वण्टीचेर तेंडली वाडटा आनी वर्सभर बाजारांत आसता. ताका बटाट्याची गरज ना, देखून वर्साच्या खंयच्याय दिसा जैन भक्ताक दिवपाची सुकी भाजी हीच.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Cutting is the long part — start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: भिजोवपाक कांयच ना. वेळ कापपांत वता — वाडपाआदीं ऐंशी मिनटां सुरू करात.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai with a lid. Two cooks for the cutting, one for the cooking.
vessel.l: झांपणी आशिल्ली ३० ली. रुंद कडाय. कापपाक दोन आनी रांदपाक एक.

season.en: All year. Cheapest from November to March.
season.l: आख्खें वर्स. नोव्हेंबर ते मार्च सगळ्यांत सवाय.

recipes.name: Jain Dali Toy
recipes.sub: The everyday Goan dal, without onion or ginger
recipes.sub_l: कांदो आनी आलें नाशिल्ली सदांची डाळी तोय

method.en: Boil the dal with turmeric until no grain can be seen, and whisk it smooth. A dali toy is thin, and thin is not the same as watery.
method.l: हळद घालून डाळ शिजयात, एकय दाणो दिसचो न्हय, आनी घुस्पावन एकजीव करात. डाळी तोय पातळ आसता, पूण पातळ म्हळ्यार उदकाळ न्हय.

method.en: Add the slit green chilli and salt and boil five minutes more.
method.l: फाडिल्ली मिरसांग आनी मीठ घालून आनीक पांच मिनटां उकडात.

method.en: Heat the coconut oil until a mustard seed jumps at once, and temper mustard, cumin, dry chilli, curry leaf, asafoetida and the dry ginger.
method.l: नाल्लाचें तेल इतलें तापयात की मोहरी बेगिनूच तडतडटा; मोहरी, जिरें, सुकी मिरसांग, कढीपत्तो, हिंग आनी सुकें आलें घालात.

method.en: Pour it in and cover at once. This dal usually takes crushed ginger in the tadka and nothing else has to change to leave it out.
method.l: तें घालून बेगिनूच धांपात. ह्या डाळींत सादारण चिड्डिल्लें आलें घालतात; तें सोडचें, हेर कांयच बदलपाची गरज ना.

recipes.why: Dali toy and ukde sheet is what a Goan house eats at noon every day of the year, and it is already free of onion. Dropping the ginger for sonth is a one-line change that lets one vessel feed the whole hall.
